AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  AWS CloudFormation template to deploy an AWS Backup Audit Manager framework with
  five default compliance controls for backup protection, encryption, deletion protection,
  minimum retention, and backup frequency verification, including prerequisite AWS Config setup
  with a Customer Managed KMS Key (CMK) for S3 bucket encryption.

Parameters:
  FrameworkName:
    Type: String
    Default: BackupComplianceFramework
    Description: Name of the AWS Backup Audit Manager Framework. Must be unique within the account and region.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{0,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, or underscores, up to 256 characters.

  FrameworkDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: Framework evaluating compliance against default backup policies including retention, frequency, and encryption.
    Description: Description of the AWS Backup Audit Manager Framework.
    MaxLength: 1024

  RequiredRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 35
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 36500
    Description: Minimum retention period in days required for recovery points and backup plans.

  RequiredFrequencyValue:
    Type: Number
    Default: 24
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000
    Description: Maximum interval allowed between backup executions.

  RequiredFrequencyUnit:
    Type: String
    Default: hours
    AllowedValues:
      - hours
      - days
      - weeks
      - months
    Description: Unit of time for the backup frequency requirement.

Resources:
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS Key & Alias for AWS Config S3 Bucket Encryption
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConfigKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer Managed Key for AWS Config S3 bucket encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: ConfigKmsKeyPolicy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAWSConfigKmsUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  ConfigKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/config-bucket-key-${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ConfigKmsKey

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 Bucket & Policy for AWS Config
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConfigBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ConfigKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  ConfigBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ConfigBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketPermissionsCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketExistenceCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ConfigBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/Config/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for AWS Config
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConfigRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'aws-config-role-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWS_ConfigRole

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AWS Config Recorder & Delivery Channel
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConfigRecorder:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConfigurationRecorder
    Properties:
      Name: default
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ConfigRole.Arn
      RecordingGroup:
        AllSupported: true
        IncludeGlobalResourceTypes: true

  ConfigDeliveryChannel:
    Type: AWS::Config::DeliveryChannel
    DependsOn: ConfigBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Name: default
      S3BucketName: !Ref ConfigBucket

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AWS Backup Audit Manager Framework
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BackupAuditFramework:
    Type: AWS::Backup::Framework
    DependsOn:
      - ConfigRecorder
      - ConfigDeliveryChannel
    Properties:
      FrameworkName: !Ref FrameworkName
      FrameworkDescription: !Ref FrameworkDescription
      FrameworkControls:
        - ControlName: BACKUP_RESOURCES_PROTECTED_BY_BACKUP_PLAN

        - ControlName: BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_ENCRYPTED

        - ControlName: BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_MANUAL_DELETION_DISABLED

        - ControlName: BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_MINIMUM_RETENTION_CHECK
          ControlInputParameters:
            - ParameterName: requiredRetentionDays
              ParameterValue: !Sub '${RequiredRetentionDays}'

        - ControlName: BACKUP_PLAN_MIN_FREQUENCY_AND_MIN_RETENTION_CHECK
          ControlInputParameters:
            - ParameterName: requiredFrequencyValue
              ParameterValue: !Sub '${RequiredFrequencyValue}'
            - ParameterName: requiredFrequencyUnit
              ParameterValue: !Ref RequiredFrequencyUnit
            - ParameterName: requiredRetentionDays
              ParameterValue: !Sub '${RequiredRetentionDays}'

      FrameworkTags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: BackupAuditManagerCompliance

Outputs:
  FrameworkArn:
    Description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS Backup Audit Manager Framework.
    Value: !GetAtt BackupAuditFramework.FrameworkArn

  FrameworkName:
    Description: The name of the AWS Backup Audit Manager Framework.
    Value: !Ref BackupAuditFramework

  FrameworkStatus:
    Description: The deployment status of the AWS Backup Audit Manager Framework.
    Value: !GetAtt BackupAuditFramework.FrameworkStatus

  CreationTime:
    Description: The date and time that the framework was created.
    Value: !GetAtt BackupAuditFramework.CreationTime

  ConfigBucketName:
    Description: S3 bucket used for AWS Config recording storage.
    Value: !Ref ConfigBucket

  ConfigKmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS Key ARN used for encrypting AWS Config S3 bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt ConfigKmsKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless workflow using Step Functions that publishes custom events to a custom EventBridge event bus with a rule forwarding events to CloudWatch Logs for debugging and testing.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name for tagging and resource naming.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    Description: Retention period in days for the CloudWatch Log Group.
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365]

Resources:
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-custom-event-bus'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DebuggingLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/events/${AWS::StackName}-custom-event-bus'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DebuggingLogGroupResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EventBridgeToCWLogsPolicy'
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Sid": "TrustEventBridgeToCreateLogStreamsAndPutEvents",
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {
                "Service": "events.amazonaws.com"
              },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:PutLogEvents"
              ],
              "Resource": "${DebuggingLogGroup.Arn}:*"
            }
          ]
        }

  EventBusToLogsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    DependsOn:
      - DebuggingLogGroupResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-catch-all-to-logs'
      Description: Catch-all rule forwarding events from custom event bus to CloudWatch Logs
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - prefix: ""
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudWatchLogTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt DebuggingLogGroup.Arn

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sfn-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PutEventsToCustomBus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  WorkflowStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-event-publisher-workflow'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Workflow that formats and publishes custom events to the custom EventBridge event bus",
          "StartAt": "PublishCustomEvent",
          "States": {
            "PublishCustomEvent": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::events:putEvents",
              "Parameters": {
                "Entries": [
                  {
                    "EventBusName": "${CustomEventBus.Arn}",
                    "Source": "mycompany.orderprocessing",
                    "DetailType": "OrderPlaced",
                    "Detail.$": "$.order"
                  }
                ]
              },
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  CustomEventBusName:
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge Event Bus
    Value: !Ref CustomEventBus

  CustomEventBusArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom EventBridge Event Bus
    Value: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  DebuggingLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs Log Group capturing events
    Value: !GetAtt DebuggingLogGroup.Arn

  StateMachineArn:

Description: CodePipeline custom action type for deploying to AWS OpsWorks via a Lambda worker function.

Resources:
  WorkerLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OpsWorksCustomActionWorkerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codepipeline:PutJobSuccessResult
                  - codepipeline:PutJobFailureResult
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - opsworks:CreateDeployment
                  - opsworks:DescribeDeployments
                  - opsworks:DescribeApps
                  - opsworks:DescribeStacks
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'

  WorkerLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-opsworks-deployer'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt WorkerLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 256
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cp_client = boto3.client('codepipeline')
          opsworks_client = boto3.client('opsworks')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              job_id = None
              try:
                  job = event.get('CodePipeline.job')
                  if not job:
                      logger.error('No CodePipeline.job found in event payload')
                      return

                  job_id = job.get('id')
                  job_data = job.get('data', {})
                  action_config = job_data.get('actionConfiguration', {}).get('configuration', {})

                  deploy_bucket = action_config.get('Deploy-Bucket')
                  opsworks_stack_id = action_config.get('OpsWorks-Stack-ID')
                  opsworks_app_id = action_config.get('OpsWorks-App-ID')

                  if not deploy_bucket or not opsworks_stack_id or not opsworks_app_id:
                      raise ValueError('Missing required configuration properties: Deploy-Bucket, OpsWorks-Stack-ID, or OpsWorks-App-ID')

                  logger.info(f"Triggering OpsWorks deployment for App: {opsworks_app_id} on Stack: {opsworks_stack_id} using bucket: {deploy_bucket}")

                  response = opsworks_client.create_deployment(
                      StackId=opsworks_stack_id,
                      AppId=opsworks_app_id,
                      Command={
                          'Name': 'deploy'
                      },
                      Comment=f"Deployment initiated by CodePipeline Custom Action Job {job_id}"

                  deployment_id = response.get('DeploymentId')
                  logger.info(f"Created OpsWorks deployment successfully. DeploymentId: {deployment_id}")

                  cp_client.put_job_success_result(
                      jobId=job_id,
                      outputVariables={
                          'DeploymentId': deployment_id
                      }
                  )
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.exception('Failed to process CodePipeline job')
                  if job_id:
                      cp_client.put_job_failure_result(
                          jobId=job_id,
                          failureDetails={
                              'type': 'JobFailed',
                              'message': str(e),
                              'externalExecutionId': context.aws_request_id

          Queryable: false
          Type: String
        - Name: OpsWorks-App-ID

          Required: true
          Key: true
          Secret: false
          Queryable: true
          Type: String

                  - !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn

            "EvaluateInstanceState": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                  "StringEquals": "running",
                  "Next": "HandleRunningState"
                },
                {
                  "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                  "StringEquals": "stopped",
                  "Next": "HandleStoppedState"
                },
                {
                  "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                  "StringEquals": "terminated",
                  "Next": "HandleTerminatedState"

Description: CloudFormation template creating an S3 bucket encrypted with a KMS CMK, Glue database, and Glue crawler to catalog AWS CloudTrail logs for Amazon Athena queries.

Parameters:
  DatabasePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: cloudtrail
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9_]+$'
    Description: Prefix for the Glue database name. It will be combined with the suffix -kk-admin-db.

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Customer Managed Key for encrypting CloudTrail S3 bucket logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailEncrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-cloudtrail-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  CloudTrailLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  CloudTrailLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CloudTrailLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny

          ping: String

        WriteCapacityUnits: 5

        AttributeName: expires_at

      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  DynamoDBAutoscalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'

              Service:
                - application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoscalingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable

        TargetValue: 70.0
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:

  WriteCapacityScalableTarget:

      MaxCapacity: 40
      MinCapacity: 5

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Foundational infrastructure for Amazon ECS Anywhere, including an ECS cluster,
  an IAM role for registering and managing external container instances via AWS Systems Manager,
  and an SSM Command Document to automate the ECS Anywhere registration script on target servers.

Parameters:
  ClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-anywhere-cluster
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster for on-premises external container instances.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.

  InstanceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: on-prem-node
    Description: Prefix applied to registered external container instances for identification.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.

Resources:
  EcsAnywhereRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ClusterName}-ecs-anywhere-role'
      Description: IAM role for on-premises instances registered to ECS Anywhere via AWS Systems Manager.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2ContainerServiceforEC2Role
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ClusterName}-ecs-anywhere-role'

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Ref ClusterName
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ClusterName

  EcsAnywhereRegistrationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ClusterName}-RegisterExternalInstance'
      DocumentType: Command
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '2.2'
        description: Register on-premises Linux instance into the ECS Anywhere cluster using the ECS registration script.
        parameters:
          ActivationCode:
            type: String
            description: Systems Manager activation code generated from create-activation.
          ActivationId:
            type: String
            description: Systems Manager activation ID generated from create-activation.
          Region:
            type: String
            default: !Ref AWS::Region
            description: AWS Region where the ECS cluster and Systems Manager activation reside.
          InstanceName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref InstanceNamePrefix
            description: Hostname or display name prefix for the external container instance.
          Cluster:
            type: String
            default: !Ref ClusterName
            description: Name of the ECS cluster to register the instance with.
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runShellScript
            name: RegisterEcsAnywhereInstance
            inputs:
              timeoutSeconds: '600'
              runCommand:
                - |
                  #!/usr/bin/env bash
                  set -euo pipefail
                  echo "Downloading ECS Anywhere registration script..."
                  curl -fsSL "https://amazon-ecs-agent.s3.amazonaws.com/ecs-anywhere-install.sh" -o /tmp/ecs-anywhere-install.sh
                  chmod +x /tmp/ecs-anywhere-install.sh
                  echo "Executing ECS Anywhere registration script for cluster {{ Cluster }} in region {{ Region }}..."
                  bash /tmp/ecs-anywhere-install.sh \
                    --cluster "{{ Cluster }}" \
                    --region "{{ Region }}" \
                    --activation-code "{{ ActivationCode }}" \
                    --activation-id "{{ ActivationId }}"
                  rm -f /tmp/ecs-anywhere-install.sh
                  echo "ECS Anywhere registration completed successfully."
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ClusterName}-RegisterExternalInstance'

Outputs:
  EcsClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster for external container instances.
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster

  EcsClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS cluster for external container instances.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsCluster.Arn

  EcsAnywhereRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role to associate with AWS Systems Manager hybrid activations.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsAnywhereRole.Arn

  EcsAnywhereRegistrationDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Document used to run the ECS Anywhere registration workflow.
    Value: !Ref EcsAnywhereRegistrationDocument

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready CloudFormation template deploying an automated Chaos Engineering workflow using AWS Step Functions to test ECS service resilience.

Parameters:
  LatestAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
    Description: SSM Parameter path to retrieve the latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI ID.

Resources:
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking Resources
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ChaosVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Chaos-Engineering-VPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Chaos-Engineering-IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Chaos-Public-RouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Chaos-Public-Subnet-1

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security Groups
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TargetInstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the target EC2 chaos instance
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow outbound traffic within VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Chaos-Target-Instance-SG

  EcsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS Fargate tasks
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow HTTP ingress from within VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow outbound traffic within VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Chaos-ECS-Service-SG

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EC2 Target Instance
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ChaosTargetInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DependsOn:
      - PublicRoute
      - SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref TargetInstanceSecurityGroup
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpEndpoint: enabled
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Chaos-Target-EC2-Instance

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS Customer Managed Key & Alias for SNS Encryption
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlertKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Customer Managed Key for encrypting chaos engineering SNS alerts
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSNSServiceUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Chaos-Alert-KMS-Key

  AlertKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/chaos-alerts-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AlertKey

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Notification (SNS)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlertSnsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: ChaosEngineeringAlerts
      TopicName: chaos-engineering-ecs-alerts
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AlertKey

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS Cluster, Task Definition, Service & Logging
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: chaos-engineering-cluster

  EcsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /ecs/chaos-resilient-service
      RetentionInDays: 7

  EcsTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

  EcsTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  EcsTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: chaos-resilient-task
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: web-app
          Image: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:stable-alpine
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref EcsLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs

  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - PublicRoute
      - SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      ServiceName: chaos-resilient-service
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref EcsTaskDefinition
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: 0
      EnableECSManagedTags: false
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 0
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: ENABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PublicSubnet
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref EcsSecurityGroup

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda Functions & IAM Roles
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EC2TerminatorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2TerminationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource: '*'

  EC2TerminatorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: chaos-ec2-terminator
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt EC2TerminatorRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          ec2_client = boto3.client('ec2')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              instance_id = event.get('InstanceId')
              if not instance_id:
                  raise ValueError("Missing 'InstanceId' in input payload.")

              print(f"Received request to terminate instance: {instance_id}")
              try:
                  response = ec2_client.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
                  terminating_instances = response.get('TerminatingInstances', [])
                  print(f"Termination initiated: {terminating_instances}")
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'instanceId': instance_id,
                      'terminatingInstances': terminating_instances
                  }
              except ClientError as e:
                  print(f"Error terminating instance {instance_id}: {str(e)}")
                  raise e

  ECSHealthCheckerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ECSHealthCheckAndSNSPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:service/${EcsCluster}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref AlertSnsTopic
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt AlertKey.Arn

  ECSHealthCheckerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: chaos-ecs-health-checker
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt ECSHealthCheckerRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          ecs_client = boto3.client('ecs')
          sns_client = boto3.client('sns')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              cluster_name = event.get('ClusterName')
              service_name = event.get('ServiceName')
              sns_topic_arn = event.get('SnsTopicArn')

              if not cluster_name or not service_name or not sns_topic_arn:
                  raise ValueError("ClusterName, ServiceName, and SnsTopicArn are required in payload.")

              print(f"Checking health for service {service_name} in cluster {cluster_name}")
              response = ecs_client.describe_services(
                  cluster=cluster_name,
                  services=[service_name]
              )

              services = response.get('services', [])
              if not services:
                  error_msg = f"ECS Service {service_name} was not found in cluster {cluster_name}."
                  print(error_msg)
                  sns_client.publish(
                      TopicArn=sns_topic_arn,
                      Subject=f"ALERT: Chaos Test - ECS Service Not Found: {service_name}",
                      Message=error_msg
                  )
                  return {'healthy': False, 'status': 'NOT_FOUND', 'reason': error_msg}

              service = services[0]
              status = service.get('status')
              desired_count = service.get('desiredCount', 0)
              running_count = service.get('runningCount', 0)

              is_healthy = (status == 'ACTIVE') and (running_count >= desired_count)
              print(f"Status: {status}, Desired: {desired_count}, Running: {running_count}, Healthy: {is_healthy}")

              if not is_healthy:
                  subject = f"ALERT: Chaos Test - ECS Service {service_name} Unhealthy"
                  message = (
                      f"Chaos testing has detected an unhealthy ECS service!\n"
                      f"Cluster: {cluster_name}\n"
                      f"Service: {service_name}\n"
                      f"Status: {status}\n"
                      f"Desired Count: {desired_count}\n"
                      f"Running Count: {running_count}\n"
                  )
                  print(f"Publishing alert to {sns_topic_arn}")
                  sns_client.publish(
                      TopicArn=sns_topic_arn,
                      Subject=subject,
                      Message=message
                  )

              return {
                  'healthy': is_healthy,
                  'clusterName': cluster_name,
                  'serviceName': service_name,
                  'status': status,
                  'desiredCount': desired_count,
                  'runningCount': running_count
              }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions State Machine & IAM Role
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StepFunctionsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeChaosLambdasPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt EC2TerminatorFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt ECSHealthCheckerFunction.Arn

  ChaosStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: ChaosEngineeringEcsResilienceWorkflow
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        TerminatorArn: !GetAtt EC2TerminatorFunction.Arn
        HealthCheckerArn: !GetAtt ECSHealthCheckerFunction.Arn
        TargetInstanceId: !Ref ChaosTargetInstance
        ClusterName: !Ref EcsCluster
        ServiceName: chaos-resilient-service
        TopicArn: !Ref AlertSnsTopic
      Definition:
        Comment: Chaos Engineering workflow to test ECS resilience after EC2 instance termination.
        StartAt: TerminateChaosEC2Instance
        States:
          TerminateChaosEC2Instance:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: ${TerminatorArn}
              Payload:
                InstanceId: ${TargetInstanceId}
            ResultPath: $.terminationResult
            Next: WaitForRecoveryWindow
          WaitForRecoveryWindow:
            Type: Wait
            Seconds: 300
            Next: CheckECSHealthAndAlert
          CheckECSHealthAndAlert:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: ${HealthCheckerArn}
              Payload:
                ClusterName: ${ClusterName}
                ServiceName: ${ServiceName}
                SnsTopicArn: ${TopicArn}
            ResultPath: $.healthCheckResult
            End: true

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions Chaos Engineering State Machine
    Value: !Ref ChaosStateMachine

  ECSClusterName:
    Description: Name of the resilient ECS Cluster
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster

  ECSServiceName:
    Description: Name of the resilient ECS Service
    Value: chaos-resilient-service

  EC2TargetInstanceId:
    Description: Instance ID of the Chaos Target EC2 Instance
    Value: !Ref ChaosTargetInstance

  SNSTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS Alert Topic
    Value: !Ref AlertSnsTopic

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the Customer Managed Key for SNS
    Value: !GetAtt AlertKey.Arn

  EC2TerminatorFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Terminator Lambda Function
    Value: !GetAtt EC2TerminatorFunction.Arn

  ECSHealthCheckerFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS Health Checker Lambda Function
    Value: !GetAtt ECSHealthCheckerFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Production-ready CloudFormation template deploying IAM roles, custom resource
  handlers, and configuration for AWS DevOps Agent Space and monitoring association.

Parameters:
  SpaceName:
    Type: String
    Description: The name of the DevOps Agent Space.
    Default: devops-agent-space
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores, max 64 chars.

  OperatorAppName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the operator application.
    Default: devops-operator-app
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores, max 64 chars.

Resources:
  DevOpsAgentServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-devops-agent-service-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by aidevops.amazonaws.com for agent execution.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:aidevops:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:space/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSCloudTrail_ReadOnlyAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXrayWriteOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ServiceLinkedRoleCreationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateServiceLinkedRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/aidevops.amazonaws.com/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/devops-guru.amazonaws.com/*'
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    iam:AWSServiceName:
                      - aidevops.amazonaws.com
                      - devops-guru.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: PutSLRRolePolicy
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/aidevops.amazonaws.com/*'

  DevOpsOperatorAppRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-devops-operator-app-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by aidevops.amazonaws.com for operator console and telemetry application.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:aidevops:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:operator-application/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OperatorTelemetryInspectionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: TelemetryAndInsightsInspection
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:FilterLogEvents
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - devops-guru:DescribeAccountHealth
                  - devops-guru:DescribeAccountOverview
                  - devops-guru:GetCostEstimation
                  - devops-guru:SearchInsights
                  - devops-guru:ListInsights
                Resource: '*'

  DevOpsGuruResourceCollection:
    Type: AWS::DevOpsGuru::ResourceCollection
    Properties:
      ResourceCollectionFilter:
        CloudFormation:
          StackNames:
            - !Ref AWS::StackName

  DevOpsAgentSpaceManagerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-space-manager-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SpaceManagementPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - devops-guru:UpdateResourceCollection
                  - devops-guru:GetResourceCollection
                  - devops-guru:DescribeAccountHealth
                Resource: '*'

  DevOpsAgentSpaceManagerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-space-manager'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt DevOpsAgentSpaceManagerRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import hashlib
          import urllib.request

          def send_response(event, context, response_status, response_data, physical_resource_id=None):
              response_url = event['ResponseURL']
              response_body = json.dumps({
                  'Status': response_status,
                  'Reason': f'See CloudWatch Log Stream: {context.log_stream_name}',
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or event.get('PhysicalResourceId', context.log_stream_name),
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': response_data
              }).encode('utf-8')

              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  response_url,
                  data=response_body,
                  headers={'content-type': '', 'content-length': str(len(response_body))},
                  method='PUT'
              )
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as res:
                      pass
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Failed sending response: {e}")

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  space_name = props['SpaceName']
                  operator_name = props['OperatorAppName']

Description: AWS CloudFormation template demonstrating Systems Manager Parameter Store and Secrets Manager access via an AWS Lambda function named ParameterStoreDemo.

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ParameterStoreAndSecretsManagerAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AWS::StackName}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:/${AWS::StackName}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
                Resource: '*'

  ParameterStoreDemoLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ParameterStoreDemo
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STACK_NAME: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          ssm_client = boto3.client('ssm')
          secrets_client = boto3.client('secretsmanager')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              stack_name = os.environ.get('STACK_NAME')
              parameter_path = f"/{stack_name}/"
              print(f"Retrieving SSM parameters under path: {parameter_path}")

              # Retrieve all SSM Parameters under the stack's path
              ssm_parameters = []
              try:
                  paginator = ssm_client.get_paginator('get_parameters_by_path')
                  for page in paginator.paginate(
                      Path=parameter_path,
                      Recursive=True,
                      WithDecryption=True
                  ):
                      for param in page.get('Parameters', []):
                          param_info = {
                              'Name': param.get('Name'),
                              'Type': param.get('Type'),
                              'Value': param.get('Value'),
                              'Version': param.get('Version')
                          }
                          ssm_parameters.append(param_info)
                          print(f"SSM Parameter: {param_info['Name']} = {param_info['Value']} (Type: {param_info['Type']})")
              except ClientError as e:
                  print(f"Error fetching SSM parameters: {e}")

              # Retrieve Secrets matching the stack prefix
              secrets_found = []
              try:
                  paginator = secrets_client.get_paginator('list_secrets')
                  prefix = f"/{stack_name}/"
                  for page in paginator.paginate(
                      Filters=[
                          {
                              'Key': 'name',
                              'Values': [prefix]
                          }
                      ]
                  ):
                      for secret in page.get('SecretList', []):
                          secret_name = secret.get('Name')
                          secret_arn = secret.get('ARN')
                          print(f"Found Secret: {secret_name} (ARN: {secret_arn})")

                          try:
                              value_response = secrets_client.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_arn)
                              secret_value = value_response.get('SecretString')
                              secrets_found.append({
                                  'Name': secret_name,
                                  'ARN': secret_arn,
                                  'Value': secret_value
                              })
                              print(f"Retrieved Secret Value for {secret_name}: {secret_value}")
                          except ClientError as secret_err:
                              print(f"Error retrieving secret value for {secret_name}: {secret_err}")
              except ClientError as e:
                  print(f"Error listing secrets: {e}")

              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({
                      'message': 'Successfully processed SSM parameters and Secrets',
                      'parameter_count': len(ssm_parameters),
                      'parameters': ssm_parameters,
                      'secret_count': len(secrets_found),
                      'secrets': [
                          {'Name': s['Name'], 'ARN': s['ARN']} for s in secrets_found
                      ]
                  })
              }

  EnvironmentParameterName:
    Description: Name of the Environment SSM Parameter
    Value: !Ref EnvironmentParameter

    Description: ARN of the generated Database Secret in Secrets Manager
    Value: !Ref DatabaseSecret

Description: Configures GitHub Actions OIDC identity provider and IAM role for guardian/facia-scala-client with read-only access to the facia-tool-store S3 bucket DEV prefix using a Customer Managed KMS Key.

Resources:
  GitHubOIDCProvider:
    Type: AWS::IAM::OIDCProvider
    Properties:
      Url: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
      ClientIdList:
        - sts.amazonaws.com
      ThumbprintList:
        - 6938fd907821a48ac88da002ac0404fa870c0c54
        - 1c58a3a8518e8759bf075b76b750d4f8d70462ff

  FaciaToolStoreKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Customer Managed Key for encrypting the facia-tool-store S3 bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  FaciaToolStoreKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/facia-tool-store-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FaciaToolStoreKey

  FaciaToolStoreBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt FaciaToolStoreKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  GitHubActionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: facia-scala-client-github-actions-role
      Description: IAM role assumed by GitHub Actions for guardian/facia-scala-client with read-only access to the facia-tool-store S3 bucket.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: !Ref GitHubOIDCProvider
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud: sts.amazonaws.com
              StringLike:
                token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub: repo:guardian/facia-scala-client:*
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FaciaToolStoreDevReadOnlyAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListFaciaToolStoreBucketDevPrefix
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt FaciaToolStoreBucket.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    s3:prefix:
                      - DEV/*
                      - DEV
              - Sid: GetObjectsFromDevPrefix
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub '${FaciaToolStoreBucket.Arn}/DEV/*'
              - Sid: DecryptWithKMSKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FaciaToolStoreKey.Arn

Outputs:

    Value: !Ref GitHubOIDCProvider

    Value: !GetAtt FaciaToolStoreBucket.Arn

    Description: Name of the facia-tool-store S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref FaciaToolStoreBucket

    Value: !GetAtt FaciaToolStoreKey.Arn

    Description: ARN of the IAM Role for GitHub Actions
    Value: !GetAtt GitHubActionsRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates a Python Lambda function that logs the current time to CloudWatch Logs, scheduled to run every 5 minutes via EventBridge.

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  TimeLoggerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              current_time = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
              logger.info(f"Current UTC Time: {current_time}")
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({'currentTime': current_time})
              }

  ScheduledRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Triggers the TimeLogger Lambda function every 5 minutes
      ScheduleExpression: rate(5 minutes)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt TimeLoggerFunction.Arn
          Id: TimeLoggerTarget

  PermissionForEventsToInvokeLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref TimeLoggerFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt ScheduledRule.Arn

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Time Logger Lambda Function
    Value: !GetAtt TimeLoggerFunction.Arn

  LambdaExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda Execution IAM Role
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn

  ScheduledRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge Scheduled Rule
    Value: !GetAtt ScheduledRule.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions an SSM Document and Association to collect custom inventory of database and caching processes on Linux and Windows EC2 instances.

Parameters:
  LinuxProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: 'CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached'
    Description: Comma-delimited list of process keywords to scan for on Linux EC2 instances.

  WindowsProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: 'sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached'
    Description: Comma-delimited list of process keywords to scan for on Windows EC2 instances.

  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: 'rate(30 days)'
    Description: Schedule expression (cron or rate syntax) defining how frequently the inventory scan association runs.

Resources:
  ProcessInventorySSMDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Command
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '2.2'
        description: Custom inventory collection document scanning for active database and caching processes.
        parameters:
          LinuxProcesses:
            type: String
            description: Comma-delimited list of process keywords to search on Linux.
            default: 'CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached'
          WindowsProcesses:
            type: String
            description: Comma-delimited list of process keywords to search on Windows.
            default: 'sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached'
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runShellScript
            name: CollectLinuxProcesses
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Linux
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - |
                  #!/usr/bin/env bash
                  set -u

                  # Retrieve EC2 instance ID via IMDSv2 with IMDSv1 fallback
                  IMDS_TOKEN=$(curl -s -S -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 60" 2>/dev/null || true)
                  if [ -n "$IMDS_TOKEN" ]; then
                    INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s -S -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $IMDS_TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
                  else
                    INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s -S http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
                  fi

                  CAPTURE_TIME=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
                  INVENTORY_DIR="/var/lib/amazon/ssm/inventory/custom"
                  mkdir -p "$INVENTORY_DIR"
                  INVENTORY_FILE="$INVENTORY_DIR/processes.json"

                  TARGET_KEYWORDS="{{ LinuxProcesses }}"
                  IFS=',' read -r -a KEYWORD_ARRAY <<< "$TARGET_KEYWORDS"

                  ENTRIES=()
                  for KEYWORD in "${KEYWORD_ARRAY[@]}"; do
                    # Strip leading and trailing whitespace
                    KEYWORD="$(echo "$KEYWORD" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')"
                    [ -z "$KEYWORD" ] && continue

                    # Search processes matching keyword; filter out grep itself and the script
                    MATCHES=$(ps -eo pid,user,comm,args --no-headers 2>/dev/null | grep -i -- "$KEYWORD" | grep -v grep | grep -v "CollectLinuxProcesses" || true)

                    if [ -n "$MATCHES" ]; then
                      while IFS= read -r line; do
                        [ -z "$line" ] && continue
                        PID_VAL=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $1}')
                        USER_VAL=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $2}')
                        COMM_VAL=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $3}')
                        ARGS_VAL=$(echo "$line" | awk '{$1=""; $2=""; $3=""; sub(/^[ \t]+/, ""); print}')
                        # Escape special JSON characters
                        SAFE_ARGS=$(echo "$ARGS_VAL" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g; s/\t/\\t/g' | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 256)
                        SAFE_COMM=$(echo "$COMM_VAL" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')
                        SAFE_KEYWORD=$(echo "$KEYWORD" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')

                        ENTRY="{\"CaptureTime\":\"$CAPTURE_TIME\",\"InstanceId\":\"$INSTANCE_ID\",\"ProcessName\":\"$SAFE_COMM\",\"ProcessId\":\"$PID_VAL\",\"User\":\"$USER_VAL\",\"CommandLine\":\"$SAFE_ARGS\",\"MatchedKeyword\":\"$SAFE_KEYWORD\"}"
                        ENTRIES+=("$ENTRY")
                      done <<< "$MATCHES"
                    fi
                  done

                  # Build JSON payload
                  JSON_PAYLOAD="{\n  \"SchemaVersion\": \"1.0\",\n  \"TypeName\": \"Custom:ProcessInformation\",\n  \"Content\": [\n"
                  TOTAL_ENTRIES=${#ENTRIES[@]}
                  for (( i=0; i<TOTAL_ENTRIES; i++ )); do
                    if [ $i -lt $(( TOTAL_ENTRIES - 1 )) ]; then
                      JSON_PAYLOAD+="    ${ENTRIES[$i]},\n"
                    else
                      JSON_PAYLOAD+="    ${ENTRIES[$i]}\n"
                    fi
                  done
                  JSON_PAYLOAD+="  ]\n}"

                  echo -e "$JSON_PAYLOAD" > "$INVENTORY_FILE"
                  echo "Custom inventory saved to $INVENTORY_FILE with $TOTAL_ENTRIES matching process(es)."

          - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
            name: CollectWindowsProcesses
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Windows
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - |
                  $ErrorActionPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'

                  # Retrieve EC2 instance ID via IMDSv2 with IMDSv1 fallback
                  $token = $null
                  try {
                    $token = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -Method PUT -Headers @{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds" = "60"} -TimeoutSec 3
                  } catch {}

                  $instanceId = "unknown"
                  try {
                    if ($token) {
                      $instanceId = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id" -Headers @{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token" = $token} -TimeoutSec 3
                    } else {
                      $instanceId = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id" -TimeoutSec 3
                    }
                  } catch {}

                  $captureTime = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
                  $inventoryDir = "C:\ProgramData\Amazon\SSM\InstanceData\Inventory\Custom"
                  if (!(Test-Path -Path $inventoryDir)) {
                    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $inventoryDir -Force | Out-Null
                  }
                  $inventoryFile = Join-Path $inventoryDir "processes.json"

                  $keywordsRaw = '{{ WindowsProcesses }}'
                  $keywords = $keywordsRaw.Split(',') | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne "" }

                  $runningProcesses = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Property ProcessId, Name, CommandLine

                  $contentList = [System.Collections.Generic.List[PSObject]]::new()

                  foreach ($keyword in $keywords) {
                    $matching = $runningProcesses | Where-Object {
                      ($_.Name -and ($_.Name -like "*$keyword*")) -or
                      ($_.CommandLine -and ($_.CommandLine -like "*$keyword*"))
                    }

                    foreach ($proc in $matching) {
                      $cmdLine = ""
                      if ($proc.CommandLine) {
                        $cmdLine = $proc.CommandLine
                        if ($cmdLine.Length -gt 256) {
                          $cmdLine = $cmdLine.Substring(0, 256)
                        }
                      }
                      $item = [PSCustomObject]@{
                        CaptureTime    = $captureTime
                        InstanceId     = $instanceId
                        ProcessName    = [string]$proc.Name
                        ProcessId      = [string]$proc.ProcessId
                        CommandLine    = $cmdLine
                        MatchedKeyword = $keyword
                      }
                      $contentList.Add($item)
                    }
                  }

                  $inventoryPayload = [PSCustomObject]@{
                    SchemaVersion = "1.0"
                    TypeName      = "Custom:ProcessInformation"
                    Content       = $contentList
                  }

                  $jsonOutput = $inventoryPayload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
                  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($inventoryFile, $jsonOutput, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
                  Write-Output "Custom inventory written to $inventoryFile with $($contentList.Count) matching process(es)."

  ProcessInventoryAssociation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Association
    Properties:
      AssociationName: Custom-Inventory-Processes
      Name: !Ref ProcessInventorySSMDocument
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      Targets:
        - Key: InstanceIds
          Values:
            - '*'
      Parameters:
        LinuxProcesses:
          - !Ref LinuxProcessKeywords
        WindowsProcesses:
          - !Ref WindowsProcessKeywords

Outputs:
  SSMDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Document created for process inventory collection.
    Value: !Ref ProcessInventorySSMDocument

  SSMAssociationId:
    Description: Association ID of the Custom-Inventory-Processes SSM Association.
    Value: !Ref ProcessInventoryAssociation

  SSMAssociationName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Association configured for inventory collection.
    Value: Custom-Inventory-Processes
deploy_logs: ["Creating stack 'iac-god-eval-18c6ad58' on aws", 'iac-god-eval-18c6ad58: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - User Initiated', 'ProcessInventorySSMDocument: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'ProcessInventorySSMDocument: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Resource creation Initiated', 'ProcessInventorySSMDocument: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Eventual consistency check initiated', 'ProcessInventorySSMDocument: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'ProcessInventoryAssociation: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'ProcessInventoryAssociation: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Resource creation Initiated', 'ProcessInventoryAssociation: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Eventual consistency check initiated', 'iac-god-eval-18c6ad58: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Eventual consistency check initiated', 'ProcessInventoryAssociation: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'iac-god-eval-18c6ad58: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A']

    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'DataZoneDomainExecutionRole-${DomainName}'

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

              Service: datazone.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

                  - glue:BatchGetPartition
