AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: S3 buckets for a data processing pipeline including source, target, and conditional EMR log bucket with KMS CMK encryption, lifecycle rules, and export outputs.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment identifier used for naming and tagging resources.
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  CreateEmrLogBucket:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether to create the EMR log bucket.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

Mappings:
  RegionStorageClassMap:
    us-east-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    us-east-2:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    us-west-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    us-west-2:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    eu-west-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    eu-west-2:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    eu-central-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    ap-northeast-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    ap-northeast-2:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    ap-southeast-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    ap-southeast-2:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    ap-south-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    sa-east-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    ca-central-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA

Conditions:
  ShouldCreateEmrLogBucket: !Equals [!Ref CreateEmrLogBucket, 'true']

Resources:
  PipelineEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer Managed Key for encrypting data processing pipeline S3 buckets.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: PipelineKeyPolicy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  PipelineEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-s3-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref PipelineEncryptionKey

  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt PipelineEncryptionKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: RetentionPolicyDisabled
            Status: Disabled
            Transitions:
              - TransitionInDays: 90
                StorageClass: !FindInMap [RegionStorageClassMap, !Ref 'AWS::Region', StorageClass]
            ExpirationInDays: 2555
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: PipelineRole
          Value: Source

  SourceBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref SourceBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt SourceBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${SourceBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  TargetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt PipelineEncryptionKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: RetentionPolicyDisabled
            Status: Disabled
            Transitions:
              - TransitionInDays: 90
                StorageClass: !FindInMap [RegionStorageClassMap, !Ref 'AWS::Region', StorageClass]
            ExpirationInDays: 2555
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: PipelineRole
          Value: Target

  TargetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TargetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt TargetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${TargetBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  EmrLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: ShouldCreateEmrLogBucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt PipelineEncryptionKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: LogRetentionAndTransition
            Status: Enabled
            Transitions:
              - TransitionInDays: 90
                StorageClass: !FindInMap [RegionStorageClassMap, !Ref 'AWS::Region', StorageClass]
            ExpirationInDays: 2555
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: PipelineRole
          Value: EmrLogs

  EmrLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: ShouldCreateEmrLogBucket
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref EmrLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt EmrLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${EmrLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

Outputs:
  SourceBucketName:
    Description: Name of the source data bucket
    Value: !Ref SourceBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SourceBucketName'

  SourceBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the source data bucket
    Value: !GetAtt SourceBucket.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SourceBucketArn'

  TargetBucketName:
    Description: Name of the target data bucket
    Value: !Ref TargetBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TargetBucketName'

  TargetBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the target data bucket
    Value: !GetAtt TargetBucket.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TargetBucketArn'

  PipelineEncryptionKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for bucket encryption
    Value: !GetAtt PipelineEncryptionKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PipelineEncryptionKeyArn'

  EmrLogBucketName:
    Condition: ShouldCreateEmrLogBucket
    Description: Name of the EMR log bucket
    Value: !Ref EmrLogBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EmrLogBucketName'

  EmrLogBucketDomainName:
    Condition: ShouldCreateEmrLogBucket
    Description: IPv4 DNS name of the EMR log bucket
    Value: !GetAtt EmrLogBucket.DomainName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EmrLogBucketDomainName'

  EmrLogBucketRegionalDomainName:
    Condition: ShouldCreateEmrLogBucket
    Description: Regional DNS domain name of the EMR log bucket
    Value: !GetAtt EmrLogBucket.RegionalDomainName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EmrLogBucketRegionalDomainName'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Automatically enforces IMDSv2 and disables IMDSv1 on EC2 instances transitioning to running state via EventBridge and SSM Automation.

Parameters:
  HttpPutResponseHopLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 64
    Description: The desired HTTP PUT response hop limit for instance metadata requests (between 1 and 64).

Resources:
  SSMAutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role assumed by Systems Manager Automation to enforce IMDSv2 on EC2 instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2MetadataRemediationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
                Resource: '*'

  EventBridgeSSMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role assumed by EventBridge to trigger SSM Automation and pass execution role.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgeStartSSMAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMAutomationExecutionRole.Arn

  IMDSv2EnforcementRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Triggers AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata when an EC2 instance enters the running state.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - running
      Targets:
        - Id: EnforceIMDSv2Target
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:$DEFAULT'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeSSMRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              instanceId: '$.detail.instance-id'
            InputTemplate: !Sub >-
              {
                "InstanceId": ["<instanceId>"],
                "EnforceIMDSv2": ["required"],
                "HttpPutResponseHopLimit": ["${HttpPutResponseHopLimit}"],
                "AutomationAssumeRole": ["${SSMAutomationExecutionRole.Arn}"]
              }

Outputs:
  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule triggering IMDSv2 configuration automation.
    Value: !GetAtt IMDSv2EnforcementRule.Arn

  EventBridgeInvocationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by EventBridge to invoke SSM Automation.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeSSMRole.Arn

  SSMAutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by SSM Automation to modify EC2 instance metadata options.
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS AppSync GraphQL API with AWS IAM authentication and an Amazon EventBridge data source configured to put events onto a custom EventBridge event bus.

Resources:
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-event-bus'

  AppSyncEventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PutEventsToCustomBus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Note {
          NoteId: ID!
          title: String!
          content: String!
        }

        type Query {
          getNote(NoteId: ID!): Note
        }

        type Mutation {
          saveNote(NoteId: ID!, title: String!, content: String!): Note
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  EventBridgeDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: EventBridgeDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_EVENTBRIDGE
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncEventBridgeRole.Arn
      EventBridgeConfig:
        EventBusArn: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  SaveNoteResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: saveNote
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt EventBridgeDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "PutEvents",
          "params": {
            "entries": [
              {
                "Source": "appsync.notes",
                "DetailType": "NoteSaved",
                "Detail": "$util.toJson($ctx.arguments)"
              }
            ]
          }
        }

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Scheduled Lambda function to periodically scan and clean up expired records from the DynamoDB throttle table.

Parameters:
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: 'rate(1 hour)'
    Description: Schedule expression for triggering cleanup Lambda (e.g., 'rate(1 hour)'). Set to empty string to disable the schedule.

Conditions:
  HasSchedule: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ScheduleExpression, '']]

Resources:
  ThrottleTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: throttle
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: PK
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: ExpiresAt
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: PK
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: ExpiresAt
          KeyType: RANGE

  CleanupLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      RetentionInDays: 30

  CleanupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCleanupAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ThrottleTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CleanupLogGroup.Arn

  DynamoDBCleanupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - CleanupLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt CleanupLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref ThrottleTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import time
          import boto3
          from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Attr

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              now = int(time.time())
              print(f"Starting cleanup of {table_name} for records with ExpiresAt <= {now}")
              
              deleted_count = 0
              scan_kwargs = {
                  'FilterExpression': Attr('ExpiresAt').lte(now),
                  'ProjectionExpression': '#pk, #exp',
                  'ExpressionAttributeNames': {
                      '#pk': 'PK',
                      '#exp': 'ExpiresAt'
                  }
              }

              while True:
                  response = table.scan(**scan_kwargs)
                  items = response.get('Items', [])

                  if items:
                      with table.batch_writer() as batch:
                          for item in items:
                              batch.delete_item(
                                  Key={
                                      'PK': item['PK'],
                                      'ExpiresAt': item['ExpiresAt']
                                  }
                              )
                      deleted_count += len(items)

                  if 'LastEvaluatedKey' in response:
                      scan_kwargs['ExclusiveStartKey'] = response['LastEvaluatedKey']
                  else:
                      break

              print(f"Cleanup complete. Total records deleted: {deleted_count}")
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'deletedRecords': deleted_count
              }

  CleanupScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: HasSchedule
    Properties:
      Description: Scheduled trigger for DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt DynamoDBCleanupFunction.Arn
          Id: DynamoDBCleanupFunctionTarget

  CleanupSchedulePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: HasSchedule
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt CleanupScheduleRule.Arn

Outputs:
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB throttle table
    Value: !Ref ThrottleTable

  CleanupLambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB cleanup Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBCleanupFunction.Arn

  CleanupScheduleRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge schedule rule (if enabled)
    Value: !If [HasSchedule, !GetAtt CleanupScheduleRule.Arn, 'Schedule Disabled']

Description: AWS CloudFormation template for IoT SiteWise wind farm and turbine asset models.

Resources:
  TurbineAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: WindTurbineAssetModel
      AssetModelDescription: Asset model representing an individual wind turbine.
      AssetModelProperties:
        # Attributes
        - LogicalId: TurbineSerialNumber
          Name: SerialNumber
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: UNKNOWN
        - LogicalId: TurbineCapacityKw
          Name: CapacityKw
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: '2000'
        - LogicalId: TurbineModel
          Name: Model
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: WT-2000X

        # Measurements
        - LogicalId: TurbineWindSpeed
          Name: WindSpeed
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: m/s
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - LogicalId: TurbineTorque
          Name: Torque
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kNm
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - LogicalId: TurbinePower
          Name: Power
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kW
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement

        # Transform: Overdrive State Transform (triggers 1 when torque > 3, else 0)
        - LogicalId: TurbineOverdriveState
          Name: OverdriveState
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type:
            TypeName: Transform
            Transform:
              Expression: if(torque > 3, 1, 0)
              Variables:
                - Name: torque
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbineTorque

        # Metrics: Computed over 5-minute tumbling window
        - LogicalId: TurbineAvgWindSpeed5m
          Name: AverageWindSpeed5m
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: m/s
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: avg(ws)
              Variables:
                - Name: ws
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbineWindSpeed
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - LogicalId: TurbineOverdriveStateTime5m
          Name: OverdriveStateTime5m
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: s
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: sum(overdrive) * 300
              Variables:
                - Name: overdrive
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbineOverdriveState
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - LogicalId: TurbineAvgPower5m
          Name: AveragePower5m
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kW
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: avg(power)
              Variables:
                - Name: power
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbinePower
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m

  WindFarmAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: WindFarmAssetModel
      AssetModelDescription: Asset model representing an entire wind farm containing multiple turbines.
      AssetModelHierarchies:
        - LogicalId: WindTurbinesHierarchy
          Name: Turbines
          ChildAssetModelId: !Ref TurbineAssetModel
      AssetModelProperties:
        # Attributes
        - LogicalId: FarmLocation
          Name: Location
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: Offshore Block A
        - LogicalId: FarmOperator
          Name: Operator
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: CleanEnergy Corp

        # Rollup Metrics: 5-minute tumbling window aggregated from child turbines
        - LogicalId: FarmTotalPower5m
          Name: TotalPower5m
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kW
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: sum(turbine_power)
              Variables:
                - Name: turbine_power
                  Value:
                    HierarchyLogicalId: WindTurbinesHierarchy
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbineAvgPower5m
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - LogicalId: FarmAvgWindSpeed5m
          Name: FarmAverageWindSpeed5m
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: m/s
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: avg(turbine_ws)
              Variables:
                - Name: turbine_ws
                  Value:
                    HierarchyLogicalId: WindTurbinesHierarchy
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbineAvgWindSpeed5m
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m

Outputs:
  TurbineAssetModelId:
    Description: The ID of the Turbine Asset Model.
    Value: !Ref TurbineAssetModel

  TurbineAssetModelArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Turbine Asset Model.
    Value: !GetAtt TurbineAssetModel.AssetModelArn

  WindFarmAssetModelId:
    Description: The ID of the Wind Farm Asset Model.
    Value: !Ref WindFarmAssetModel

    Description: The ARN of the Wind Farm Asset Model.
    Value: !GetAtt WindFarmAssetModel.AssetModelArn

  WindTurbinesHierarchyId:
    Description: The ID of the hierarchy linking child turbines to the wind farm model.
    Value: WindTurbinesHierarchy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Replicates CodeCommit repositories (card-service, rule-service, ecs-pipeline) to a target AWS region on mainline branch pushes using AWS CodeBuild and Amazon EventBridge.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-\d{1}$
    Description: Destination AWS region for CodeCommit repository replication.
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region format (e.g., us-east-1).

  BranchName:
    Type: String
    Default: mainline
    Description: Branch name to monitor and mirror to the destination region.

Resources:
  CodeBuildLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/codebuild/${AWS::StackName}-codecommit-replicator
      RetentionInDays: 30

  CodeBuildServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-codebuild-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeBuildLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub ${CodeBuildLogGroup.Arn}:*
        - PolicyName: CodeCommitReplicationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:GitPull
                  - codecommit:GitPush
                  - codecommit:GetBranch
                  - codecommit:CreateBranch
                  - codecommit:UpdateDefaultBranch
                  - codecommit:GetCommit
                  - codecommit:GetRepository
                  - codecommit:ListBranches
                  - codecommit:ListRepositories
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline

  CodeBuildProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-repo-replicator
      Description: Mirrors CodeCommit repositories to the target replica region using git-remote-codecommit
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildServiceRole.Arn
      TimeoutInMinutes: 30
      Artifacts:
        Type: NO_ARTIFACTS
      Environment:
        Type: LINUX_CONTAINER
        ComputeType: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
        Image: aws/codebuild/amazonlinux2-x86_64-standard:5.0
        EnvironmentVariables:
          - Name: SOURCE_REGION
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref AWS::Region
          - Name: TARGET_REGION
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref TargetRegion
          - Name: BRANCH_NAME
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref BranchName
          - Name: REPOSITORIES
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: card-service rule-service ecs-pipeline
      LogsConfig:
        CloudWatchLogs:
          Status: ENABLED
          GroupName: !Ref CodeBuildLogGroup
      Source:
        Type: NO_SOURCE
        BuildSpec: |
          version: 0.2
          phases:
            install:
              commands:
                - pip install --upgrade pip
                - pip install git-remote-codecommit
                - git config --global credential.helper '!aws codecommit credential-helper $@'
                - git config --global credential.UseHttpPath true
                - git config --global user.name "CodeBuild Replicator"
                - git config --global user.email "codebuild-replicator@noreply.aws.amazon.com"
            build:
              commands:
                - |
                  set -e
                  for REPO in $REPOSITORIES; do
                    echo "=========================================="
                    echo "Syncing repository: $REPO"
                    echo "Source: codecommit::${SOURCE_REGION}://${REPO}"
                    echo "Target: codecommit::${TARGET_REGION}://${REPO}"
                    echo "=========================================="
                    rm -rf "$REPO"
                    git clone --mirror "codecommit::${SOURCE_REGION}://${REPO}" "$REPO"
                    cd "$REPO"
                    git remote add target "codecommit::${TARGET_REGION}://${REPO}"
                    git push target --all --force
                    git push target --tags --force
                    cd ..
                    rm -rf "$REPO"
                    echo "Successfully mirrored $REPO to ${TARGET_REGION}"
                  done
            post_build:
              commands:
                - echo "CodeCommit replication completed successfully."

  EventBridgeInvocationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-events-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartCodeBuildExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                Resource: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn

  CodeCommitTriggerRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-codecommit-trigger
      Description: Triggers CodeBuild repository replication on pushes to the mainline branch
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          repositoryName:
            - card-service
            - rule-service
            - ecs-pipeline
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - !Ref BranchName
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
          Id: TargetCodeBuildProject
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvocationRole.Arn

Outputs:
  CodeBuildProjectName:
    Description: Name of the CodeBuild replication project
    Value: !Ref CodeBuildProject

  CodeBuildProjectArn:
    Description: ARN of the CodeBuild replication project
    Value: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn

  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge trigger rule
    Value: !GetAtt CodeCommitTriggerRule.Arn

  TargetReplicaRegion:
    Description: Destination region configured for CodeCommit mirroring
    Value: !Ref TargetRegion

      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  AccessLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDeliveryWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:

    DependsOn: AccessLogBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:

      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  ReplicaBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ReplicaBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

            Resource: !Sub '${ReplicaBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:

    Properties:

        Statement:

                  - s3:GetObjectVersionAcl

              - Sid: TargetBucketReplicationObjects

  PrimaryBucketPolicy:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CloudFormation template provisioning automation infrastructure for Aurora Global Database failover,
  including an SSM Automation Document, Secrets Manager secret, IAM roles, and a trigger Lambda function.

Parameters:
  PrimaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Primary AWS Region for the Aurora Global Database.
  SecondaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: Secondary AWS Region for the Aurora Global Database failover.
  GlobalClusterIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: my-global-aurora-cluster
    Description: Identifier of the Aurora Global Database cluster.

Resources:
  # Secrets Manager Secret storing the active writer endpoint
  AuroraWriterSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: aurora-global-db-active-writer
      Description: Stores the active Aurora Global Database writer endpoint.
      SecretString: '{"writer_endpoint":"initial-writer.cluster-custom.domain"}'

  # IAM Role assumed by SSM Automation during failover execution
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AuroraFailoverExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rds:FailoverGlobalCluster
                  - rds:DescribeGlobalClusters
                  - rds:DescribeDBClusters
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:DescribeRoutingControl
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:UpdateRoutingControlStates
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:ListRoutingControls
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:GetRoutingControlState
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref AuroraWriterSecret
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:*:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/*'

  # SSM Automation Document defining the failover workflow
  AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Orchestrates failover of an Aurora Global Database and Route 53 ARC routing controls.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
          PrimaryRegion:
            type: String
            description: Primary AWS Region.
            default: us-east-1
          SecondaryRegion:
            type: String
            description: Secondary AWS Region.
            default: us-west-2
          GlobalClusterIdentifier:
            type: String
            description: Identifier of the Global Aurora DB Cluster.
            default: my-global-aurora-cluster
          SecretArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the Secrets Manager Secret storing the writer endpoint.
        mainSteps:
          - name: determineActiveRegion
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
                GlobalClusterIdentifier: '{{ GlobalClusterIdentifier }}'
              Script: |
                def script_handler(events, context):
                    import boto3
                    global_cluster_id = events['GlobalClusterIdentifier']
                    primary_region = events['PrimaryRegion']
                    secondary_region = events['SecondaryRegion']

                    rds = boto3.client('rds', region_name=primary_region)
                    try:
                        resp = rds.describe_global_clusters(GlobalClusterIdentifier=global_cluster_id)
                        members = resp['GlobalClusters'][0].get('GlobalClusterMembers', [])
                        current_writer_arn = ''
                        for member in members:
                            if member.get('IsWriter', False):
                                current_writer_arn = member['DBClusterArn']
                                break
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"Error checking RDS writer: {str(e)}")
                        current_writer_arn = ''

                    target_region = secondary_region
                    print(f"Current writer cluster ARN: {current_writer_arn}, Target failover region: {target_region}")
                    return {'TargetRegion': target_region, 'CurrentWriterArn': current_writer_arn}
            outputs:
              - Name: TargetRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.TargetRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: CurrentWriterArn
                Selector: $.Payload.CurrentWriterArn
                Type: String

          - name: failoverGlobalCluster
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                GlobalClusterIdentifier: '{{ GlobalClusterIdentifier }}'
                TargetRegion: '{{ determineActiveRegion.TargetRegion }}'
              Script: |
                def script_handler(events, context):
                    import boto3
                    import time

                    global_cluster_id = events['GlobalClusterIdentifier']
                    target_region = events['TargetRegion']

                    rds_target = boto3.client('rds', region_name=target_region)
                    clusters = rds_target.describe_db_clusters()
                    target_cluster_arn = None
                    for c in clusters.get('DBClusters', []):
                        if c.get('GlobalWriteForwardingStatus') or global_cluster_id in c.get('DBClusterArn', ''):
                            target_cluster_arn = c['DBClusterArn']
                            break

                    if not target_cluster_arn and clusters.get('DBClusters'):
                        target_cluster_arn = clusters['DBClusters'][0]['DBClusterArn']

                    print(f"Failing over global cluster {global_cluster_id} to target DB cluster {target_cluster_arn}")
                    if target_cluster_arn:
                        try:
                            rds_target.failover_global_cluster(
                                GlobalClusterIdentifier=global_cluster_id,
                                TargetDbClusterIdentifier=target_cluster_arn
                            )
                        except Exception as ex:
                            print(f"Failover call warning/error: {str(ex)}")

                    return {'TargetClusterArn': target_cluster_arn or 'unknown'}
            outputs:
              - Name: TargetClusterArn
                Selector: $.Payload.TargetClusterArn
                Type: String

          - name: updateRoutingControlAndSecret
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                TargetRegion: '{{ determineActiveRegion.TargetRegion }}'
                SecretArn: '{{ SecretArn }}'
              Script: |
                def script_handler(events, context):
                    import boto3
                    import json

                    target_region = events['TargetRegion']
                    secret_arn = events['SecretArn']

                    rds = boto3.client('rds', region_name=target_region)
                    writer_endpoint = 'endpoint-updated'
                    try:
                        clusters = rds.describe_db_clusters()
                        if clusters.get('DBClusters'):
                            writer_endpoint = clusters['DBClusters'][0].get('Endpoint', writer_endpoint)
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"Error fetching cluster endpoint: {str(e)}")

                    sm = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
                    try:
                        sm.update_secret(
                            SecretId=secret_arn,
                            SecretString=json.dumps({'writer_endpoint': writer_endpoint, 'region': target_region})
                        )
                        print(f"Updated secret {secret_arn} with endpoint {writer_endpoint}")
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"Error updating secret: {str(e)}")

                    return {'WriterEndpoint': writer_endpoint}
            outputs:
              - Name: WriterEndpoint
                Selector: $.Payload.WriterEndpoint
                Type: String

  # IAM Role for Lambda function
  TriggerFailoverLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMAutomationExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn

  # Lambda function initiating SSM Automation
  TriggerFailover:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark compliant VPC Flow Logs automation solution.
  Creates a sample VPC, CloudWatch Logs log group, IAM delivery role, Systems Manager
  Automation execution role, direct remediation SSM document, and a Change Manager

Resources:
  SampleVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16

      EnableDnsSupport: true

  VpcFlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flow-logs-reject
      RetentionInDays: 365

  VpcFlowLogsDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

  EnableRejectFlowLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture for compliance with CIS Benchmark.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the VPC to enable Flow Logs on.
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            description: The name of the CloudWatch Log Group to deliver flow logs to.
            default: !Ref VpcFlowLogsLogGroup
          DeliverLogsPermissionArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role allowing VPC Flow Logs to deliver to CloudWatch.
            default: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SsmAutomationExecutionRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableRejectFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
                DeliverLogsPermissionArn: '{{ DeliverLogsPermissionArn }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    vpc_id = events['VpcId']
                    log_group_name = events['LogGroupName']
                    role_arn = events['DeliverLogsPermissionArn']

                    describe_response = ec2.describe_flow_logs(
                        Filter=[
                            {'Name': 'resource-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]},
                            {'Name': 'log-status', 'Values': ['ACTIVE']}
                        ]
                    )

                    for fl in describe_response.get('FlowLogs', []):
                        traffic_type = fl.get('TrafficType')
                        destination_type = fl.get('LogDestinationType')
                        log_group = fl.get('LogGroupName')
                        if traffic_type in ['REJECT', 'ALL'] and destination_type == 'cloud-watch-logs' and log_group == log_group_name:
                            return {
                                'Status': 'SKIPPED',
                                'Message': f'Active flow log already capturing {traffic_type} to {log_group_name}',
                                'FlowLogId': fl.get('FlowLogId')
                            }

                    create_response = ec2.create_flow_logs(
                        ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                        ResourceType='VPC',
                        TrafficType='REJECT',
                        LogDestinationType='cloud-watch-logs',
                        LogGroupName=log_group_name,
                        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=role_arn
                    )

                    flow_log_ids = create_response.get('FlowLogIds', [])
                    unsuccessful = create_response.get('Unsuccessful', [])
                    if unsuccessful:
                        error_msg = unsuccessful[0].get('Error', {}).get('Message', 'Unknown error')
                        raise Exception(f'Failed to create flow log: {error_msg}')

                    return {
                        'Status': 'CREATED',
                        'FlowLogIds': flow_log_ids
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: Response
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap

    Properties:

      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'

            inputs:

              RuntimeParameters:
                VpcId:
                  - '{{ VpcId }}'

                  - '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to create and manage an Amazon Route 53 Reusable Delegation Set using a Lambda-backed custom resource.

Parameters:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: ReusableDelegationSet
    Description: Name of the Lambda function that manages the reusable delegation set.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]
    Description: Retention period in days for the Lambda function CloudWatch logs.

Resources:
  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${LambdaFunctionName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Route53DelegationSetManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53:CreateReusableDelegationSet
                  - route53:DeleteReusableDelegationSet
                  - route53:GetReusableDelegationSet
                  - route53:ListReusableDelegationSets
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaLogGroup.Arn

  DelegationSetFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: LambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import hashlib
          import json
          import logging
          import socket
          import time
          import urllib.request
          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          route53 = boto3.client('route53')

          def send_response(event, context, status, response_data, physical_resource_id=None, reason=None):
              response_url = event['ResponseURL']
              response_body = {
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': reason or f"See CloudWatch Log Stream: {context.log_stream_name}",
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or event.get('PhysicalResourceId', context.log_stream_name),
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': response_data
              }
              json_data = json.dumps(response_body).encode('utf-8')
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  response_url,
                  data=json_data,
                  headers={'Content-Type': '', 'Content-Length': str(len(json_data))},
                  method='PUT'
              )
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                      logger.info(f"CloudFormation response status: {resp.status}")
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Failed sending response to CloudFormation: {e}")

          def resolve_ips(hostname):
              ipv4 = ''
              ipv6 = ''
              try:
                  results = socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, None, socket.AF_INET)
                  if results:
                      ipv4 = results[0][4][0]
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.warning(f"Could not resolve IPv4 for {hostname}: {e}")
              try:
                  results = socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, None, socket.AF_INET6)
                  if results:
                      ipv6 = results[0][4][0]
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.warning(f"Could not resolve IPv6 for {hostname}: {e}")
              return ipv4, ipv6

          def build_response_data(delegation_set_id, name_servers):
              clean_id = delegation_set_id.replace('/delegationset/', '')
              data = {
                  'DelegationSetId': clean_id,
                  'NameServers': name_servers
              }
              for i in range(4):
                  idx = i + 1
                  if i < len(name_servers):
                      ns = name_servers[i]
                      ipv4, ipv6 = resolve_ips(ns)
                      data[f'NameServer{idx}'] = ns
                      data[f'NameServer{idx}IPv4'] = ipv4
                      data[f'NameServer{idx}IPv6'] = ipv6
                  else:
                      data[f'NameServer{idx}'] = ''
                      data[f'NameServer{idx}IPv4'] = ''
                      data[f'NameServer{idx}IPv6'] = ''
              return data

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Received event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              response_data = {}
              physical_resource_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')

              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      unique_seed = f"{event.get('StackId', '')}-{event.get('LogicalResourceId', '')}-{event.get('RequestId', '')}-{time.time()}"
                      caller_reference = hashlib.sha256(unique_seed.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:32]
                      resp = route53.create_reusable_delegation_set(
                          CallerReference=caller_reference
                      )
                      delegation_set = resp['DelegationSet']
                      ds_id = delegation_set['Id'].replace('/delegationset/', '')
                      physical_resource_id = ds_id
                      name_servers = delegation_set.get('NameServers', [])
                      response_data = build_response_data(ds_id, name_servers)
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', response_data, physical_resource_id)
                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      ds_id = physical_resource_id
                      resp = route53.get_reusable_delegation_set(Id=ds_id)
                      delegation_set = resp['DelegationSet']
                      name_servers = delegation_set.get('NameServers', [])
                      response_data = build_response_data(ds_id, name_servers)
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', response_data, physical_resource_id)
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      if physical_resource_id:
                          try:
                              route53.delete_reusable_delegation_set(Id=physical_resource_id)
                              logger.info(f"Deleted delegation set {physical_resource_id}")
                          except route53.exceptions.NoSuchDelegationSet:
                              logger.info(f"Delegation set {physical_resource_id} does not exist.")
                          except Exception as e:
                              logger.warning(f"Error deleting delegation set: {e}")
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_resource_id)
                  else:
                      send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {}, physical_resource_id, f"Unknown RequestType: {request_type}")
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.exception(f"Handler execution failed: {e}")
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {}, physical_resource_id, str(e))

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless WebSocket API with API Gateway triggering Step Functions and responding back via API Gateway Management API.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    Description: The name of the WebSocket API deployment stage.

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # IAM Roles
  # ============================================================================
  ApiGatewayStepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStepFunctionsExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt ProcessMessageStateMachine.Arn

  ResponseLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaBasicLogsAndManageConnections
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/POST/@connections/*'

  StepFunctionsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeResponseLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt SendResponseLambda.Arn
                  - !Sub '${SendResponseLambda.Arn}:*'

  # ============================================================================
  # Lambda Function (WebSocket Response Handler)
  # ============================================================================
  SendResponseLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SendResponseLambda'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt ResponseLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 15
      Environment:
        Variables:
          API_ENDPOINT: !Sub 'https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          api_endpoint = os.environ['API_ENDPOINT']
          client = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=api_endpoint)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event.get('connectionId')
              message = event.get('message')
              entered_time = event.get('enteredTime', '')

              response_data = {
                  'status': 'COMPLETED',
                  'originalMessage': message,
                  'processedAt': entered_time
              }

              try:
                  client.post_to_connection(
                      ConnectionId=connection_id,
                      Data=json.dumps(response_data).encode('utf-8')
                  )
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Message sent'}
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error sending message to {connection_id}: {str(e)}")
                  raise e

  # ============================================================================
  # Step Functions State Machine
  # ============================================================================
  ProcessMessageStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Process WebSocket message after delay and respond back to client via Lambda",
          "StartAt": "WaitForFiveSeconds",
          "States": {
            "WaitForFiveSeconds": {
              "Type": "Wait",
              "Seconds": 5,
              "Next": "SendResponseToClient"
            },
            "SendResponseToClient": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke",
              "Parameters": {
                "FunctionName": "${SendResponseLambda.Arn}",
                "Payload": {
                  "connectionId.$": "$.connectionId",
                  "message.$": "$.message",
                  "enteredTime.$": "$$.State.EnteredTime"
                }
              },
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

  # ============================================================================
  # API Gateway V2 (WebSocket API)
  # ============================================================================
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebSocketApi'
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'

  # Connect Route & Integration (Mock)
  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: MOCK
      PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
      RequestTemplates:
        application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
      TemplateSelectionExpression: \$default

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ConnectIntegration}'

  ConnectRouteResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::RouteResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteId: !Ref ConnectRoute
      RouteResponseKey: $default

  ConnectIntegrationResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::IntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationId: !Ref ConnectIntegration
      IntegrationResponseKey: /200/
      TemplateSelectionExpression: \$default

  # Disconnect Route & Integration (Mock)
  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: MOCK
      PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
      RequestTemplates:
        application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
      TemplateSelectionExpression: \$default

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}'

  DisconnectRouteResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::RouteResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteId: !Ref DisconnectRoute
      RouteResponseKey: $default

  DisconnectIntegrationResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::IntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationId: !Ref DisconnectIntegration
      IntegrationResponseKey: /200/
      TemplateSelectionExpression: \$default

  # Default Route & Step Functions Integration
  StartExecutionIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayStepFunctionsRole.Arn
      PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
      RequestTemplates:
        application/json: !Sub
          - |
            #set($rawInput = $request.body)
            #set($escapedInput = $util.escapeJavaScript($rawInput))
            {
              "input": "{\"connectionId\": \"$context.connectionId\", \"message\": \"$escapedInput\"}",
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachineArn}"
            }
          - StateMachineArn: !GetAtt ProcessMessageStateMachine.Arn
      TemplateSelectionExpression: \$default

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${StartExecutionIntegration}'

  DefaultRouteResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::RouteResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteId: !Ref DefaultRoute
      RouteResponseKey: $default

  StartExecutionIntegrationResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::IntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationId: !Ref StartExecutionIntegration
      IntegrationResponseKey: /200/
      TemplateSelectionExpression: \$default

  # Deployment & Stage
  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - ConnectRouteResponse
      - ConnectIntegrationResponse
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DisconnectRouteResponse
      - DisconnectIntegrationResponse
      - DefaultRoute
      - DefaultRouteResponse
      - StartExecutionIntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
      AutoDeploy: false

Outputs:
  WebSocketApiId:
    Description: The ID of the WebSocket API.
    Value: !Ref WebSocketApi

  WebSocketUrl:
    Description: The WSS URL for WebSocket client connections.
    Value: !Sub 'wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'

  WebSocketManagementApiEndpoint:
    Description: The callback URL used to send messages to connected clients via API Gateway Management API.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'

  StateMachineArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Step Functions State Machine.
    Value: !GetAtt ProcessMessageStateMachine.Arn

  ResponseLambdaArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Lambda Function that sends responses via API Gateway Management API.
    Value: !GetAtt SendResponseLambda.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS Cost Management stack with monthly budget, KMS-encrypted SNS topic, and budget alert notifications.

Parameters:
  MonthlyBudgetLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 100
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Monthly budget limit in USD.
  NotificationProtocol:
    Type: String
    Default: sms
    AllowedValues:
      - sms
      - email
    Description: Notification protocol for budget alerts (sms or email).
  NotificationEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: '+61400000000'
    Description: Notification endpoint (phone number with country code e.g., +61400000000 or email address).

Resources:
  BillingTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS customer managed key for encrypting billing and budget SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: billing-topic-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsToGenerateDataKeyAndDecrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:budgets::${AWS::AccountId}:budget/*'

  BillingTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/billing-topic-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BillingTopicKey

  BillingNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-billing-notifications'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref BillingTopicKey

  BillingTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref BillingNotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: BillingTopicPolicy
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref BillingNotificationTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:budgets::${AWS::AccountId}:budget/*'

  BillingNotificationSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEndpoint
      Protocol: !Ref NotificationProtocol
      TopicArn: !Ref BillingNotificationTopic

  MonthlyCostBudget:
    Type: AWS::Budgets::Budget
    DependsOn: BillingTopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Budget:
        BudgetName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Monthly-Cost-Budget'
        BudgetType: COST
        TimeUnit: MONTHLY
        BudgetLimit:
          Amount: !Ref MonthlyBudgetLimit
          Unit: USD
      NotificationsWithSubscribers:
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 80
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: SNS
              Address: !Ref BillingNotificationTopic
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 99
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: SNS
              Address: !Ref BillingNotificationTopic

  BudgetName:

    Value: !Ref MonthlyCostBudget
  SnsTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS-encrypted SNS topic for budget notifications
    Value: !Ref BillingNotificationTopic
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS Key used to encrypt the SNS topic
    Value: !GetAtt BillingTopicKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito authentication and authorization infrastructure for Ontology Lookup Service with SSM Parameter Store integration.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: ontology-lookup-service
    Description: Application name used for resource naming and SSM parameter paths.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: OLSGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      MfaConfiguration: 'ON'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${AppName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: !Sub 'https://${AppName}.api'
      Name: !Sub '${AppName}-resource-server'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to ontology service

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AppName}-m2m-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub 'https://${AppName}.api/read'
      ExplicitAuthFlows: []
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/cognito/user-pool-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID

  SSMClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/cognito/client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
      Description: Cognito App Client ID for machine-to-machine authentication

  SSMClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/cognito/client-secret'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UserPoolClient.ClientSecret
      Description: Cognito App Client Secret for machine-to-machine authentication

  SSMDomain:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/cognito/domain'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${AppName}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Description: Cognito Hosted Auth Domain FQDN

  SSMTokenUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/cognito/token-url'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${AppName}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Description: OAuth2 Token Endpoint URL

  SSMDiscoveryUrl:
