final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice with private Cloud Map service discovery, custom VPC, NAT Gateway, and CloudWatch alarm-based step auto scaling.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Name of the environment (e.g. production, staging, dev)

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: web-service
    Description: Name of the microservice

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:latest
    Description: Docker container image URI to run

  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: Port exposed by the container

  TaskCpu:
    Type: String
    Default: '256'
    AllowedValues:
      - '256'
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '4096'
    Description: CPU units for the Fargate task (256 = 0.25 vCPU)

  TaskMemory:
    Type: String
    Default: '512'
    AllowedValues:
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '3072'
      - '4096'
      - '8192'
    Description: Memory in MiB for the Fargate task

  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Desired number of ECS tasks to run

  CustomTaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional ARN of an existing IAM role for tasks to assume to access AWS resources

Conditions:
  HasCustomTaskRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTaskRoleArn, '']]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-subnet'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-gw'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-2'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-rt'

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS Fargate containers
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow incoming traffic on container port from VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 0
          ToPort: 65535
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/1
          Description: Allow outbound TCP traffic to lower half IPv4 space via NAT Gateway
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 0
          ToPort: 65535
          CidrIp: 128.0.0.0/1
          Description: Allow outbound TCP traffic to upper half IPv4 space via NAT Gateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-container-sg'

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-exec-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

  PrivateDnsNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.local'
      Description: Private DNS namespace for microservice discovery
      Vpc: !Ref VPC

  DiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      Description: Cloud Map service for discovering the microservice
      NamespaceId: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task'
      Cpu: !Ref TaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref TaskMemory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If [HasCustomTaskRole, !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs

  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - PrivateDefaultRoute
      - PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation
      - PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort

  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 2
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${ECSCluster}/${ECSService.Name}'
      RoleARN: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/ecs.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForApplicationAutoScaling_ECSService'
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs

  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-out'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        Cooldown: 60
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: 2

  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-in'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        Cooldown: 60
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  CPUUtilizationHighAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-high'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm to scale out ECS service when CPU utilization is >= 70%
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleOutPolicy

  CPUUtilizationLowAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-low'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm to scale in ECS service when CPU utilization is <= 20%
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleInPolicy

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: Public Subnet ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  ECSClusterName:
    Description: ECS Cluster Name
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster

  ECSServiceName:
    Description: ECS Service Name
    Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name

  CloudMapNamespaceName:
    Description: Private Cloud Map DNS Namespace Name
    Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.local'

  CloudMapNamespaceArn:
    Description: Private Cloud Map DNS Namespace ARN
    Value: !GetAtt PrivateDnsNamespace.Arn

  DiscoveryServiceArn:
    Description: Cloud Map Service ARN
    Value: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn

  DiscoveryDnsName:
    Description: FQDN for discovering this service via DNS SRV queries
    Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}.local'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS hybrid network backbone designed for OCI interconnect demonstrations, including VPC, IGW, TGW, Flow Logs with KMS, and optional Site-to-Site VPN to OCI.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.94.0.0/16'
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.94.10.0/24'
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    Description: CIDR block for the subnet in the first availability zone.

  InternalInboundCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/8'
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    Description: CIDR range allowed for inbound HTTPS traffic to the demonstration security group.

  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.100.0.0/16'
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    Description: CIDR block representing the OCI primary region backbone network.

  EnableOciVpn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to 'true' to deploy the Customer Gateway and Site-to-Site VPN Connection to OCI.

  OciCgwIpAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: '203.0.113.10'
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$'
    Description: Public IP address of the OCI Customer Gateway (used if EnableOciVpn is true).

  TransitGatewayAmazonSideAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534
    Description: Private Autonomous System Number (ASN) for the Transit Gateway.

  OciBgpAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 65000
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 4294967295
    Description: BGP ASN for the OCI Customer Gateway.

Conditions:
  CreateOciVpnCondition: !Equals [!Ref EnableOciVpn, 'true']

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting VPC Flow Logs in CloudWatch Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flow-logs*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/vpc-flow-logs-hybrid-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flow-logs-${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  DefaultInternetRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  HybridDemoSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for hybrid interconnect demo restricted to HTTPS
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalInboundCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS inbound from configurable internal CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS outbound strictly to OCI backbone CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-demo-sg'

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayAmazonSideAsn
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw'

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-rt'

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-vpc-attachment'

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachmentRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  OciCustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateOciVpnCondition
    Properties:
      BgpAsn: !Ref OciBgpAsn
      IpAddress: !Ref OciCgwIpAddress
      Type: ipsec.1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-oci-cgw'

  OciVpnConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateOciVpnCondition
    Properties:
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref OciCustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Type: ipsec.1
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-oci-vpn'

  TransitGatewayVpnAttachmentRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateOciVpnCondition
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref OciVpnConnection
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  TgwRouteToOci:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Condition: CreateOciVpnCondition
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref OciVpnConnection

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref Vpc

  SubnetId:
    Description: The ID of the subnet
    Value: !Ref Subnet

  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: The ID of the hybrid demo security group
    Value: !Ref HybridDemoSecurityGroup

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: The ID of the Transit Gateway
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway

  TransitGatewayRouteTableId:
    Description: The route table ID of the Transit Gateway
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  CustomerGatewayId:
    Condition: CreateOciVpnCondition
    Description: The ID of the Customer Gateway for OCI
    Value: !Ref OciCustomerGateway

  VpnConnectionId:
    Condition: CreateOciVpnCondition
    Description: The ID of the VPN Connection to OCI
    Value: !Ref OciVpnConnection

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: The ARN of the KMS key used for CloudWatch Logs encryption
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CloudFormation template provisioning self-contained infrastructure for a QuickSight
  Admin Console data preparation pipeline, including a KMS-encrypted S3 bucket,
  an IAM execution role with scoped S3 and KMS permissions, five Glue jobs (3 Python Shell
  and 2 Glue ETL), and five 3-hour scheduled triggers.

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: qs-admin-console
    Description: Prefix to apply to project resources for identification.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9-_]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

  CloudTrailGlueTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: qs_admin_cloudtrail_logs
    Description: Name of the Glue Data Catalog table storing CloudTrail audit logs for downstream consumption.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

Resources:
  DataBucketKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer Managed Key for QuickSight Admin Console S3 Bucket Encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceKeyUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  DataBucketKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectPrefix}-bucket-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataBucketKmsKey

  DataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-data-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataBucketKmsKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: CleanIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7

  DataBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref DataBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTlsRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt DataBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${DataBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-glue-service-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightAdminConsoleExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightFullAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: IAMFullAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchAndLogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - logs:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3BucketLevelAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket

                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads

              - Sid: S3ObjectLevelAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload

              - Sid: GlueFullAccess

        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${DataBucket}/scripts/object_access.py'
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Complete EC2 Image Builder pipeline for custom ECS-optimized AMIs with Chef integration, lifecycle management, and custom build workflow.

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-custom-ami
    Description: Name prefix used for identifying pipeline resources and tagging AMIs.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Target AWS Region to distribute the resulting custom AMI.

  PipelineScheduleCron:
    Type: String
    Default: cron(0 0 * * ? *)
    Description: Cron expression determining how often the Image Builder pipeline triggers.

  LifecycleAgeDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3650
    Description: Number of days after which built AMIs and associated snapshots are deprecated and deleted.

  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 50
    MinValue: 30
    MaxValue: 1000
    Description: Size of the root EBS volume in GiB for the ECS-optimized parent image.

Resources:
  ArtifactKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting Image Builder artifacts and build logs in S3.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderAndEC2Usage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
              Service:
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: '*'

  ArtifactKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ApplicationName}-artifacts-${AWS::Region}
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ArtifactKey

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub ${ApplicationName}-artifacts-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceSecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub ${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ApplicationName}-imagebuilder-instance-role-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ArtifactBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BucketReadWriteAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub ${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*
              - Sid: KMSKeyAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub ${ApplicationName}-instance-profile-${AWS::Region}
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderLifecycleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ApplicationName}-imagebuilder-lifecycle-role-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageLifecycleManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageAMIsAndSnapshots
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
                  - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - imagebuilder:DeleteImage
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                  - imagebuilder:ListImages
                Resource: '*'

  ImagePipelineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ApplicationName}-imagebuilder-execution-role-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderWorkflowExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EC2ExecutionPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassRoleToInstanceRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInstanceRole.Arn
              - Sid: SSMExecutionPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                  - ssm:GetCommandInvocation
                  - ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ImageBuilderPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:GetComponent
                  - imagebuilder:GetWorkflow
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3LoggingAndArtifactPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub ${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*
              - Sid: KMSAccessPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn

  UpdateSSMAndMetadataComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ApplicationName}-update-ssm-metadata-component
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Updates Amazon SSM Agent and collects system metadata prior to image creation.
      Data: |
        name: UpdateSSMAndMetadataComponent
        description: Updates SSM Agent and gathers instance metadata
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSSMAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - echo "Updating Amazon SSM Agent to latest version..."
                    - yum install -y https://s3.amazonaws.com/ec2-downloads-windows/SSMAgent/latest/linux_amd64/amazon-ssm-agent.rpm || systemctl restart amazon-ssm-agent
                    - systemctl status amazon-ssm-agent || true
              - name: CollectMetadata
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - mkdir -p /var/log/imagebuilder
                    - echo "Collecting AMI metadata..." > /var/log/imagebuilder/build_metadata.txt
                    - date -u >> /var/log/imagebuilder/build_metadata.txt
                    - uname -a >> /var/log/imagebuilder/build_metadata.txt
                    - cat /etc/os-release >> /var/log/imagebuilder/build_metadata.txt
                    - ecs-agent --version >> /var/log/imagebuilder/build_metadata.txt || true
                    - docker --version >> /var/log/imagebuilder/build_metadata.txt || true

  ChefRecipeComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ApplicationName}-chef-recipe-component
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Component to download and execute Chef recipes for system configuration.
      Data: !Sub |
        name: ChefRecipeComponent
        description: Downloads and executes Chef recipes from S3
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallChef
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      if ! command -v chef-solo &> /dev/null; then
                        echo "Installing Chef Solo / Cinc client..."
                        curl -L https://omnitruck.cinc.sh/install.sh | sudo bash || curl -L https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh | sudo bash
                      fi
              - name: DownloadAndRunChefRecipe
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      mkdir -p /opt/chef-recipes
                      echo "Checking for recipes in S3 bucket: ${ArtifactBucket}"
                      aws s3 cp s3://${ArtifactBucket}/cookbooks.tar.gz /opt/chef-recipes/cookbooks.tar.gz || true
                      if [ -f /opt/chef-recipes/cookbooks.tar.gz ]; then
                        tar -xzf /opt/chef-recipes/cookbooks.tar.gz -C /opt/chef-recipes/
                        echo "Running Chef Solo execution..."
                        chef-solo -c /opt/chef-recipes/solo.rb -j /opt/chef-recipes/dna.json
                      else
                        echo "No cookbooks found; creating default run-list baseline."
                        mkdir -p /opt/chef-recipes/cookbooks/baseline/recipes
                        cat << 'EOF' > /opt/chef-recipes/solo.rb
                        cookbook_path '/opt/chef-recipes/cookbooks'
                        EOF
                        cat << 'EOF' > /opt/chef-recipes/cookbooks/baseline/recipes/default.rb
                        package 'jq' do
                          action :install
                        end
                        package 'amazon-efs-utils' do
                          action :install
                        end
                        EOF
                        cat << 'EOF' > /opt/chef-recipes/dna.json
                        {"run_list": ["recipe[baseline]"]}
                        EOF
                        chef-solo -c /opt/chef-recipes/solo.rb -j /opt/chef-recipes/dna.json
                      fi

  CustomBuildWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ApplicationName}-build-workflow
      Version: 1.0.1
      Type: BUILD
      Description: Custom workflow to launch instances, execute build components, collect metadata, create AMIs, and clean up.
      Data: |
        name: CustomBuildWorkflow
        description: Workflow that orchestrates instance launch, component execution, metadata collection, and AMI creation
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        steps:
          - name: LaunchBuildInstance
            action: LaunchInstance
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              waitFor: "ssmAgent"
          - name: WaitForSSMAgent
            action: WaitForSSMAgent
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: ExecuteComponents
            action: ExecuteComponents
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: CollectImageMetadata
            action: CollectImageMetadata
            onFailure: Continue
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: CreateImage
            action: CreateImage
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: TerminateBuildInstance
            action: TerminateInstance
            onFailure: Continue
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
        outputs:
          - name: ImageId
            value: "$.stepOutputs.CreateImage.imageId"

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ApplicationName}-recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Recipe based on AL2 ECS-optimized AMI with custom root volume, SSM/metadata updates, and Chef component.
      ParentImage: !Sub ssm:/aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt UpdateSSMAndMetadataComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt ChefRecipeComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration

      - dev

      - prod

        - AttributeName: USER_ID

      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName

      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: S3 Access Point content-level PII classification scanner using Amazon Comprehend, DynamoDB, and optional VPC endpoints.

Parameters:
  AccessPointArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional ARN of an existing S3 Access Point to scan. If left blank, a default S3 bucket and Access Point will be created automatically.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:s3:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:accesspoint/[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid S3 Access Point ARN.

  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional VPC ID. Required only if the target S3 Access Point has a VPC network origin.

  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional comma-delimited list of VPC Subnet IDs for Lambda and Interface VPC Endpoints.

  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional Security Group ID for Lambda and Interface VPC Endpoints.

  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional comma-delimited list of Route Table IDs for the S3 Gateway VPC Endpoint.

  CreateVpcEndpoints:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create VPC Endpoints (S3, DynamoDB, Comprehend, SNS) if VpcId is provided. Set to false if VPC already has them.

  MemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: Memory size in MB for the Lambda scanner function.

  Timeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 10
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Timeout in seconds for the Lambda scanner function.

  ComprehendLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: 'en'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'en'
      - 'es'
      - 'fr'
      - 'de'
      - 'it'
      - 'pt'
      - 'ar'
      - 'hi'
      - 'ja'
      - 'ko'
      - 'zh'
      - 'zh-TW'
    Description: Default language code for Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities.

  MaxFilesPerInvocation:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10000
    Description: Maximum number of files to inspect per single Lambda invocation.

  OptionalNotificationTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional SNS Topic ARN for receiving scan completion notifications and alerts.

Conditions:
  HasAccessPointArn: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AccessPointArn, '']]
  CreateDefaultAccessPoint: !Not [!Condition HasAccessPointArn]
  IsVpcEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
  ShouldCreateVpcEndpoints: !And
    - !Condition IsVpcEnabled
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateVpcEndpoints, 'true']
  HasNotificationTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OptionalNotificationTopicArn, '']]

Resources:
  DefaultScanBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateDefaultAccessPoint
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Customer Managed Key for encrypting the default scan bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: default-scan-bucket-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3AndLambdaUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - s3.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: '*'

  DefaultScanBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateDefaultAccessPoint
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/default-scan-bucket-key-${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DefaultScanBucketKey

  DefaultScanBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: CreateDefaultAccessPoint
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DefaultScanBucketKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  DefaultScanAccessPoint:
    Type: AWS::S3::AccessPoint
    Condition: CreateDefaultAccessPoint
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref DefaultScanBucket
      Name: !Sub 'scan-ap-${AWS::StackName}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  ScanReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: AccessPointArn
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: ScanTimestampAndObjectKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: AccessPointArn
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: ScanTimestampAndObjectKey
          KeyType: RANGE
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateVpcEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds

  DynamoDBInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateVpcEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: false

  ComprehendInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateVpcEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SNSInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateVpcEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  ScannerLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiiScannerExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !If
                    - HasAccessPointArn
                    - !Ref AccessPointArn
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${DefaultScanAccessPoint}'
                  - !If
                    - HasAccessPointArn
                    - !Sub '${AccessPointArn}/object/*'
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${DefaultScanAccessPoint}/object/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateDefaultAccessPoint
                  - !GetAtt DefaultScanBucketKey.Arn
                  - '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ScanReportTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !If
                  - HasNotificationTopic
                  - !Ref OptionalNotificationTopicArn
                  - '*'

  ScannerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerLambdaRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref MemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref Timeout
      VpcConfig: !If
        - IsVpcEnabled
        - SecurityGroupIds:
            - !Ref SecurityGroupId
          SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !If
            - HasAccessPointArn
            - !Ref AccessPointArn
            - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${DefaultScanAccessPoint}'
          REPORT_TABLE_NAME: !Ref ScanReportTable
          LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref ComprehendLanguageCode
          MAX_FILES_PER_INVOCATION: !Ref MaxFilesPerInvocation
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref OptionalNotificationTopicArn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import datetime
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          s3_client = boto3.client('s3')
          comprehend_client = boto3.client('comprehend')
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          sns_client = boto3.client('sns')

          ACCESS_POINT_ARN = os.environ.get('ACCESS_POINT_ARN')
          REPORT_TABLE_NAME = os.environ.get('REPORT_TABLE_NAME')
          DEFAULT_LANGUAGE = os.environ.get('LANGUAGE_CODE', 'en')
          MAX_FILES = int(os.environ.get('MAX_FILES_PER_INVOCATION', '500'))
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN = os.environ.get('SNS_TOPIC_ARN', '')

          CHUNK_BYTE_SIZE = 95 * 1024

          def chunk_text_by_bytes(text, max_bytes):
              encoded = text.encode('utf-8')
              for i in range(0, len(encoded), max_bytes):
                  yield encoded[i:i + max_bytes].decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              prefix = event.get('prefix', '')
              language_code = event.get('language_code', DEFAULT_LANGUAGE)
              max_files = int(event.get('max_files', MAX_FILES))

              table = dynamodb.Table(REPORT_TABLE_NAME)
              scan_start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

              scanned_count = 0
              pii_found_count = 0
              summary_records = []

              paginator = s3_client.get_paginator('list_objects_v2')
              page_iterator = paginator.paginate(
                  Bucket=ACCESS_POINT_ARN,
                  Prefix=prefix
              )

              for page in page_iterator:
                  for obj in page.get('Contents', []):
                      if scanned_count >= max_files:
                          break

                      key = obj['Key']
                      file_size = obj.get('Size', 0)

                      if key.endswith('/') or file_size == 0:
                          continue

                      scanned_count += 1
                      detected_entities = {}
                      total_entities = 0

                      try:
                          s3_response = s3_client.get_object(
                              Bucket=ACCESS_POINT_ARN,
                              Key=key
                          )
                          content = s3_response['Body'].read().decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')

                          for chunk in chunk_text_by_bytes(content, CHUNK_BYTE_SIZE):
                              if not chunk.strip():
                                  continue
                              comp_response = comprehend_client.detect_pii_entities(
                                  Text=chunk,
                                  LanguageCode=language_code
                              )
                              for entity in comp_response.get('Entities', []):
                                  etype = entity['Type']
                                  detected_entities[etype] = detected_entities.get(etype, 0) + 1
                                  total_entities += 1

                      except ClientError as e:
                          detected_entities['ERROR'] = str(e)
                      except Exception as e:
                          detected_entities['ERROR'] = str(e)

                      if total_entities > 0:
                          pii_found_count += 1

                      now_iso = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
                      sort_key = f"{now_iso}#{key}"

                      item = {
                          'AccessPointArn': ACCESS_POINT_ARN,
                          'ScanTimestampAndObjectKey': sort_key,
                          'ScanTimestamp': now_iso,
                          'ObjectKey': key,
                          'ObjectSizeBytes': file_size,
                          'TotalPiiEntities': total_entities,
                          'PiiBreakdown': detected_entities,
                          'PiiDetected': total_entities > 0
                      }
                      table.put_item(Item=item)
                      summary_records.append({'key': key, 'pii_count': total_entities})

                  if scanned_count >= max_files:
                      break

              scan_end = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
              report_summary = {
                  'AccessPointArn': ACCESS_POINT_ARN,
                  'ScanStart': scan_start,
                  'ScanEnd': scan_end,
                  'FilesScanned': scanned_count,
                  'FilesWithPii': pii_found_count
              }

              if SNS_TOPIC_ARN:
                  try:
                      sns_client.publish(
                          TopicArn=SNS_TOPIC_ARN,
                          Subject=f"PII Classification Complete: {pii_found_count} files with sensitive data",
                          Message=json.dumps(report_summary, indent=2)
                      )
                  except Exception as err:
                      print(f"Failed to publish SNS message: {err}")

              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': report_summary
              }

    Value: !If

      - !Ref AccessPointArn
      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${DefaultScanAccessPoint}'

    Description: Example AWS CLI command to execute the scanner function.
    Value: !Sub 'aws lambda invoke --function-name ${ScannerFunction} --payload "{\"prefix\":\"\"}" response.json'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS Glue Data Catalog databases and tables for LPG and RDF graph representations with Air-Routes ontology integration.

Parameters:
  LpgDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database
    Description: Name of the AWS Glue database for Labeled Property Graph (LPG) tables.
  RdfDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database-rdf
    Description: Name of the AWS Glue database for RDF tables.

Resources:
  GraphStorageKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer Managed Key for Graph Storage S3 Bucket Encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'

  GraphStorageKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/graph-storage-s3-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref GraphStorageKmsKey

  GraphStorageBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt GraphStorageKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  LpgGlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref LpgDatabaseName
        Description: Glue catalog database for Labeled Property Graph (LPG) entities.

  RdfGlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref RdfDatabaseName
        Description: Glue catalog database for Resource Description Framework (RDF) entities.

  AirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LpgGlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport
        Description: LPG vertex table for airports.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          typeOfData: file
          graph-type: vertex
          graph-label: airport
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub s3://${GraphStorageBucket}/lpg/airport/
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          Compressed: false
          NumberOfBuckets: -1
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
              Comment: Unique vertex identifier
            - Name: code
              Type: string
              Comment: IATA 3-letter airport code
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
              Comment: ICAO 4-letter airport code
            - Name: city
              Type: string
              Comment: City name
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
              Comment: Full airport description
            - Name: region
              Type: string
              Comment: Region code
            - Name: country
              Type: string
              Comment: Country 2-letter code
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
              Comment: Latitude coordinate
            - Name: lon
              Type: double
              Comment: Longitude coordinate
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
              Comment: Elevation in feet

  CountryTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LpgGlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: country
        Description: LPG vertex table for countries.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          typeOfData: file
          graph-type: vertex
          graph-label: country
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub s3://${GraphStorageBucket}/lpg/country/
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          Compressed: false
          NumberOfBuckets: -1
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
              Comment: Unique vertex identifier
            - Name: code
              Type: string
              Comment: Country ISO code
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
              Comment: Country name

  ContinentTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LpgGlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: continent
        Description: LPG vertex table for continents.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          typeOfData: file
          graph-type: vertex
          graph-label: continent
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub s3://${GraphStorageBucket}/lpg/continent/
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          Compressed: false
          NumberOfBuckets: -1
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
              Comment: Unique vertex identifier
            - Name: code
              Type: string
              Comment: Continent code
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
              Comment: Continent name

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LpgGlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route
        Description: LPG edge table for flight routes connecting airports.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          typeOfData: file
          graph-type: edge
          graph-label: route
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub s3://${GraphStorageBucket}/lpg/route/
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          Compressed: false
          NumberOfBuckets: -1
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
              Comment: Unique edge identifier
            - Name: from
              Type: string
              Comment: Outgoing vertex identifier
            - Name: to
              Type: string
              Comment: Incoming vertex identifier
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
              Comment: Flight distance in miles

  CustomAirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LpgGlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: customairport
        Description: LPG graph view executing a Gremlin traversal for up to 10 routes.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          typeOfData: file
          graph-type: view
          graph-label: customairport
          gremlin-query: g.V().hasLabel('airport').outE('route').limit(10).project('from','to').by(outV().values('code')).by(inV().values('code'))
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub s3://${GraphStorageBucket}/lpg/customairport/
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          Compressed: false
          NumberOfBuckets: -1
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: from
              Type: string
              Comment: Source airport IATA code
            - Name: to
              Type: string
              Comment: Destination airport IATA code

  AirportRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RdfGlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport_rdf
        Description: RDF table for airports mapped to class:Airport with prefix stripping.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          typeOfData: file
          rdf-type: 'true'
          strip-uri-prefixes: 'true'
          querymode: class
          classuri: class:Airport
          prefix.class: http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/class/
          prefix.prop: http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/
          prefix.obj: http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub s3://${GraphStorageBucket}/rdf/airport_rdf/
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          Compressed: false
          NumberOfBuckets: -1
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
              Comment: Unique subject URI or identifier
            - Name: code
              Type: string
              Comment: IATA 3-letter airport code
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
              Comment: ICAO 4-letter airport code
            - Name: city
              Type: string
              Comment: City name
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
              Comment: Full airport description
            - Name: region
              Type: string
              Comment: Region code
            - Name: country
              Type: string
              Comment: Country 2-letter code
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
              Comment: Latitude coordinate
            - Name: lon
              Type: double
              Comment: Longitude coordinate
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
              Comment: Elevation in feet

  RouteRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RdfGlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf
        Description: RDF table querying routes via SPARQL with declared URI prefixes.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          typeOfData: file
          rdf-type: 'true'
          strip-uri-prefixes: 'true'
          querymode: sparql
          prefix.class: http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/class/
          prefix.prop: http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/
          prefix.obj: http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/
          sparql-query: |
            PREFIX prop: <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/>
            PREFIX obj: <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/>
            SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist
            WHERE {
              ?src obj:route ?dest .
              ?src prop:code ?incode .
              ?dest prop:code ?outcode .
              ?src prop:dist ?dist .
            }
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub s3://${GraphStorageBucket}/rdf/route_rdf/
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          Compressed: false
          NumberOfBuckets: -1
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
              Comment: Inbound source airport code
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
              Comment: Outbound destination airport code
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
              Comment: Route distance

  RouteRdfNoPfxTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RdfGlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf_nopfx
        Description: RDF table querying routes via SPARQL with embedded full URIs.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          typeOfData: file
          rdf-type: 'true'
          strip-uri-prefixes: 'true'
          querymode: sparql
          sparql-query: |
            SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist
            WHERE {
              ?src <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/route> ?dest .
              ?src <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/code> ?incode .
              ?dest <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/code> ?outcode .
              ?src <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/dist> ?dist .
            }
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub s3://${GraphStorageBucket}/rdf/route_rdf_nopfx/
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          Compressed: false
          NumberOfBuckets: -1
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              serialization.format: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
              Comment: Inbound source airport code
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
              Comment: Outbound destination airport code
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
              Comment: Route distance

Outputs:
  StorageKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the Customer Managed KMS Key encrypting the graph storage bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt GraphStorageKmsKey.Arn
  StorageBucketName:
    Description: S3 Bucket storing the underlying graph data files.
    Value: !Ref GraphStorageBucket

    Description: Name of the LPG Glue Database.
