AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito authentication stacks for PiBot web application and IoT trusted user provisioning.

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: pibot
    Description: Prefix applied to resource names for the PiBot deployment.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # 1. Main Web Application Authentication Setup
  # ============================================================================
  WebAppUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-web-user-pool'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  WebAppUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-web-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref WebAppUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  WebAppIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}_web_identity_pool'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref WebAppUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt WebAppUserPool.ProviderName

  WebAppAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-web-auth-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref WebAppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WebAppAuthPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - cognito-identity:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:GetHLSStreamingSessionURL
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                Resource: '*'

  WebAppUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-web-unauth-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref WebAppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WebAppUnauthPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                  - cognito-sync:*
                Resource: '*'

  WebAppIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref WebAppIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt WebAppAuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt WebAppUnauthRole.Arn

  # ============================================================================
  # 2. IoT Provisioning Authentication Setup
  # ============================================================================
  ProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-provisioning-user-pool'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  ProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-provisioning-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  ProvisioningIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}_provisioning_identity_pool'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt ProvisioningUserPool.ProviderName

  ProvisioningAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-provisioning-auth-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: IoTProvisioningPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - cognito-identity:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:CreateKeysAndCertificate
                  - iot:AttachPolicy
                  - iot:AttachPrincipalPolicy
                  - iot:AttachThingPrincipal
                  - iot:DescribeCertificate
                  - iot:CreateThing
                  - iot:DescribeThing
                  - iot:UpdateCertificate
                Resource: '*'

  ProvisioningUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-provisioning-unauth-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ProvisioningDenyUnauth
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Deny
                Action: '*'
                Resource: '*'

  ProvisioningIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production Route 53 public hosted zone and comprehensive DNS record sets for radiotopia.fm

Parameters:
  ApexDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: radiotopia.fm
    Description: The apex domain name for the hosted zone

  MediaCloudFrontDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for media subdomain

  TowerCloudFrontDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d222222abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for tower subdomain

  V1CloudFrontDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d333333abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for v1 subdomain

  PlusCloudFrontDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d444444abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for plus subdomain

  FeedProxyTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: feeds.feedburner.com
    Description: Target hostname for podcast feed proxy service

  SpecialEventHostIp:
    Type: String
    Default: 203.0.113.50
    Description: Dedicated IPv4 address for special event subdomain

Resources:
  PublicHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ApexDomainName}.'
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Public hosted zone for radiotopia.fm live production services
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Domain
          Value: !Ref ApexDomainName

  ApexARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '198.185.159.144'
        - '198.185.159.145'
        - '198.49.23.144'
        - '198.49.23.145'

  WwwCnameRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 'ext-cust.squarespace.com.'

  ApexMxRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '5 alt1.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '5 alt2.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '10 alt3.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '10 alt4.aspmx.l.google.com.'

  ApexTxtRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:servers.mcsv.net include:mail.zendesk.com include:_spf.createsend.com ~all"'
        - '"google-site-verification=y_8HkE4PjLm1nOpQrStUvWxYzAbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQr"'
        - '"squarespace-site-verification=sqsp0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"'

  DmarcRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_dmarc.${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DMARC1; p=reject; pct=100; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@${ApexDomainName}; ruf=mailto:dmarc-forensics@${ApexDomainName}; fo=1"'

  MediaAliasARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'media.${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref MediaCloudFrontDomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  MediaAliasAaaaRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'media.${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref MediaCloudFrontDomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  TowerAliasARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'tower.${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref TowerCloudFrontDomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  TowerAliasAaaaRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'tower.${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref TowerCloudFrontDomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  V1AliasARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'v1.${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref V1CloudFrontDomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  V1AliasAaaaRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'v1.${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref V1CloudFrontDomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  PlusAliasARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'plus.${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref PlusCloudFrontDomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  PlusAliasAaaaRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'plus.${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref PlusCloudFrontDomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeedProxyCnameRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'feed.${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '${FeedProxyTarget}.'

  SpecialEventARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'event.${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SpecialEventHostIp

  MediaAcmValidationRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90.media.${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '_1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef.acm-validations.aws.'

  TowerAcmValidationRecordSet:

    Properties:

      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '_2345678901abcdef2345678901abcdef.acm-validations.aws.'

  V1AcmValidationRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_c3d4e5f6a1b20718293a4b5c6d7e8f92.v1.${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '_3456789012abcdef3456789012abcdef.acm-validations.aws.'

  PlusAcmValidationRecordSet:

    Properties:

      ResourceRecords:

    Properties:

      Name: !Sub 'zendeskverification.${ApexDomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef"'

  ZendeskDkim1RecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk1._domainkey.${ApexDomainName}.'

      Type: TXT

      ResourceRecords:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CloudFormation template provisioning an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway with MCP
  integration for protein variant effect prediction, initializing genuine Cognito and Lambda
  resources to enable self-contained greenfield deployment with dynamic SSM Parameter Store resolution.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: Project identifier used to scope resource names and parameter paths.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, underscores, and hyphens.

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: AgentCore Gateway for protein variant effect prediction MCP tools
    Description: Description for the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.

  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional name for the AgentCore Gateway. Defaults to <ProjectName>-gateway if left blank.

  LambdaTargetArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional backend Lambda ARN. If left blank, the template-provisioned Lambda function ARN will be used.

  CognitoDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional Cognito OIDC Discovery URL. If left blank, the template-provisioned Cognito User Pool discovery URL will be used.

  CognitoClientId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional Cognito User Pool Client ID. If left blank, the template-provisioned User Pool Client will be used.

Conditions:
  HasCustomGatewayName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']]
  HasCustomLambdaArn: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LambdaTargetArn, '']]
  HasCustomDiscoveryUrl: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CognitoDiscoveryUrl, '']]
  HasCustomClientId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CognitoClientId, '']]

Resources:
  # --- Greenfield Authentication Resources ---
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-user-pool'
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  # --- Greenfield Backend Lambda Resources ---
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-backend-lambda-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

  BackendLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-variant-predictor'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps({"status": "SUCCESS", "message": "Protein prediction mock complete."})
              }

  # --- SSM Parameter Store Configuration ---
  BackendLambdaArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/backend/lambda-arn'
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Description: SSM parameter holding the backend Lambda function ARN for protein prediction.
      Value: !If
        - HasCustomLambdaArn
        - !Ref LambdaTargetArn
        - !GetAtt BackendLambdaFunction.Arn

  CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/auth/discovery-url'
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Description: SSM parameter holding the Cognito OIDC discovery URL.
      Value: !If
        - HasCustomDiscoveryUrl
        - !Ref CognitoDiscoveryUrl
        - !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  CognitoClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/auth/client-id'
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Description: SSM parameter holding the Cognito client ID.
      Value: !If
        - HasCustomClientId
        - !Ref CognitoClientId
        - !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient

  # --- Bedrock AgentCore Execution Role ---
  AgentCoreExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-bedrock-agentcore-role-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: IAM execution role allowing Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to invoke the backend Lambda.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:gateway/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeBackendLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt BackendLambdaArnParameter.Value

  GatewayExecutionRoleSsmParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/gateway-role-arn'
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: IAM Role ARN utilized by Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.

  # --- Bedrock AgentCore Gateway ---
  AgentCoreGateway:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - HasCustomGatewayName
        - !Ref GatewayName
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway'
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      ProtocolType: MCP
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AgentCoreExecutionRole.Arn
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: !GetAtt CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter.Value
          AllowedClients:
            - !GetAtt CognitoClientIdParameter.Value
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: Production

  # --- Bedrock AgentCore Gateway Target ---
  AgentCoreGatewayTarget:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
    Properties:
      GatewayIdentifier: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-protein-tools'
      Description: MCP target connecting protein variant prediction tools to the Lambda backend
      CredentialProviderConfigurations:
        - CredentialProviderType: GATEWAY_IAM_ROLE
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: !GetAtt BackendLambdaArnParameter.Value
            ToolSchema:
              InlinePayload:
                - Name: invoke_endpoint
                  Description: Submit protein amino acid sequences to compute predicted variant effect scores and functional perturbations.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      sequence:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Wild-type or mutant protein primary amino acid sequence.
                      mutations:
                        Type: array
                        Items:
                          Type: string
                        Description: List of variants in standard syntax (e.g. A123V) to evaluate.
                      model_parameters:
                        Type: object
                        Description: Optional inference hyperparameters for variant effect computation.
                    Required:
                      - sequence
                - Name: get_results
                  Description: Poll execution status or retrieve completed predictions using the submitted job identifier.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      job_id:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Unique identifier generated during variant prediction job submission.
                    Required:
                      - job_id

Outputs:
  GatewayId:
    Description: Unique identifier for the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !Ref AgentCoreGateway

  GatewayArn:
    Description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayArn

  GatewayEndpoint:
    Description: REST endpoint URL of the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayUrl

  GatewayExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreExecutionRole.Arn

  GatewayRoleSsmParameterName:
    Description: SSM Parameter Store key storing the AgentCore IAM Role ARN.
    Value: !Ref GatewayExecutionRoleSsmParameter

    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the second private Application Load Balancer subnet (AZ 2).

  LambdaSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.3.0/24'
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the private Lambda subnet.

  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.100.0/24'
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet hosting the NAT Gateway when egress is enabled.

  EnableNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable optional NAT Gateway deployment to allow outbound internet access for OAuth and IdP flows.

Conditions:
  CreateNatGatewayCondition: !Equals [!Ref EnableNatGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGatewayCondition
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateNatGatewayCondition
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateNatGatewayCondition
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-nat'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateNatGatewayCondition
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGatewayCondition
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateNatGatewayCondition
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGatewayCondition
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGatewayCondition
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw'

  AlbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-alb-subnet-1'

  AlbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-alb-subnet-2'

  LambdaSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref LambdaSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-lambda-subnet'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateRouteToNatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGatewayCondition
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  AlbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  AlbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  LambdaSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref LambdaSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ArtifactKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for encrypting artifact storage bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: artifact-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 's3.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'

  ArtifactKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-artifact-storage-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ArtifactKmsKey

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ArtifactKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-artifact-storage'

  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonHttpsTraffic
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

    Description: Private Subnet ID for Application Load Balancer in AZ 1
    Value: !Ref AlbSubnet1

  LambdaSubnetId:

    Description: Name of S3 Bucket for artifact storage
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket

  ArtifactBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of S3 Bucket for artifact storage
    Value: !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions an AWS Step Functions State Machine with two separate API Gateway REST APIs (GET and POST endpoints) integrated via dedicated IAM roles.

Resources:
  StepFunctionsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - states.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'

  TwoStepPassStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: |-
        {
          "Comment": "A simple two-step pass workflow",
          "StartAt": "PassState1",
          "States": {
            "PassState1": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": {
                "step1": "completed"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.step1Output",
              "Next": "PassState2"
            },
            "PassState2": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": {
                "step2": "completed"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.step2Output",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

  GetApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt TwoStepPassStateMachine.Arn

  PostApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt TwoStepPassStateMachine.Arn

  GetWorkflowApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: GetWorkflowApi
      Description: REST API providing a GET endpoint to trigger Step Functions execution
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  GetWorkflowResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt GetWorkflowApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execution
      RestApiId: !Ref GetWorkflowApi

  GetWorkflowMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetWorkflowApi
      ResourceId: !Ref GetWorkflowResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        Credentials: !GetAtt GetApiRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |-
            {
              "input": "{}",
              "stateMachineArn": "${TwoStepPassStateMachine}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: $input.json('$')

  GetWorkflowDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - GetWorkflowMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetWorkflowApi

  GetWorkflowStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetWorkflowApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref GetWorkflowDeployment
      StageName: prod

  PostWorkflowApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: PostWorkflowApi
      Description: REST API providing a POST endpoint to trigger Step Functions execution
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  PostWorkflowResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt PostWorkflowApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execution
      RestApiId: !Ref PostWorkflowApi

  PostWorkflowMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostWorkflowApi
      ResourceId: !Ref PostWorkflowResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        Credentials: !GetAtt PostApiRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |-
            {
              "input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$'))",
              "stateMachineArn": "${TwoStepPassStateMachine}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: $input.json('$')

  PostWorkflowDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - PostWorkflowMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostWorkflowApi

  PostWorkflowStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostWorkflowApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref PostWorkflowDeployment
      StageName: prod

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions State Machine
    Value: !GetAtt TwoStepPassStateMachine.Arn

  GetWorkflowEndpoint:
    Description: URL endpoint for invoking the Step Functions workflow via GET request
    Value: !Sub https://${GetWorkflowApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/execution

  PostWorkflowEndpoint:
    Description: URL endpoint for invoking the Step Functions workflow via POST request
    Value: !Sub https://${PostWorkflowApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/execution

Description: Foundation IAM roles and Secrets Manager resources for the Hospitality Insights platform.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights
    Description: Name of the project used for resource naming and tagging.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment (dev, staging, or prod).

  # ============================================================================
  # Secrets Manager Secrets
  # ============================================================================
  ProjectConfigSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/${Environment}/config'
      Description: !Sub 'Placeholder configuration parameters for ${ProjectName} ${Environment}'
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"environment":"initialized"}'
        GenerateStringKey: placeholderKey
        PasswordLength: 16
        ExcludePunctuation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ScrapingBeeApiKeySecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/${Environment}/scrapingbee-api-key'
      Description: !Sub 'API key for ScrapingBee service in ${ProjectName} ${Environment}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SQS queue for audit events with KMS encryption, environment-aware DLQ, CloudWatch alarms, and SNS notifications.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment. DLQ is provisioned only in non-dev environments.

  MessageRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 345600
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 1209600
    Description: The number of seconds Amazon SQS retains a message in the primary queue (default 4 days).

  VisibilityTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 43200
    Description: The visibility timeout for the primary queue in seconds (default 5 minutes).

  AgeOfOldestMessageThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3600
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 1209600
    Description: Threshold in seconds for the age of oldest message alarm on the primary queue (default 1 hour).

  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Email address to receive CloudWatch alarm notifications via SNS.

Conditions:
  IsNonDev: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, dev]]
  HasNotificationEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, '']]

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS CMK for Audit Events SQS queues and CloudWatch alarm SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: audit-events-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAndSNSServices
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - sns.amazonaws.com
                - sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/audit-events-${Environment}-${AWS::StackName}
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  DeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub audit-events-dlq-${Environment}
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: !Ref VisibilityTimeout

  AuditEventsQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub audit-events-${Environment}
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !Ref MessageRetentionPeriod
      VisibilityTimeout: !Ref VisibilityTimeout
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNonDev
        - !Sub '{"deadLetterTargetArn":"${DeadLetterQueue.Arn}","maxReceiveCount":5}'
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  AlarmNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub audit-events-alarm-notifications-${Environment}
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  AlarmNotificationSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasNotificationEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail

  AuditQueueAgeOfOldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub audit-events-old-message-alarm-${Environment}
      AlarmDescription: Triggered when the oldest message in the audit queue exceeds the configured age threshold.
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref AgeOfOldestMessageThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  DeadLetterQueueMessagesVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub audit-events-dlq-activity-alarm-${Environment}
      AlarmDescription: Triggered when messages are received in the audit DLQ.
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

Outputs:
  AuditEventsQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the primary audit events SQS queue
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsQueue

  AuditEventsQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the primary audit events SQS queue
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn

  DeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Description: URL of the audit events Dead Letter Queue
    Value: !Ref DeadLetterQueue

  DeadLetterQueueArn:
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Description: ARN of the audit events Dead Letter Queue
    Value: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS Key used to encrypt audit queues and topics
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  AlarmNotificationTopicArn:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Cognito User Pool, App Clients (Web and M2M), Resource Server, User Groups,
  SSM Parameter Store configurations, and an unattached helper Lambda function
  for researchapp and AgentCore.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateGatewayPool
    Description: The name of the Cognito User Pool.
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: The name of the machine-to-machine Cognito User Pool Client.
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: The name of the web application Cognito User Pool Client.

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # Cognito User Pool & Domain
  # ============================================================================
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OPTIONAL'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub 'researchapp-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'

  # ============================================================================
  # Cognito Resource Server
  # ============================================================================
  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: researchapp-agentcore-api
      Name: ResearchApp AgentCore API
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AgentCore resources

  # ============================================================================
  # Cognito User Pool Groups
  # ============================================================================
  AdminUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Administrator group with elevated permissions
      Precedence: 1

  CustomerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Standard customer group
      Precedence: 10

  # ============================================================================
  # Cognito App Clients
  # ============================================================================
  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - researchapp-agentcore-api/read
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  MachineAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - researchapp-agentcore-api/read
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # ============================================================================
  # Lambda Function (Add user to customer group - Standalone, not wired)
  # ============================================================================
  AddUserToGroupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AddUserToGroupRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoAddUserToGroupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  AddUserToGroupLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AddUserToCustomerGroup'
      Description: Helper function to assign newly registered users to the customer group
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt AddUserToGroupLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
          GROUP_NAME: customer
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
          USER_POOL_ID = os.environ.get('USER_POOL_ID')
          GROUP_NAME = os.environ.get('GROUP_NAME', 'customer')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_name = event.get('userName')
              if not user_name and 'request' in event:
                  user_name = event['request'].get('userAttributes', {}).get('email')

              if not user_name:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'userName not found in event'})
                  }

              try:
                  cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=USER_POOL_ID,
                      Username=user_name,
                      GroupName=GROUP_NAME
                  )
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': f'User {user_name} added to {GROUP_NAME}'})
                  }
              except ClientError as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': e.response['Error']['Message']})
                  }

  # ============================================================================
  # SSM Parameter Store Entries
  # Path: /app/researchapp/agentcore/
  # ============================================================================
  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user_pool_id
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID for ResearchApp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool

  SSMUserPoolArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user_pool_arn
      Description: Cognito User Pool ARN for ResearchApp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  SSMCognitoDomain:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito_domain
      Description: Cognito Hosted UI Domain prefix for ResearchApp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'researchapp-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'

  SSMWebClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web_client_id
      Description: Cognito Web Client ID for ResearchApp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient

  SSMMachineClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine_client_id
      Description: Cognito Machine-to-Machine Client ID for ResearchApp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineAppClient

  SSMMachineClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine_client_secret
      Description: Cognito Machine-to-Machine Client Secret for ResearchApp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MachineAppClient.ClientSecret

  SSMOAuthScopeRead:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/oauth_scope_read
      Description: Resource server read scope identifier
      Type: String
      Value: researchapp-agentcore-api/read

  SSMDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/discovery_url
      Description: OpenID Connect Discovery URL
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  SSMTokenUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/token_url
      Description: OAuth2 Token Endpoint URL
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://researchapp-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

  SSMAuthorizeUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/authorize_url
      Description: OAuth2 Authorization Endpoint URL
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://researchapp-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  CognitoDomainUrl:
    Description: Full base URL for the Cognito Hosted UI
    Value: !Sub 'https://researchapp-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

  WebAppClientId:
    Description: ID of the Web Application Client
    Value: !Ref WebAppClient

  MachineAppClientId:
    Description: ID of the Machine-to-Machine Client
    Value: !Ref MachineAppClient

  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer group assignment Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt AddUserToGroupLambdaFunction.Arn

  SSMParameterPath:
    Description: Base SSM Parameter Store path for AgentCore configuration
    Value: /app/researchapp/agentcore/

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AppSync GraphQL API for cryptocurrency ticker data with CoinGecko HTTP integration and DynamoDB persistence.

Resources:
  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE

  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AppSyncDynamoDBRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn
                  - !Sub ${APIDataTable.Arn}/*

  CryptoTickerGraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
        }

        type Query {
          ticker(symbol: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        type TickerInfo {
          symbol: String!
          priceUsd: Float!
          timestamp: String!
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }

        type PriceRecord {
          symbol: String!
          priceUsd: Float!
          timestamp: String!
        }

        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [PriceRecord!]!
          nextToken: String
        }

  CryptoTickerApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Description: Default API key for CryptoTickerAPI

  CoinGeckoHttpDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoHTTPDataSource
      Type: HTTP
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com

  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: APIDataTableDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable

  FetchPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: fetchCoinGeckoPrice
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt CoinGeckoHttpDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($symbol = $ctx.args.symbol.toLowerCase())
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "resourcePath": "/api/v3/simple/price",
          "params": {
            "query": {
              "ids": "$symbol",
              "vs_currencies": "usd"
            },
            "headers": {
              "Accept": "application/json",
              "User-Agent": "AWS-AppSync"
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        #if($ctx.result.statusCode != 200)
          $util.error("CoinGecko API returned status code ${ctx.result.statusCode}", "HttpError")
        #end
        #set($response = $util.parseJson($ctx.result.body))
        #set($symbol = $ctx.args.symbol.toLowerCase())
        #if(!$response.containsKey($symbol) || !$response.get($symbol).containsKey("usd"))
          $util.error("Price data not found for symbol: ${ctx.args.symbol}", "NotFound")
        #end
        #set($price = $response.get($symbol).get("usd"))
        #set($now = $util.time.nowISO8601())
        $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("symbol", $ctx.args.symbol))
        $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("priceUsd", $price))
        $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("timestamp", $now))
        $util.toJson({
          "symbol": $ctx.args.symbol,
          "priceUsd": $price,
          "timestamp": $now
        })

  SavePriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: savePriceToDynamoDB
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($symbol = $ctx.stash.symbol)
        #set($price = $ctx.stash.priceUsd)
        #set($timestamp = $ctx.stash.timestamp)
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson("TICKER#${symbol}"),
            "sk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson("TS#${timestamp}")
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "symbol": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($symbol),
            "priceUsd": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($price),
            "timestamp": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($timestamp)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        $util.toJson({
          "symbol": $ctx.stash.symbol,
          "priceUsd": $ctx.stash.priceUsd,
          "timestamp": $ctx.stash.timestamp
        })

  QueryTickerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
      - FetchPriceFunction
      - SavePriceFunction
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FetchPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt SavePriceFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("symbol", $ctx.args.symbol))
        {}
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.prev.result)

  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Kind: UNIT
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($limit = $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.limit, 25))
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Query",
          "query": {
            "expression": "hk = :hk",
            "expressionValues": {
              ":hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson("TICKER#${ctx.source.symbol}")
            }
          },
          "scanIndexForward": false,
          "limit": $limit
          #if($ctx.args.nextToken)
            ,"nextToken": "$ctx.args.nextToken"
          #end
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        $util.toJson({
          "items": $ctx.result.items,
          "nextToken": $ctx.result.nextToken
        })

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL API Identifier
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId

  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL API Endpoint URL
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl

  ApiKey:
    Description: AppSync API Key for CryptoTickerAPI
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerApiKey.ApiKey

  DynamoDBTableName:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for AWS Elemental MediaPackage live channel with conditional HLS and DASH origin endpoints and optional VOD/archive IAM access role.

Parameters:
  LogicalResourcePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: medialive-pkg
    Description: Logical resource prefix for naming MediaPackage resources.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9\-_]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, dashes, or underscores.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment tag.

  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: Project
    Description: Key for an optional custom tag applied to resources.

  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: LiveStreaming
    Description: Value for the custom tag applied to resources.

  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    Description: Manifest name for generated origin endpoints.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9\-_]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, dashes, or underscores.

  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: Duration (in seconds) of each HLS segment.

  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 86400
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 1209600
    Description: Maximum time window (in seconds) available for live playback startover.

  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Packaging format to output for live streaming endpoints.

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional S3 bucket name for live-to-VOD harvest archiving. If provided, origin endpoint origination is set to DENY.

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional S3 bucket name containing source video assets for MediaPackage VOD workflows.

Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  EnableVod: !Or [Condition: HasArchiveBucket, Condition: HasVodSourceBucket]
  EnableHls: !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'APPLE_HLS'], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'ALL']]
  EnableDash: !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'ISO_DASH'], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'ALL']]
  OriginationIsDeny: !Condition HasArchiveBucket

Resources:
  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalResourcePrefix}-channel'
      Description: !Sub 'MediaPackage live channel for ${LogicalResourcePrefix}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: EnableHls
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalResourcePrefix}-hls-endpoint'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub 'HLS Origin Endpoint for ${LogicalResourcePrefix}'
      Origination: !If [OriginationIsDeny, 'DENY', 'ALLOW']
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        PlaylistWindowSeconds: 60
        AdMarkers: NONE
        IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: EnableDash
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalResourcePrefix}-dash-endpoint'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub 'DASH Origin Endpoint for ${LogicalResourcePrefix}'
      Origination: !If [OriginationIsDeny, 'DENY', 'ALLOW']
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        Profile: NONE
        ManifestWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  MediaPackageVodRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableVod
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalResourcePrefix}-mediapackage-vod-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MediaPackageVodS3Policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - !If
                - HasVodSourceBucket
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}'
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}/*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - HasArchiveBucket
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:PutObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}'
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

Outputs:
  ChannelId:
    Description: MediaPackage Channel ID
    Value: !Ref MediaPackageChannel

  ChannelArn:
    Description: MediaPackage Channel ARN
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageChannel.Arn

  HlsEndpointUrl:
    Condition: EnableHls
    Description: Primary playback URL for HLS Origin Endpoint
    Value: !GetAtt HlsOriginEndpoint.Url

  HlsEndpointArn:
    Condition: EnableHls
    Description: ARN for HLS Origin Endpoint
    Value: !GetAtt HlsOriginEndpoint.Arn

  DashEndpointUrl:
    Condition: EnableDash
    Description: Primary playback URL for DASH Origin Endpoint
    Value: !GetAtt DashOriginEndpoint.Url

  DashEndpointArn:
    Condition: EnableDash
    Description: ARN for DASH Origin Endpoint
    Value: !GetAtt DashOriginEndpoint.Arn

  MediaPackageVodRoleArn:
    Condition: EnableVod
    Description: IAM Role ARN for MediaPackage VOD S3 access
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageVodRole.Arn
