AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready CloudFormation template for an Amazon DynamoDB table with configurable keys, billing mode, PITR, optional KMS CMK, and optional CloudWatch alarm notifications.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Custom name for the DynamoDB table. If omitted, CloudFormation will generate a unique name.

  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'id'
    Description: Name of the partition key attribute.

  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: 'S'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'S'
      - 'N'
      - 'B'
    Description: Data type of the partition key attribute (S=String, N=Number, B=Binary).

  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Name of the sort key attribute. Leave empty if no sort key is required.

  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: 'N'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'S'
      - 'N'
      - 'B'
    Description: Data type of the sort key attribute (S=String, N=Number, B=Binary). Ignored if SortKeyName is empty.

  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: 'PROVISIONED'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'PROVISIONED'
      - 'PAY_PER_REQUEST'
    Description: Billing mode for the DynamoDB table.

  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Provisioned read capacity units (used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED).

  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Provisioned write capacity units (used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED).

  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery (PITR) for continuous backups.

  EnableKmsEncryption:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable server-side encryption using a customer-managed AWS KMS key.

  EnableAlerting:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable CloudWatch alarms for table throttling and system errors.

  AlertNotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Email address to receive CloudWatch alarm notifications via SNS. Ignored if EnableAlerting is false.

Conditions:
  HasCustomTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, '']]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, 'PROVISIONED']
  IsPitRecoveryEnabled: !Equals [!Ref PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled, 'true']
  UseKms: !Equals [!Ref EnableKmsEncryption, 'true']
  UseAlerting: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlerting, 'true']
  HasAlertEmail: !And
    - !Condition UseAlerting
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertNotificationEmail, '']]

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: UseKms
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for DynamoDB table server-side encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: dynamodb-kms-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:CreateGrant'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: UseKms
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  SnsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: UseAlerting
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for SNS alert topic encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: sns-kms-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAndSNSAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: '*'

  SnsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: UseAlerting
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-sns-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SnsKmsKey

  AlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: UseAlerting
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DynamoDBAlerts'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SnsKmsKey

  AlertTopicSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlertEmail
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertNotificationEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref AlertTopic

  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !If [HasCustomTableName, !Ref TableName, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      AttributeDefinitions: !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
      KeySchema: !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [IsPitRecoveryEnabled, true, false]
      SSESpecification: !If
        - UseKms
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
          KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: UseAlerting
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DynamoDB-ThrottledRequests'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when DynamoDB throttled requests exceed threshold.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: UseAlerting
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DynamoDB-SystemErrors'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when DynamoDB encounters system errors.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the created DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable

  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the created DynamoDB table
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

  KmsKeyArn:
    Condition: UseKms
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for DynamoDB table encryption
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  AlertTopicArn:
    Condition: UseAlerting
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic for DynamoDB CloudWatch alerts
    Value: !Ref AlertTopic

  SnsKmsKeyArn:
    Condition: UseAlerting
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for SNS topic encryption
    Value: !GetAtt SnsKmsKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready EC2 Image Builder pipeline for building custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs for x86_64 and arm64 architectures with Docker, Python packages, and SSM user configuration.

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1.0.0'
    Description: Version identifier for the Image Builder recipes and pipeline output AMIs (semantic versioning format, e.g., 1.0.0).
    AllowedPattern: ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid semantic version (e.g. 1.0.0).

  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 1024
    Description: Size in GiB for the root EBS block device mapping of built AMIs.

  TargetOrganizationArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) AWS Organization ARN to share resulting AMIs with (e.g., arn:aws:organizations::123456789012:organization/o-example123). Leave empty if not sharing with an organization.

Conditions:
  HasTargetOrganizationArn: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetOrganizationArn, '']]

Resources:
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS Customer Managed Key for S3 Bucket Encryption
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Customer Managed Key for EC2 Image Builder S3 build logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  ImageBuilderLogKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-s3-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ImageBuilderLogKey

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 Logging Bucket for Image Builder
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ImageBuilderLogKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  ImageBuilderLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ImageBuilderLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceSecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ImageBuilderLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ImageBuilderLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role and Instance Profile for Image Builder Build Instances
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role for EC2 Image Builder build and test instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderLogBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3LogBucketPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${ImageBuilderLogBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: KMSLogBucketPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderLogKey.Arn

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder Components: Build (Software Installation) & Test (Validation)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SoftwareInstallationComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-software-installation'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, and enables sudo for ssm-user
      Data: |
        name: SoftwareInstallation
        description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, and configures ssm-user sudo
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdatePackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf update -y
              - name: InstallDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - systemctl start docker
                    - usermod -aG docker ec2-user || true
              - name: InstallDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - DOCKER_CONFIG=${DOCKER_CONFIG:-/usr/local/lib/docker}
                    - mkdir -p $DOCKER_CONFIG/cli-plugins
                    - ARCH=$(uname -m)
                    - COMPOSE_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/docker/compose/releases/latest | grep '"tag_name":' | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]+)".*/\1/')
                    - if [ -z "$COMPOSE_VERSION" ]; then COMPOSE_VERSION="v2.24.5"; fi
                    - curl -SL "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/${COMPOSE_VERSION}/docker-compose-linux-${ARCH}" -o $DOCKER_CONFIG/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - chmod +x $DOCKER_CONFIG/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - ln -sf $DOCKER_CONFIG/cli-plugins/docker-compose /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
              - name: InstallPythonAndPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y python3 python3-pip python3-devel gcc
                    - pip3 install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip
                    - pip3 install --no-cache-dir synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: ConfigureSsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - echo "ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user

  ValidationTestComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-validation-test'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Tests Docker service, Docker Compose execution, and Python package imports
      Data: |
        name: ValidationTest
        description: Validates Docker, Docker Compose, and Python package installations
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: VerifyDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - systemctl is-active docker
                    - docker info
              - name: VerifyDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker compose version
                    - docker-compose version
              - name: VerifyPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient; import pandas; import pysftp; print('All required Python modules imported successfully.')"
              - name: VerifySsmUserSudoConfig
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - test -f /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - grep -q "ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder Recipes: x86_64 and arm64
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageRecipeX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-recipe-x86_64'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SoftwareInstallationComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt ValidationTestComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: true
            DeleteOnTermination: true

  ImageRecipeArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-recipe-arm64'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-arm64/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SoftwareInstallationComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt ValidationTestComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: true
            DeleteOnTermination: true

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared Infrastructure Configuration
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infra-config'
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.medium
        - t4g.medium

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito User Pool with app client, user groups, and custom resource Lambda for seeding demo users for AgentOps e-commerce analytics.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentops-ecommerce-users
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      MfaConfiguration: 'OPTIONAL'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: role
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '50'

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentops-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  AdminUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Admin team group
      Precedence: 1

  TeamAlphaUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Team Alpha members
      Precedence: 10

  TeamBetaUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Team Beta members
      Precedence: 20

  SeederLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoSeederPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/* agentops-user-seeder*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminDeleteUser
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  SeederLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: agentops-user-seeder
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt SeederLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import urllib.request
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          DEMO_USERS = [
              {"email": "alice@demo.local", "role": "member", "group": "team-alpha"},
              {"email": "bob@demo.local", "role": "member", "group": "team-alpha"},
              {"email": "charlie@demo.local", "role": "team_admin", "group": "team-alpha"},
              {"email": "dave@demo.local", "role": "member", "group": "team-beta"},
              {"email": "eve@demo.local", "role": "team_admin", "group": "team-beta"},
              {"email": "admin@demo.local", "role": "admin", "group": "admin"}
          ]
          DEMO_PASSWORD = "DemoPassword123!"

          def send_response(event, context, response_status, response_data, physical_resource_id=None):
              response_url = event['ResponseURL']
              response_body = json.dumps({
                  'Status': response_status,
                  'Reason': f'See CloudWatch Log Stream: {context.log_stream_name}',
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': response_data
              }).encode('utf-8')

              headers = {
                  'content-type': '',
                  'content-length': str(len(response_body))
              }
              req = urllib.request.Request(response_url, data=response_body, headers=headers, method='PUT')
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                      logger.info(f"CloudFormation response status: {resp.status}")
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Failed to send CloudFormation response: {e}")

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Received event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              properties = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              user_pool_id = properties.get('UserPoolId')
              physical_id = "AgentOpsUserSeederResource"

              if request_type == 'Delete':
                  logger.info("Delete request: skipping user deletion to avoid accidental data loss")
                  send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_id)
                  return

              try:
                  for user in DEMO_USERS:
                      email = user['email']
                      role = user['role']
                      group = user['group']

                      try:
                          client.admin_create_user(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              UserAttributes=[
                                  {'Name': 'email', 'Value': email},
                                  {'Name': 'email_verified', 'Value': 'true'},
                                  {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': role}
                              ],
                              MessageAction='SUPPRESS'
                          )
                          logger.info(f"Created user {email}")
                      except client.exceptions.UsernameExistsException:
                          logger.info(f"User {email} already exists, updating password and group")

                      client.admin_set_user_password(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=email,
                          Password=DEMO_PASSWORD,
                          Permanent=True
                      )
                      logger.info(f"Set permanent password for {email}")

                      client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=email,
                          GroupName=group
                      )
                      logger.info(f"Added {email} to group {group}")

                  send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'Message': 'Seeded demo users successfully'}, physical_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error seeding users: {e}", exc_info=True)
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {'Error': str(e)}, physical_id)

  SeedUsersCustomResource:
    Type: Custom::UserSeeder
    DependsOn:
      - AdminUserGroup
      - TeamAlphaUserGroup
      - TeamBetaUserGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SeederLambdaFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: The ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: The ID of the Cognito User Pool Client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  Region:
    Description: AWS Region where resources are deployed
    Value: !Ref AWS::Region

  SeederLambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: The ARN of the user seeder Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt SeederLambdaFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudWatch Logs Insights queries and dashboard for AWS Client VPN usage reporting covering Active Directory/SAML, Mutual Authentication, and Mixed Mode authentication.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/vendedlogs/clientvpn/prod
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Log Group where AWS Client VPN connection logs are published (avoid unapproved reserved aws/ prefixes).
  QueryFolderPath:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-client-vpn
    Description: Folder/prefix path in CloudWatch Logs Insights to organize the query definitions.

Resources:
  ClientVpnLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 30

  QueryEndpointUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Usage-By-Endpoint'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, `endpoint-id`, `connection-attempt-status`, `connection-reset-reason`
        | stats count(*) as TotalEvents,
                count_if(`connection-attempt-status` = 'successful') as SuccessfulConnections,
                count_if(`connection-attempt-status` = 'failed') as FailedConnections,
                count_if(ispresent(`connection-reset-reason`)) as TerminatedConnections
          by `endpoint-id`
        | sort TotalEvents desc

  QueryAuthMethodUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Usage-By-Auth-Method'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, `endpoint-id`, `username`, `common-name`, `connection-attempt-status`
        | filter `connection-attempt-status` = 'successful'
        | eval AuthMethod = case(
            ispresent(`username`) and ispresent(`common-name`) and `username` != '-' and `common-name` != '-', 'Mixed (Directory/SAML + Mutual)',
            ispresent(`username`) and `username` != '-', 'Directory/SAML Auth',
            ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != '-', 'Mutual (Certificate) Auth',
            'Unknown'
          )
        | stats count(*) as SuccessfulConnections,
                count_distinct(coalesce(`username`, `common-name`)) as UniqueUsers
          by AuthMethod
        | sort SuccessfulConnections desc

  QueryDistinctActiveUsers:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Distinct-Active-Users'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, `endpoint-id`, `client-ip`, `username`, `common-name`, `connection-attempt-status`
        | filter `connection-attempt-status` = 'successful'
        | eval UserId = coalesce(`username`, `common-name`, 'Unknown')
        | stats count(*) as ConnectionCount,
                count_distinct(`endpoint-id`) as EndpointsUsed,
                earliest(@timestamp) as FirstSeen,
                latest(@timestamp) as LastSeen
          by UserId
        | sort ConnectionCount desc

  QueryConnectionDurations:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Connection-Durations'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, `endpoint-id`, `connection-duration-s`, `bytes-in`, `bytes-out`, `username`, `common-name`
        | filter ispresent(`connection-duration-s`) and `connection-duration-s` > 0
        | eval UserId = coalesce(`username`, `common-name`, 'Unknown')
        | stats count(*) as DisconnectedSessions,
                avg(`connection-duration-s`) as AvgDurationSeconds,
                max(`connection-duration-s`) as MaxDurationSeconds,
                sum(`connection-duration-s`) as TotalDurationSeconds,
                sum(`bytes-in`) as TotalBytesIn,
                sum(`bytes-out`) as TotalBytesOut
          by UserId
        | sort TotalDurationSeconds desc

  ClientVpnDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: Client-VPN-Usage-Reporting
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "text",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 2,
              "properties": {
                "markdown": "# AWS Client VPN Usage Reporting\nLog Group: `${LogGroupName}` | Metrics covering Active Directory/SAML, Mutual Auth, and Mixed Auth."
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 2,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "query": "SOURCE '${LogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, `endpoint-id`, `connection-attempt-status`, `connection-reset-reason` | stats count(*) as TotalEvents, count_if(`connection-attempt-status` = 'successful') as SuccessfulConnections, count_if(`connection-attempt-status` = 'failed') as FailedConnections, count_if(ispresent(`connection-reset-reason`)) as TerminatedConnections by `endpoint-id` | sort TotalEvents desc",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Total Usage per Endpoint",
                "view": "table"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 2,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "query": "SOURCE '${LogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, `endpoint-id`, `username`, `common-name`, `connection-attempt-status` | filter `connection-attempt-status` = 'successful' | eval AuthMethod = case(ispresent(`username`) and ispresent(`common-name`) and `username` != '-' and `common-name` != '-', 'Mixed (Directory/SAML + Mutual)', ispresent(`username`) and `username` != '-', 'Directory/SAML Auth', ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != '-', 'Mutual (Certificate) Auth', 'Unknown') | stats count(*) as SuccessfulConnections, count_distinct(coalesce(`username`, `common-name`)) as UniqueUsers by AuthMethod | sort SuccessfulConnections desc",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Usage by Authentication Method",
                "view": "table"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 8,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "query": "SOURCE '${LogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, `endpoint-id`, `client-ip`, `username`, `common-name`, `connection-attempt-status` | filter `connection-attempt-status` = 'successful' | eval UserId = coalesce(`username`, `common-name`, 'Unknown') | stats count(*) as ConnectionCount, count_distinct(`endpoint-id`) as EndpointsUsed, earliest(@timestamp) as FirstSeen, latest(@timestamp) as LastSeen by UserId | sort ConnectionCount desc",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Distinct Active Users",
                "view": "table"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 8,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "query": "SOURCE '${LogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, `endpoint-id`, `connection-duration-s`, `bytes-in`, `bytes-out`, `username`, `common-name` | filter ispresent(`connection-duration-s`) and `connection-duration-s` > 0 | eval UserId = coalesce(`username`, `common-name`, 'Unknown') | stats count(*) as DisconnectedSessions, avg(`connection-duration-s`) as AvgDurationSeconds, max(`connection-duration-s`) as MaxDurationSeconds, sum(`connection-duration-s`) as TotalDurationSeconds, sum(`bytes-in`) as TotalBytesIn, sum(`bytes-out`) as TotalBytesOut by UserId | sort TotalDurationSeconds desc",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Connection Durations & Data Transfer",
                "view": "table"
              }
            }
          ]
        }

Outputs:
  DashboardName:
    Description: Name of the Client VPN CloudWatch Dashboard
    Value: !Ref ClientVpnDashboard

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for Hospitality Insights Cognito User Pool with Hosted UI, Post-Authentication Lambda Trigger, User Groups, and optional SSO integration.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name.

  HostedUiDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights-prod
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid Cognito domain prefix (lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, 1-63 characters, cannot start or end with a hyphen).
    Description: Unique domain prefix for the Cognito Hosted UI.

  SsoProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional federated SSO Identity Provider name (e.g., Okta, AzureAD). Leave blank to disable SSO.

  SsoProviderMetadataUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional SAML/OIDC metadata URL or endpoint for the SSO Identity Provider. Leave blank if SSO is not configured.

Conditions:
  HasSsoProvider: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoProviderName, '']]
  HasSsoMetadataUrl: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoProviderMetadataUrl, '']]
  EnableSsoIntegration: !And
    - !Condition HasSsoProvider
    - !Condition HasSsoMetadataUrl

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub hospitality-insights-${Environment}-cognito-trigger-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoUpdateAttributesPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*

  PostAuthLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub hospitality-insights-${Environment}-post-auth
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              user_name = event['userName']
              current_time = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

              try:
                  client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=user_name,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {
                              'Name': 'custom:last_login',
                              'Value': current_time
                          }
                      ]
                  )
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error updating last_login for user {user_name}: {str(e)}")
                  # Do not raise exception to avoid blocking user login

              return event

  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub hospitality-insights-${Environment}-user-pool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaFunction.Arn

  LambdaCognitoPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref HostedUiDomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  UserPoolIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: EnableSsoIntegration
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SsoProviderName
      ProviderType: SAML
      ProviderDetails:
        MetadataURL: !Ref SsoProviderMetadataUrl
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub hospitality-insights-${Environment}-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 24
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: hours
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      CallbackURLs:
        - https://localhost:3000/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - https://localhost:3000/logout
      SupportedIdentityProviders: !If
        - EnableSsoIntegration
        - - COGNITO
          - !Ref SsoProviderName
        - - COGNITO
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:last_login
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:last_login

  AdminUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: Administrators with highest privileges
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Precedence: 1

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Description: Standard application users
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Precedence: 2

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Description: Power users with extended operational permissions
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Precedence: 3

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: The ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: The ID of the Cognito User Pool Client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  HostedUiDomain:
    Description: The fully qualified hosted UI domain URL
    Value: !Sub https://${HostedUiDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com

          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              request_context = event.get('requestContext', {})
              connection_id = request_context.get('connectionId')
              domain_name = request_context.get('domainName')
              stage = request_context.get('stage')
              body = event.get('body', '')

              if not connection_id or not domain_name or not stage:
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': 'Missing connection context'}

              endpoint_url = f"https://{domain_name}/{stage}"
              client = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=endpoint_url)

              try:
                  message = json.dumps({'message': 'echo', 'data': body})
                  client.post_to_connection(
                      ConnectionId=connection_id,
                      Data=message.encode('utf-8')
                  )
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Message sent'}
              except ClientError as e:
                  print(f"Error posting to connection {connection_id}: {e}")
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': 'Failed to echo message'}

    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-api'
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'
      Description: WebSocket API for managing client sessions and echo messaging

  # =========================================================================
  # Lambda Permission for API Gateway $default Route
  # =========================================================================
  EchoLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt EchoLambdaFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*'

  # =========================================================================

    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

      IntegrationMethod: POST

  ConnectIntegrationResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::IntegrationResponse

    Properties:

    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/DeleteItem'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
      RequestTemplates:
        application/json: !Sub >

            "TableName": "${SessionTable}",
            "Key": {
              "connectionId": {"S": "$context.connectionId"}
            }
          }
      PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_TEMPLATES

  DisconnectIntegrationResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::IntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationId: !Ref DisconnectIntegration
      IntegrationResponseKey: /200/

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      OperationName: DisconnectRoute
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}'

  DisconnectRouteResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::RouteResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteId: !Ref DisconnectRoute
      RouteResponseKey: $default

  # =========================================================================
  # $default Integration and Route (Echo Lambda AWS_PROXY)
  # =========================================================================
  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

  DefaultRoute:

    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

  # =========================================================================

    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment

    Properties:

      Description: Initial deployment of the WebSocket API

  WebSocketStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

      Description: WebSocket API Stage

Description: Standalone basic VPC with a single public subnet, route table, internet gateway, and network ACL for testing purposes.

    Type: String

    AllowedValues:

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:

      EnableDnsSupport: true

          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Test

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Test

    Properties:

      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

      NetworkAclId: !Ref SubnetNetworkAcl

      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

  OutboundUdpNetworkAclEntry:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref SubnetNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

  SubnetNetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      NetworkAclId: !Ref SubnetNetworkAcl

    Description: The ID of the created VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

    Description: The ID of the created Public Subnet

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: The ID of the attached Internet Gateway

  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: The ID of the Public Route Table
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  SubnetNetworkAclId:
    Description: The ID of the Network ACL
    Value: !Ref SubnetNetworkAcl

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS) experiment template for multi-service cross-region chaos testing with encrypted logging.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: The remote AWS region to disrupt connectivity to (e.g., us-west-2).
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]+)+-\d+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region identifier (e.g., us-west-2, eu-west-1).
  ExperimentDuration:
    Type: String
    Default: PT20M
    Description: Duration of the chaos disruption actions in ISO 8601 format (e.g., PT20M).
    AllowedPattern: ^PT([0-9]+H)?([0-9]+M)?([0-9]+S)?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid ISO 8601 duration format (e.g., PT20M, PT1H).
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Number of days to retain FIS experiment execution logs in CloudWatch Logs.
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]

Resources:
  FisLoggingKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS customer managed key for AWS FIS CloudWatch Log Group encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: fis-logging-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/fis/*

  FisLoggingKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/fis-experiment-logs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FisLoggingKey

  FisLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/fis/cross-region-chaos-${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FisLoggingKey.Arn

  FisExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub fis-execution-role-${AWS::StackName}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FisNetworkDisruptionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: Ec2NetworkDisruption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:ReplaceRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables
                  - ec2:DisableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
                  - ec2:EnableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
                  - ec2:AssociateTransitGatewayRouteTable
                  - ec2:DisassociateTransitGatewayRouteTable
                  - network-firewall:DescribeFirewall

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  VPC network foundation for Kerberos-secured Amazon EMR on EKS deployment with multi-AZ
  public/private subnets, redundant NAT gateways, EKS load balancer discovery tags,
  and customer-managed KMS encrypted VPC flow logs to CloudWatch.

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/26
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 located in Availability Zone 1.
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.64/26
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 located in Availability Zone 2.
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.128/26
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 located in Availability Zone 1.
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.192/26
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 located in Availability Zone 2.
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-1'

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-2'

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting VPC Flow Logs in CloudWatch
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: flow-logs-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}*'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsCloudWatchPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlog'

Outputs:

    Description: VPC ID for the EMR on EKS deployment.
    Value: !Ref VPC

  VpcCidrBlock:
    Description: CIDR block of the VPC.
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Subnet ID of Public Subnet 1 in AZ 1.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Subnet ID of Public Subnet 2 in AZ 2.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Subnet ID of Private Subnet 1 in AZ 1 for EMR on EKS workloads.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Subnet ID of Private Subnet 2 in AZ 2 for EMR on EKS workloads.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  NatGateway1Id:
    Description: NAT Gateway ID in Public Subnet 1.
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1

  NatGateway2Id:
    Description: NAT Gateway ID in Public Subnet 2.
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2

  FlowLogsLogGroupArn:
    Description: CloudWatch Log Group ARN for VPC Flow Logs.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  FlowLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS Key ARN used for VPC Flow Logs encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

Description: AWS CloudFormation template for a complete EC2 Image Builder pipeline with custom component, workflow, recipe, distribution, schedule, and lifecycle policy.

Resources:
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderLifecycleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  SampleComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: sample-component
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      Data: |
        name: sample-component
        description: Downloads and installs Chef Client on Linux.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: DownloadChefInstallScript
                action: WebDownload
                inputs:
                  - source: https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh
                    destination: /tmp/install-chef.sh
              - name: RunChefInstall
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - chmod +x /tmp/install-chef.sh
                    - /tmp/install-chef.sh
                    - rm -f /tmp/install-chef.sh

  SampleWorkflowV2:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: sample-workflow
      Version: 1.0.1
      Type: BUILD
      Data: |
        name: sample-workflow
        description: Updates SSM Agent and builds the AMI.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        outputs:
          - name: ImageId
            value: '$.stepOutputs.CreateAMI.imageId'
        steps:
          - name: LaunchBuildInstance
            action: LaunchInstance
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              waitFor: "ssmAgent"
          - name: UpdateSSMAgent
            action: RunCommand
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId: '$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId'
              documentName: AWS-RunShellScript
              parameters:
                commands:
                  - yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent || true
          - name: CreateAMI
            action: CreateImage
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId: '$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId'
          - name: TerminateBuildInstance
            action: TerminateInstance
            onFailure: Continue
            inputs:
              instanceId: '$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId'

  SampleRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: sample-recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/x.x.x'
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp2
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SampleComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/chrony-time-configuration-test/x.x.x'

  SampleInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-infrastructure-configuration
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  SampleDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-distribution-configuration
      Distributions:
        - Region: us-east-1
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: 'sample-ami-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref AWS::AccountId

  SampleImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: sample-image-pipeline
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref SampleRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref SampleInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref SampleDistributionConfiguration
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderLifecycleRole.Arn
      Workflows:
        - WorkflowArn: !GetAtt SampleWorkflowV2.Arn
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: false
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 9 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      Status: ENABLED

  SampleLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: sample-lifecycle-policy
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderLifecycleRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 6
            Unit: MONTHS
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          Environment: Dev
      Status: ENABLED

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the created EC2 Image Builder Pipeline
    Value: !GetAtt SampleImagePipeline.Arn
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the created EC2 Image Builder Recipe
    Value: !GetAtt SampleRecipe.Arn
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Image Builder Lifecycle Policy
    Value: !GetAtt SampleLifecyclePolicy.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito-based authentication layer for Lex chatbot web UI supporting authenticated and unauthenticated access with Lex V1/V2 and optional live chat API.

Parameters:
  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'identity pool'
    Description: Name for the Cognito Identity Pool.
  LexV1BotName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'OrderFlowers'
    Description: Name of the Lex V1 bot. If LexV2BotId is not provided, this Lex V1 bot will be used.
  LexV2BotId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) ID of the Lex V2 bot. If provided, Lex V2 will be used instead of Lex V1.
  LexV2BotAliasId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Alias ID of the Lex V2 bot. Required if LexV2BotId is specified.
  ForceCognitoLogin:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: When true, denies unauthenticated access to Lex and the live chat API.
  ShouldEnableLiveChat:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: When true, adds execute-api:Invoke permission for a live chat API.

Conditions:
  UseLexV2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV2BotId, '']]
  UseLexV1: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref LexV2BotId, '']
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV1BotName, '']]
  AllowUnauthAccess: !Equals [!Ref ForceCognitoLogin, 'false']
  EnableLiveChat: !Equals [!Ref ShouldEnableLiveChat, 'true']
  AllowUnauthLexV1: !And
    - !Condition AllowUnauthAccess
    - !Condition UseLexV1
  AllowUnauthLexV2: !And
    - !Condition AllowUnauthAccess
    - !Condition UseLexV2
  AllowUnauthLiveChat: !And
    - !Condition AllowUnauthAccess
    - !Condition EnableLiveChat

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  IdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName

  CognitoAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoAuthRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref IdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PollySynthesizeSpeechPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - polly:SynthesizeSpeech
                Resource: '*'

  CognitoAuthLexV1Policy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: UseLexV1
    Properties:
      PolicyName: LexV1AuthPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoAuthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lex:PostContent
              - lex:PostText
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}:*'

  CognitoAuthLexV2Policy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: UseLexV2
    Properties:
      PolicyName: LexV2AuthPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoAuthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lex:RecognizeText
              - lex:RecognizeUtterance
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}'

  CognitoAuthLiveChatPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: EnableLiveChat
    Properties:
      PolicyName: LiveChatAuthPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoAuthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - execute-api:Invoke
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/POST/livechat*'

  CognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoUnauthRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref IdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated

  CognitoUnauthLexV1Policy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: AllowUnauthLexV1
    Properties:
      PolicyName: LexV1UnauthPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoUnauthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lex:PostContent
              - lex:PostText
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}:*'

  CognitoUnauthLexV2Policy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: AllowUnauthLexV2
    Properties:
      PolicyName: LexV2UnauthPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoUnauthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lex:RecognizeText
              - lex:RecognizeUtterance
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}'

  CognitoUnauthLiveChatPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: AllowUnauthLiveChat
    Properties:
      PolicyName: LiveChatUnauthPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoUnauthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - execute-api:Invoke
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/POST/livechat*'

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt CognitoAuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt CognitoUnauthRole.Arn

Outputs:
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito Identity Pool
    Value: !Ref IdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IdentityPoolId'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool Client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId'
