AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Route 53 public hosted zone and DNS record sets for passengerlist.org including CloudFront aliases, Google Workspace MX, SPF/DMARC/DKIM, Zendesk, Squarespace, and ACM validation.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: passengerlist.org
    Description: Root domain name for the hosted zone

  CloudFrontApexDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for the root apex (passengerlist.org)

  CloudFrontWwwDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for www.passengerlist.org

  CloudFrontDeparturesDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d222222abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for departures.passengerlist.org

  CloudFrontJoinDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d333333abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for join.passengerlist.org

  CloudFrontAthenaDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d444444abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for athena.passengerlist.org

  CloudFrontFeedDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d555555abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for feed.passengerlist.org

  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: google-site-verification=exampleVerificationToken123456789
    Description: Verification token for Google Workspace / Search Console

  ZendeskSubdomainTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: mail1.zendesk.com
    Description: Target domain for Zendesk mail forwarding/routing

  ZendeskDkimDomainKey1Target:
    Type: String
    Default: mail1._domainkey.zendesk.com
    Description: CNAME target for Zendesk DKIM selector 1

  ZendeskDkimDomainKey2Target:
    Type: String
    Default: mail2._domainkey.zendesk.com
    Description: CNAME target for Zendesk DKIM selector 2

  SquarespaceVerificationSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: verify1234567890abcdef
    Description: Unique subdomain token provided by Squarespace for domain verification

  AcmValidationApexRecordName:
    Type: String
    Default: _a79865eb4cd1a6ab990a45779b4e0b96
    Description: ACM validation CNAME record name for apex domain (prefix without domain)

  AcmValidationApexRecordValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _x2.acm-validations.aws.
    Description: ACM validation CNAME record target value for apex domain

  AcmValidationSubdomainsRecordName:
    Type: String
    Default: _b12345eb4cd1a6ab990a45779b4e0b97
    Description: ACM validation CNAME record name for subdomains (prefix without domain)

  AcmValidationSubdomainsRecordValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _x3.acm-validations.aws.
    Description: ACM validation CNAME record target value for subdomains

Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Public hosted zone for passengerlist.org
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Application
          Value: PassengerList

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Apex and Subdomain TXT Records (SPF, Verification, DMARC)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApexTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:mail.zendesk.com ~all"'
        - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'

  DmarcTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_dmarc.${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DMARC1; p=none; sp=none; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@${DomainName}; aspf=r; adkim=r;"'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Google Workspace MX Records
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApexMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '5 alt1.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '5 alt2.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '10 alt3.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '10 alt4.aspmx.l.google.com.'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront A / AAAA Alias Records (CloudFront Zone ID: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApexAliasARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontApexDomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  ApexAliasAaaaRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontApexDomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  WwwAliasARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}.'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontWwwDomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  WwwAliasAaaaRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}.'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontWwwDomainName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  DeparturesAliasARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'departures.${DomainName}.'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Cognito authentication infrastructure for Customer Support Agent Core. Includes
  User Pool with email sign-in, admin and customer groups, Lambda post-confirmation
  trigger, Hosted UI domain, Resource Server, Web and M2M OAuth clients, and SSM
  Parameters for backend service integration.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Environment name for deployment context.

  CognitoDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: cs-agentcore-auth-dev
    Description: Unique prefix for the Cognito Hosted UI domain (e.g., cs-agent-auth-12345). Must be globally unique in the region.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9\-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens, and cannot start or end with a hyphen.

  WebCallbackUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost:3000/callback
    Description: Callback URL for the Web Application Client during OAuth authorization code flow.
    AllowedPattern: '^https?://.+$'

  WebLogoutUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost:3000/logout
    Description: Logout URL for the Web Application Client.
    AllowedPattern: '^https?://.+$'

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for Cognito Post Confirmation Lambda Trigger
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PostConfirmationLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cs-post-confirmation-role-${Environment}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoAddUserToGroupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda Function: Post-Confirmation Hook (Adds new users to 'customer' group)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'cs-post-confirmation-trigger-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostConfirmationLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 15
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito_client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
          DEFAULT_GROUP_NAME = "customer"

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Received event: {event}")
              user_pool_id = event.get('userPoolId')
              user_name = event.get('userName')

              trigger_source = event.get('triggerSource')
              if trigger_source in ["PostConfirmation_ConfirmSignUp", "PostConfirmation_ConfirmForgotPassword"]:
                  try:
                      logger.info(f"Adding user {user_name} to group {DEFAULT_GROUP_NAME} in pool {user_pool_id}")
                      cognito_client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=user_name,
                          GroupName=DEFAULT_GROUP_NAME
                      )
                      logger.info(f"Successfully added {user_name} to {DEFAULT_GROUP_NAME}")
                  except Exception as err:
                      logger.error(f"Error adding user to group: {str(err)}")
                      raise err

              return event

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda Permission for Cognito to Invoke Post Confirmation Function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PostConfirmationLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito User Pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DependsOn:
      - PostConfirmationLambdaPermission
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'cs-agentcore-userpool-${Environment}'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      LambdaConfig:
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito User Pool Groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminUserPoolGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Administrative users with full customer support permissions
      Precedence: 1

  CustomerUserPoolGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Standard customer accounts with self-service permissions
      Precedence: 2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito Hosted UI Domain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref CognitoDomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito Resource Server
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: https://api.customersupport.internal
      Name: CustomerSupportAgentCoreApi
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to customer support agent core resources

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito User Pool Clients
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn:
      - UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'cs-web-client-${Environment}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - https://api.customersupport.internal/read
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref WebCallbackUrl
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref WebLogoutUrl
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  MachineToMachineUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn:
      - UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'cs-m2m-client-${Environment}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - https://api.customersupport.internal/read
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Parameters: /app/customersupport/agentcore/ Hierarchy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/userpool_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID for Customer Support Agent Core

  SSMUserPoolArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/userpool_arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      Description: Cognito User Pool ARN for Customer Support Agent Core

  SSMWebClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/web_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebUserPoolClient
      Description: Cognito App Client ID for Customer Support Web Application

  SSMMachineClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/m2m_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineToMachineUserPoolClient
      Description: Cognito App Client ID for Machine-to-Machine Integration

  SSMOAuthScope:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/oauth_scope
      Type: String
      Value: https://api.customersupport.internal/read
      Description: Custom OAuth Scope for Customer Support API

  SSMHostedUIDomain:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Description: Fully qualified domain URL for the Cognito Hosted UI

  SSMDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/discovery_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OpenID Connect Discovery URL for User Pool

  SSMTokenEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/token_endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Description: OAuth 2.0 Token Endpoint URL

  SSMAuthorizeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/authorize_endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
      Description: OAuth 2.0 Authorize Endpoint URL

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  WebClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the Web Application Cognito Client
    Value: !Ref WebUserPoolClient

  MachineToMachineClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the Machine-to-Machine Cognito Client
    Value: !Ref MachineToMachineUserPoolClient

  HostedUIDomain:
    Description: Base URL for Cognito Hosted UI
    Value: !Sub 'https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OpenID Configuration Discovery Endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  CustomOAuthScope:
    Description: Full identifier for the read OAuth scope
    Value: https://api.customersupport.internal/read

  SSMParameterPath:
    Description: Base SSM Parameter Store path for Agent Core credentials and configuration
    Value: /app/customersupport/agentcore/

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: IAM roles for Amazon SageMaker project templates and integrated CI/CD services.

    Default: 'NO'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Whether to create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsUseRole.

    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Whether to create the SageMaker CloudFormation execution role.
  CreateCodeBuildRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Whether to create the SageMaker CodeBuild service role.
  CreateCodePipelineRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Whether to create the SageMaker CodePipeline service role.
  CreateEventsRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Whether to create the SageMaker CloudWatch Events service role.
  CreateApiGatewayRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Whether to create the SageMaker API Gateway service role.
  CreateFirehoseRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Whether to create the SageMaker Kinesis Data Firehose service role.
  CreateGlueRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Whether to create the SageMaker AWS Glue service role.
  CreateLambdaRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Whether to create the SageMaker AWS Lambda service role.

Conditions:
  ShouldCreateExecutionRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateExecutionRole, 'YES']
  ShouldCreateLaunchRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateLaunchRole, 'YES']
  ShouldCreateUseRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateUseRole, 'YES']
  ShouldCreateCloudFormationRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateCloudFormationRole, 'YES']
  ShouldCreateCodeBuildRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateCodeBuildRole, 'YES']
  ShouldCreateCodePipelineRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateCodePipelineRole, 'YES']
  ShouldCreateEventsRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateEventsRole, 'YES']
  ShouldCreateApiGatewayRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateApiGatewayRole, 'YES']
  ShouldCreateFirehoseRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateFirehoseRole, 'YES']
  ShouldCreateGlueRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateGlueRole, 'YES']
  ShouldCreateLambdaRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateLambdaRole, 'YES']

Resources:
  SageMakerServiceCatalogProductsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: ShouldCreateExecutionRole
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsExecutionRole
      Path: /service-role/
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess

  SageMakerServiceCatalogProductsLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: ShouldCreateLaunchRole
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsLaunchRole
      Path: /service-role/
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonSageMakerAdmin-ServiceCatalogProductsServiceRolePolicy

  SageMakerServiceCatalogProductsUseRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: ShouldCreateUseRole
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsUseRole
      Path: /service-role/
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerServiceCatalogProductsUsePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudFormationOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudformation:*:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/sagemaker-*/*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CodeBuildOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codebuild:BatchGetBuilds
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                  - codebuild:StopBuild
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:codebuild:*:${AWS::AccountId}:project/sagemaker-*'
              - Sid: CodeCommitOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:BatchGet*
                  - codecommit:CreateBranch
                  - codecommit:CreateCommit
                  - codecommit:CreateRepository
                  - codecommit:Describe*
                  - codecommit:Get*
                  - codecommit:GitPull
                  - codecommit:GitPush
                  - codecommit:List*
                  - codecommit:Put*
                  - codecommit:TagResource
                  - codecommit:UntagResource
                  - codecommit:UploadArchive
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:*:${AWS::AccountId}:sagemaker-*'
              - Sid: CodePipelineOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codepipeline:CreatePipeline
                  - codepipeline:DeletePipeline
                  - codepipeline:GetPipeline
                  - codepipeline:GetPipelineExecution
                  - codepipeline:GetPipelineState
                  - codepipeline:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - codepipeline:ListPipelines
                  - codepipeline:StartPipelineExecution
                  - codepipeline:StopPipelineExecution
                  - codepipeline:UpdatePipeline
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:codepipeline:*:${AWS::AccountId}:sagemaker-*'
              - Sid: EC2NetworkInterfaceOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ECROperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:ListImages
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EventsOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:DeleteRule
                  - events:DescribeRule
                  - events:DisableRule
                  - events:EnableRule
                  - events:ListRuleNamesByTarget
                  - events:ListRules
                  - events:ListTargetsByRule
                  - events:PutEvents
                  - events:PutRule
                  - events:PutTargets
                  - events:RemoveTargets
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:events:*:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/sagemaker-*'
              - Sid: FirehoseOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:CreateDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:DeleteDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:UpdateDestination
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:firehose:*:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/sagemaker-*'
              - Sid: GlueOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:BatchCreatePartition
                  - glue:BatchDeletePartition
                  - glue:BatchDeleteTable
                  - glue:BatchGetPartition
                  - glue:CreateDatabase
                  - glue:CreatePartition
                  - glue:CreateTable
                  - glue:DeleteDatabase
                  - glue:DeletePartition
                  - glue:DeleteTable
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:GetPartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:UpdateDatabase
                  - glue:UpdatePartition
                  - glue:UpdateTable
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: IAMPassRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/service-role/AmazonSageMaker*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService:
                      - sagemaker.amazonaws.com
                      - codebuild.amazonaws.com
                      - codepipeline.amazonaws.com
                      - events.amazonaws.com
                      - firehose.amazonaws.com
                      - glue.amazonaws.com
                      - lambda.amazonaws.com
                      - states.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: LambdaOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:CreateFunction
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - lambda:UpdateFunctionCode
                  - lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:lambda:*:${AWS::AccountId}:function:sagemaker-*'
              - Sid: LogsOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DeleteLogGroup
                  - logs:DeleteLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:*:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*'
              - Sid: S3Operations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource:
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::sagemaker-*'
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::sagemaker-*/*'
              - Sid: StepFunctionsOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:

                  - states:DeleteStateMachine
                  - states:DescribeExecution
                  - states:DescribeStateMachine
                  - states:ListExecutions
                  - states:StartExecution
                  - states:StopExecution
                  - states:UpdateStateMachine
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:states:*:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:sagemaker-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:states:*:${AWS::AccountId}:execution:sagemaker-*:*'
              - Sid: CodeStarConnectionsOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codestar-connections:UseConnection
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:codestar-connections:*:${AWS::AccountId}:connection/*'
              - Sid: KMSOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                  - kms:Decrypt

                  - kms:Encrypt

                Resource: '*'

                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Simple VPC template with optional networking components and security group controlled by parameters.

Parameters:
  Prefix:
    Type: String
    Default: SimpleApp1
    Description: Prefix applied to resource names and Name tags.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet.
  CreateInternetGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Controls whether to create and attach an Internet Gateway.
  CreatePublicSubnet:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Controls whether to create a public subnet.
  CreateRouteTable:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Controls whether to create a custom route table.
  CreateSecurityGroup:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Controls whether to create a security group.
  AllowedTrafficCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 0.0.0.0/0
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: Source CIDR range permitted to access HTTP and HTTPS ports.

Conditions:
  ShouldCreateIGW: !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGateway, 'true']
  ShouldCreateSubnet: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnet, 'true']
  ShouldCreateRouteTable: !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTable, 'true']
  ShouldCreateSecurityGroup: !Equals [!Ref CreateSecurityGroup, 'true']
  ShouldCreateInternetRoute: !And
    - !Condition ShouldCreateIGW
    - !Condition ShouldCreateRouteTable
  ShouldAssociateSubnetRouteTable: !And
    - !Condition ShouldCreateSubnet
    - !Condition ShouldCreateRouteTable

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Prefix}-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: ShouldCreateIGW
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Prefix}-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: ShouldCreateIGW
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: ShouldCreateSubnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Prefix}-public-subnet

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: ShouldCreateRouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Prefix}-public-rt

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: ShouldCreateInternetRoute
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: ShouldAssociateSubnetRouteTable
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: ShouldCreateSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub ${Prefix} Security Group allowing HTTP and HTTPS
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedTrafficCidr
          Description: Allow inbound HTTP
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedTrafficCidr
          Description: Allow inbound HTTPS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Prefix}-sg

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the created VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Landing zone hub VPC template for multi-account spoke attachment. Deploys a hub VPC
  with public and private subnets across two AZs, dual NAT Gateways, Transit Gateway,
  VPC Flow Logs with CloudWatch Logs integration, routes for spoke connectivity,
  and VPC Endpoints for SSM, EC2 Messages, SSM Messages, CloudWatch Logs, and S3.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    Description: Prefix applied to resource names and tag values.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the landing zone hub VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 in AZ 1.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 in AZ 2.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 in AZ 1.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 in AZ 2.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  TransitGatewayAsn:

    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534

    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]
    Description: CloudWatch Log retention period in days for VPC Flow Logs.

Resources:
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and Core Networking
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HubVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways & Elastic IPs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-az1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-az2'
        - Key: Environment

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-az2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway & VPC Attachment
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayAsn
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw-hub-attachment'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Route Tables & Routes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSpokeRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSpokeRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsPublishPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref HubVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Endpoints Security Group
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints allowing HTTPS inbound
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS inbound from VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Restrict HTTPS outbound to VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Endpoints
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-s3-gateway-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

    Properties:

      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ssm-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  Ec2MessagesInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ec2messages-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SsmMessagesInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ssmmessages-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LogsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-logs-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained Student Services agent infrastructure for Bedrock AgentCore with dedicated Cognito OAuth2 pools and least-privilege IAM roles.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9-]+$
    Description: Environment identifier (e.g., dev, test, prod).

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # Shared Base Managed Policy
  # ============================================================================
  AgentCoreBaseManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub student-services-agentcore-base-${EnvironmentName}
      Description: Shared base policy for Bedrock AgentCore execution roles
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/*
          - Sid: CloudWatchLoggingAndMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
          - Sid: XRayTracing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
              - xray:GetSamplingRules
              - xray:GetSamplingTargets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMParameterAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*

  # ============================================================================
  # Orchestrator: StudentServicesAgent (IAM role only, no Cognito)
  # ============================================================================
  StudentServicesAgentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub student-services-agent-orchestrator-${EnvironmentName}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref AgentCoreBaseManagedPolicy

  # ============================================================================
  # Gateway: StudentServicesGateway (Cognito only, no execution role)
  # ============================================================================
  GatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub student-services-gateway-${EnvironmentName}
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true

  GatewayUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub gateway-${AWS::AccountId}-${EnvironmentName}
      UserPoolId: !Ref GatewayUserPool

  GatewayResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: https://gateway.student-services.local
      Name: GatewayResourceServer
      UserPoolId: !Ref GatewayUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: access
          ScopeDescription: Access scope for Student Services Gateway

  GatewayAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: GatewayResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub student-services-gateway-client-${EnvironmentName}
      UserPoolId: !Ref GatewayUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 CloudWatch Log-based Monitoring Controls

Metadata:
  LogsInsightsQueries:
    CIS31UnauthorizedAPICalls: |
      fields @timestamp, eventTime, eventSource, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, errorCode, errorMessage
      | filter (errorCode like /.*UnauthorizedOperation/ or errorCode like /AccessDenied.*/)
      | sort @timestamp desc
      | limit 100
    CIS32ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA: |
      fields @timestamp, eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, additionalEventData.MFAUsed
      | filter eventName = 'ConsoleLogin' and additionalEventData.MFAUsed != 'Yes'
      | sort @timestamp desc
      | limit 100
    CIS33RootAccountUsage: |
      fields @timestamp, eventTime, eventName, eventSource, userIdentity.type, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress
      | filter userIdentity.type = 'Root' and not ispresent(userIdentity.invokedBy) and eventType != 'AwsServiceEvent'
      | sort @timestamp desc
      | limit 100
    CIS34IAMPolicyChanges: |
      fields @timestamp, eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.policyArn, requestParameters.roleName, requestParameters.userName, requestParameters.groupName
      | filter eventName in ['DeleteGroupPolicy', 'DeleteRolePolicy', 'DeleteUserPolicy', 'PutGroupPolicy', 'PutRolePolicy', 'PutUserPolicy', 'CreatePolicy', 'DeletePolicy', 'CreatePolicyVersion', 'DeletePolicyVersion', 'AttachRolePolicy', 'DetachRolePolicy', 'AttachUserPolicy', 'DetachUserPolicy', 'AttachGroupPolicy', 'DetachGroupPolicy']
      | sort @timestamp desc
      | limit 100
    CIS35CloudTrailChanges: |
      fields @timestamp, eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.name, sourceIPAddress
      | filter eventName in ['CreateTrail', 'UpdateTrail', 'DeleteTrail', 'StartLogging', 'StopLogging']
      | sort @timestamp desc

Resources:

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer Managed Key for CIS Log-based Monitoring CloudWatch Logs and SNS Topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
          - Sid: AllowSNSAndCloudWatchAlarmsKeyUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - 'cloudwatch.amazonaws.com'
                - 'sns.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: '*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/cis-monitoring-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  CisLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  SnsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: cis-monitoring-alarms
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  SnsTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref SnsTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'cloudwatch.amazonaws.com'
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref SnsTopic
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:*'

  # CIS 3.1: Unauthorized API calls
  FilterCIS31UnauthorizedAPICalls:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter

      FilterPattern: '{ ($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*") }'

          MetricName: UnauthorizedAPICallsCount
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0

    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Automated Security Hub deployment across AWS Organization via Control Tower lifecycle events and Systems Manager Automation.

Parameters:
  AuditAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS Account ID of the designated Security / Audit Account.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Default: '111122223333'
  LogArchiveAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS Account ID of the Log Archive Account.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Default: '444455556666'

Resources:
  AuditAccountIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /superwerker/audit_account_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref AuditAccountId
      Description: Account ID for the designated Security Hub delegated administrator (Audit Account)

  LogArchiveAccountIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /superwerker/log_archive_account_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref LogArchiveAccountId
      Description: Account ID for the centralized Log Archive Account

  SecurityHubAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub SecurityHub-Automation-Role-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecurityHubAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SSMParameterAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/superwerker/*
              - Sid: OrganizationsManagementAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:DescribeOrganization
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:ListRoots
                  - organizations:EnableAWSServiceAccess
                  - organizations:RegisterDelegatedAdministrator
                  - organizations:ListDelegatedAdministrators
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SecurityHubOrganizationAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:EnableOrganizationAdminAccount
                  - securityhub:DisableOrganizationAdminAccount
                  - securityhub:ListOrganizationAdminAccounts
                  - securityhub:DescribeOrganizationConfiguration
                  - securityhub:UpdateOrganizationConfiguration
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AssumeControlTowerExecution
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/AWSControlTowerExecution

  SecurityHubEnablementDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub Superwerker-EnableSecurityHub-${AWS::Region}
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables Security Hub delegated admin, auto-enablement, and enables Security Hub in member accounts.
        parameters:
          TargetAccountId:
            type: String
            default: ''
            description: Optional target account ID to enable Security Hub for. If empty, processes audit, log archive, and organization members.
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetConfigurationParameters
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    ssm_client = boto3.client('ssm')
                    audit_resp = ssm_client.get_parameter(Name='/superwerker/audit_account_id')
                    audit_account_id = audit_resp['Parameter']['Value']
                    log_archive_resp = ssm_client.get_parameter(Name='/superwerker/log_archive_account_id')
                    log_archive_account_id = log_archive_resp['Parameter']['Value']
                    return {
                        'AuditAccountId': audit_account_id,
                        'LogArchiveAccountId': log_archive_account_id
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: AuditAccountId
                Selector: $.Payload.AuditAccountId
                Type: String
              - Name: LogArchiveAccountId
                Selector: $.Payload.LogArchiveAccountId
                Type: String

          - name: ConfigureDelegatedAdmin
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{GetConfigurationParameters.AuditAccountId}}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    audit_account_id = events['AuditAccountId']
                    sh_client = boto3.client('securityhub')

                    # Enable delegated admin
                    try:
                        sh_client.enable_organization_admin_account(
                            AdminAccountId=audit_account_id
                        )
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] not in ['ResourceConflictException', 'InvalidInputException']:
                            raise e

                    return {'Status': 'DelegatedAdminConfigured'}

          - name: ConfigureAuditAndMembers
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{GetConfigurationParameters.AuditAccountId}}'
                LogArchiveAccountId: '{{GetConfigurationParameters.LogArchiveAccountId}}'
                TargetAccountId: '{{TargetAccountId}}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import os
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def assume_ct_role(account_id):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    partition = sts.get_caller_identity()['Arn'].split(':')[1]
                    role_arn = f"arn:{partition}:iam::{account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution"
                    resp = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=role_arn,
                        RoleSessionName="SSMSecurityHubAutomation"
                    )
                    return boto3.Session(
                        aws_access_key_id=resp['Credentials']['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=resp['Credentials']['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=resp['Credentials']['SessionToken'],
                        region_name=os.environ.get('AWS_REGION', 'us-east-1')
                    )

                def enable_hub_in_account(session):
                    sh = session.client('securityhub')
                    try:
                        sh.enable_security_hub(
                            EnableDefaultStandards=True
                        )
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] not in ['ResourceConflictException', 'InvalidInputException']:
                            raise e

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    audit_account = events['AuditAccountId']
                    log_archive_account = events['LogArchiveAccountId']
                    target_account = events.get('TargetAccountId', '').strip()

                    # 1. Enable Security Hub in Audit Account
                    audit_session = assume_ct_role(audit_account)
                    enable_hub_in_account(audit_session)

                    audit_sh = audit_session.client('securityhub')

                    # 2. Configure organization auto-enable in Audit account
                    try:
                        audit_sh.update_organization_configuration(
                            AutoEnable=True,
                            AutoEnableStandards='DEFAULT'
                        )
                    except ClientError as e:
                        print(f"Update organization config notice: {e}")

                    # 3. Identify accounts to onboard
                    accounts_to_process = []
                    if target_account:
                        accounts_to_process.append(target_account)
                    else:
                        accounts_to_process.append(log_archive_account)
                        # List all active member accounts in the organization
                        org_client = boto3.client('organizations')
                        paginator = org_client.get_paginator('list_accounts')
                        for page in paginator.paginate():
                            for acct in page['Accounts']:
                                if acct['Status'] == 'ACTIVE' and acct['Id'] != audit_account:
                                    if acct['Id'] not in accounts_to_process:
                                        accounts_to_process.append(acct['Id'])

                    # 4. Enable Security Hub in accounts and create member association
                    for acct_id in accounts_to_process:
                        if acct_id == audit_account:
                            continue
                        try:
                            target_session = assume_ct_role(acct_id)
                            enable_hub_in_account(target_session)
                        except Exception as ex:
                            print(f"Could not enable hub directly in {acct_id}: {ex}")

                        try:
                            # Register member in delegated administrator
                            audit_sh.create_members(
                                AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': acct_id}]
                            )
                        except ClientError as err:
                            if err.response['Error']['Code'] not in ['ResourceConflictException', 'InvalidInputException']:
                                print(f"Create member error for {acct_id}: {err}")

                    return {'Status': 'Completed', 'ProcessedCount': len(accounts_to_process)}

  EventBridgeAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub SecurityHub-EventBridge-Role-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ExecuteSSMAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartAutomationExecution
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubEnablementDocument}:$DEFAULT

  LandingZoneLifecycleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: ControlTower-LandingZone-SecurityHub-Setup
      Description: Triggers Security Hub organization-wide automation when Landing Zone setup or update succeeds.
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - AWS Service Event via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventName:
            - SetupLandingZone
            - UpdateLandingZone
            - ResetLandingZone
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubEnablementDocument}:$DEFAULT
          Id: LandingZoneSecurityHubTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeAutomationRole.Arn

  AccountFactoryLifecycleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: ControlTower-AccountFactory-SecurityHub-Setup
      Description: Triggers Security Hub automation when a new account is provisioned or updated via Control Tower.
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - AWS Service Event via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventName:
            - CreateManagedAccount
            - UpdateManagedAccount
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubEnablementDocument}:$DEFAULT
          Id: AccountFactorySecurityHubTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeAutomationRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              targetAccount: $.detail.serviceEventDetails.createManagedAccountStatus.account.accountId
            InputTemplate: '{"TargetAccountId": [<targetAccount>]}'

Outputs:
  SSMAutomationDocumentArn:
    Description: ARN of the SSM Automation Document for Security Hub enablement
    Value: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${SecurityHubEnablementDocument}

  SecurityHubAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM Role assumed by Systems Manager Automation
    Value: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationRole.Arn

  EventBridgeAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM Role assumed by EventBridge to start SSM Automation
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeAutomationRole.Arn

  LandingZoneLifecycleRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge Rule for Landing Zone setup/update lifecycle events
    Value: !GetAtt LandingZoneLifecycleRule.Arn

  AccountFactoryLifecycleRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge Rule for Account Factory lifecycle events
    Value: !GetAtt AccountFactoryLifecycleRule.Arn

  AuditAccountIdParameterName:
    Description: SSM Parameter path for Audit Account ID
    Value: !Ref AuditAccountIdParameter

  LogArchiveAccountIdParameterName:
    Description: SSM Parameter path for Log Archive Account ID
    Value: !Ref LogArchiveAccountIdParameter
