AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SQS testing infrastructure with KMS encryption, multiple FIFO and standard queues with DLQs, and CloudWatch alarms.

Resources:
  QueueKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS CMK for SQS queues encryption and CloudWatch monitoring
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: KeyPolicyForSQS
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSQSandCloudWatchService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sqs.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'

  QueueKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/sqs-testing-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref QueueKmsKey

  StandaloneFifoQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standalone-queue.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueKmsKey

  FifoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueKmsKey

  FifoQueueWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-primary-fifo-queue.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueKmsKey
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoDlq.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  StandardDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-dlq'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueKmsKey

  StandardQueueWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueKmsKey
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardDlq.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  SeparateFifoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-separate-fifo-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueKmsKey

  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StandardQueue-MessagesSent'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor standard queue number of messages sent (sum >= 1) breaching on missing data
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName

  FifoQueueAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FifoQueue-MessagesSent-Anomaly'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor FIFO queue with DLQ average number of messages sent using anomaly detection
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      TreatMissingData: missing
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          ReturnData: true
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlq.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
        - Id: ad1
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)
          ReturnData: true

  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StandardQueue-SentMessageSize'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor standard queue maximum sent message size threshold 183500 bytes
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName

  SeparateFifoSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SeparateFifo-SentMessageSize'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor separate FIFO queue maximum sent message size threshold 183500 bytes
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName

  StandardDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StandardDlq-VisibleMessages'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor standard DLQ sum of visible messages alerting when greater than zero
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDlq.QueueName

  FifoDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FifoDlq-VisibleMessages'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor FIFO DLQ sum of visible messages alerting when greater than zero
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoDlq.QueueName

  StandardQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StandardQueue-OldestMessageAge'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor standard queue maximum age of oldest message with threshold 15 treating missing data
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName

  SeparateFifoOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SeparateFifo-OldestMessageAge'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor separate FIFO queue maximum age of oldest message with threshold 15 treating missing data
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName

  StandardQueueNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StandardQueue-NotVisibleMessages'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor standard queue maximum number of messages not visible with threshold 108000
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 108000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName

  SeparateFifoNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SeparateFifo-NotVisibleMessages'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor separate FIFO queue maximum number of messages not visible with threshold 18000
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 18000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName

  StandardDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StandardDlq-OldestMessageAge'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor standard DLQ maximum age of oldest message with threshold 90

      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 90

      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDlq.QueueName

  SyntheticAlwaysOkAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SyntheticAlwaysOK'

      Threshold: 1000000000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Infrastructure for a private Red Hat OpenShift on AWS (ROSA) cluster using AWS
  PrivateLink, dedicated Egress VPC, AWS Transit Gateway, optional VPC Flow Logs with KMS encryption,
  and optional Elastic Load Balancing Service-Linked Role.

Parameters:
  AvailabilityZonesCount:
    Type: String
    Default: '3'
    AllowedValues:
      - '1'
      - '3'
    Description: Number of Availability Zones for the ROSA cluster VPC subnets (1 for Single-AZ, 3 for Multi-AZ).

  RosaVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    Description: CIDR block for the private ROSA cluster VPC.

  RosaSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA Private Subnet 1 (AZ 1).

  RosaSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA Private Subnet 2 (AZ 2 - Multi-AZ only).

  RosaSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA Private Subnet 3 (AZ 3 - Multi-AZ only).

  EgressVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    Description: CIDR block for the centralized Egress VPC.

  EgressPublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    Description: CIDR block for the Egress VPC Public Subnet (NAT Gateway and Internet Gateway).

  EgressPrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    Description: CIDR block for the Egress VPC Private Subnet (Transit Gateway Attachment).

  CreateELBServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing Service-Linked Role (set to false if already created in this account).

  EnableVPCFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to enable VPC Flow Logs for ROSA and Egress VPCs, delivered to CloudWatch Logs encrypted with a KMS customer managed key.

Conditions:
  IsMultiAZ: !Equals [!Ref AvailabilityZonesCount, '3']
  ShouldCreateELBRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateELBServiceLinkedRole, 'true']
  ShouldEnableFlowLogs: !Equals [!Ref EnableVPCFlowLogs, 'true']

Resources:
  ELBServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Condition: ShouldCreateELBRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
      Description: Service-linked role for Elastic Load Balancing used by ROSA.

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Key for encrypting VPC Flow Logs delivered to CloudWatch Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: flowlogs-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/vpc-flow-logs-rosa
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsPublishPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc-flow-logs/*

  RosaFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc-flow-logs/rosa-vpc-${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  EgressFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc-flow-logs/egress-vpc-${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  RosaVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-vpc
        - Key: rosa-cluster
          Value: 'true'

  RosaVPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt RosaFlowLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      ResourceId: !Ref RosaVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-vpc-flow-log

  RosaSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-az1
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  RosaSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-az2
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  RosaSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-az3
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  RosaPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-rt

  RosaSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable

  RosaSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable

  RosaSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable

  EgressVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-vpc

  EgressVPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt EgressFlowLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-vpc-flow-log

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-public-az1

  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-public-rt

  EgressPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable

  EgressPublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-nat-gw

  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-private-az1

  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-private-rt

  EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable

  EgressPrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: Transit Gateway connecting ROSA VPC to Egress VPC
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-tgw

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-tgw-rt

  RosaTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      SubnetIds: !If
        - IsMultiAZ
        - - !Ref RosaSubnet1
          - !Ref RosaSubnet2
          - !Ref RosaSubnet3
        - - !Ref RosaSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-tgw-attachment-rosa

  EgressTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-tgw-attachment-egress

  RosaTgwRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment

  EgressTgwRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

  TgwRouteToInternetViaEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

  TgwRouteToRosaVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment

  RosaDefaultRouteToTgw:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  EgressRouteToRosaViaTgw:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: EgressTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

Outputs:
  RosaVpcId:
    Description: Identifier of the ROSA cluster VPC
    Value: !Ref RosaVPC

  RosaVpcCidrBlock:
    Description: CIDR block of the ROSA cluster VPC
    Value: !GetAtt RosaVPC.CidrBlock

  RosaSubnet1Id:
    Description: Subnet ID of ROSA Private Subnet 1 (AZ 1)
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet1

  RosaSubnet2Id:
    Description: Subnet ID of ROSA Private Subnet 2 (AZ 2)
    Value: !If [IsMultiAZ, !Ref RosaSubnet2, 'N/A']

  RosaSubnet3Id:
    Description: Subnet ID of ROSA Private Subnet 3 (AZ 3)
    Value: !If [IsMultiAZ, !Ref RosaSubnet3, 'N/A']

  RosaSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of active ROSA Subnet IDs
    Value: !If
      - IsMultiAZ
      - !Sub ${RosaSubnet1},${RosaSubnet2},${RosaSubnet3}
      - !Ref RosaSubnet1

  EgressVpcId:
    Description: Identifier of the centralized Egress VPC
    Value: !Ref EgressVPC

  EgressPublicSubnetId:
    Description: Identifier of the Egress VPC Public Subnet
    Value: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet

  EgressPrivateSubnetId:
    Description: Identifier of the Egress VPC Private Subnet
    Value: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: Identifier of the Internet Gateway attached to the Egress VPC
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatGatewayId:
    Description: Identifier of the NAT Gateway in the Egress VPC
    Value: !Ref NatGateway

  NatGatewayElasticIP:
    Description: Public IP address of the NAT Gateway Elastic IP
    Value: !Ref NatGatewayEIP

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: Identifier of the AWS Transit Gateway
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway

  TransitGatewayRouteTableId:
    Description: Identifier of the Transit Gateway Route Table
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  RosaTgwAttachmentId:
    Description: Identifier of the ROSA VPC Transit Gateway Attachment
    Value: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment

  EgressTgwAttachmentId:
    Description: Identifier of the Egress VPC Transit Gateway Attachment
    Value: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Prerequisite resources and AWS Systems Manager Automation remediation documents
  for automated remediation of PCI DSS compliance controls with outputs exported
  for AWS Config conformance packs.

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # Prerequisite 1: KMS Customer Master Key with Key Rotation Enabled
  # ============================================================================
  PCIPrerequisiteKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Customer Managed Key for PCI DSS automated remediation
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailEncrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:cloudtrail:arn': !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudtrail:*:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/*'

  PCIPrerequisiteKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/pci-dss-remediation-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref PCIPrerequisiteKmsKey

  # ============================================================================
  # Prerequisite 2: CloudWatch Logs Log Group for CloudTrail with 1827 Days Retention
  # ============================================================================
  PCICloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/cloudtrail/pci-dss-compliance-trail-logs
      RetentionInDays: 1827

  # ============================================================================
  # Prerequisite 3: IAM Role for CloudTrail to Deliver Logs to CloudWatch Logs
  # ============================================================================
  PCICloudTrailCWLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'PCICloudTrailToCloudWatchLogsRole-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCWLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/cloudtrail/pci-dss-compliance-trail-logs:*'

  # ============================================================================
  # Prerequisite 4: IAM Role for SSM Automations
  # ============================================================================
  PCISSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'PCISSMAutomationExecutionRole-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess'

  # ============================================================================
  # Remediation Document 1: Encrypt CloudTrail Trail with KMS & Integrate with CW
  # ============================================================================
  SSMDocumentEncryptCloudTrailTrail:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: !Sub 'PCI-Remediate-CloudTrail-EncryptAndCWLogs-${AWS::Region}'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Encrypts a specified CloudTrail trail with a KMS key and integrates with CloudWatch Logs.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: The name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail.
          KmsKeyId:
            type: String
            description: The KMS Key ID or ARN to encrypt CloudTrail log files.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group to which CloudTrail logs will be delivered.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that CloudTrail assumes to deliver logs to CloudWatch Logs.
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateCloudTrailConfiguration
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              KmsKeyId: '{{ KmsKeyId }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'

  # ============================================================================
  # Remediation Document 2: Enable KMS Key Rotation
  # ============================================================================
  SSMDocumentEnableKmsKeyRotation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: !Sub 'PCI-Remediate-KMS-EnableKeyRotation-${AWS::Region}'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables key rotation for a specified KMS Customer Master Key.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
          KeyId:
            type: String
            description: The Key ID, Key ARN, or Alias of the KMS key.
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableKeyRotation
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: '{{ KeyId }}'

  # ============================================================================
  # Remediation Document 3: Integrate CloudTrail with CloudWatch Logs
  # ============================================================================
  SSMDocumentIntegrateCloudTrailCloudWatch:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: !Sub 'PCI-Remediate-CloudTrail-CloudWatchIntegration-${AWS::Region}'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Integrates a specified CloudTrail trail with a CloudWatch Logs log group.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: The name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role for CloudTrail log delivery.
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrailWithCloudWatch
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'

  # ============================================================================
  # Remediation Document 4: Enforce PCI DSS IAM Password Policy
  # ============================================================================
  SSMDocumentUpdateIAMPasswordPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: !Sub 'PCI-Remediate-IAM-PasswordPolicy-${AWS::Region}'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Updates the account IAM password policy to meet PCI DSS requirements.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireSymbols: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
              HardExpiry: true
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24

  # ============================================================================
  # Remediation Document 5: Enable Log Validation, Multi-Region & CW for CloudTrail
  # ============================================================================
  SSMDocumentEnableCloudTrailLogValidation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: !Sub 'PCI-Remediate-CloudTrail-LogValidationAndMultiRegion-${AWS::Region}'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables log file validation, multi-region collection, and CloudWatch integration on a CloudTrail trail.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: The name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role for CloudTrail log delivery.
        mainSteps:
          - name: ConfigureCloudTrail
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'

  # ============================================================================
  # Remediation Document 6: Revoke All Rules on Default Security Group
  # ============================================================================
  SSMDocumentRevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: !Sub 'PCI-Remediate-EC2-RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules-${AWS::Region}'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Revokes all ingress and egress rules on a specified security group (e.g. default security group).
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the security group to revoke rules from.
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeRules
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: revoke_all_rules
              InputPayload:
                GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3

                def revoke_all_rules(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    group_id = events['GroupId']

                    response = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[group_id])
                    sg = response['SecurityGroups'][0]

                    ip_permissions = sg.get('IpPermissions', [])
                    if ip_permissions:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                            GroupId=group_id,
                            IpPermissions=ip_permissions
                        )

                    ip_permissions_egress = sg.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])
                    if ip_permissions_egress:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(
                            GroupId=group_id,
                            IpPermissions=ip_permissions_egress
                        )

                    return {
                        'StatusCode': 200,
                        'Message': f'Successfully revoked all ingress and egress rules for {group_id}'
                    }

  # ============================================================================
  # Remediation Document 7: Delete Specified Security Group
  # ============================================================================
  SSMDocumentDeleteSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: !Sub 'PCI-Remediate-EC2-DeleteSecurityGroup-${AWS::Region}'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Deletes a specified EC2 security group.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the security group to delete.
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteSecurityGroup
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DeleteSecurityGroup
              GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'

  # ============================================================================
  # Remediation Document 8: Release Unused Elastic IP Address
  # ============================================================================
  SSMDocumentReleaseElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: !Sub 'PCI-Remediate-EC2-ReleaseElasticIP-${AWS::Region}'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Releases an unused EC2 Elastic IP address using its Allocation ID.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: The Allocation ID of the Elastic IP address to release.
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseAddress
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'

  # ============================================================================
  # Remediation Document 9: Remove Hardcoded Credentials from CodeBuild Project
  # ============================================================================
  SSMDocumentRemoveCodeBuildEnvCredentials:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: !Sub 'PCI-Remediate-CodeBuild-RemoveCredentials-${AWS::Region}'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Removes AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variables from a CodeBuild project.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: The name of the AWS CodeBuild project.
        mainSteps:
          - name: SanitizeEnvironmentVariables
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: sanitize_env_vars
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: '{{ ProjectName }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3

                def sanitize_env_vars(events, context):
                    cb = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    project_name = events['ProjectName']

                    projects = cb.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])['projects']
                    if not projects:
                        raise ValueError(f"Project {project_name} not found")

                    environment = projects[0]['environment']
                    env_vars = environment.get('environmentVariables', [])

                    filtered_vars = [
                        v for v in env_vars
                        if v.get('name') not in ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')
                    ]

                    environment['environmentVariables'] = filtered_vars
                    cb.update_project(
                        name=project_name,
                        environment=environment
                    )

                    return {
                        'StatusCode': 200,
                        'Message': f'Successfully removed sensitive credentials from {project_name}'
                    }

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Telemetry monitoring stack for Claude Desktop (CoWork) usage, token consumption, cost analysis, and CloudWatch dashboard.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /cowork/claude-desktop/telemetry
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group to receive Claude Desktop CoWork telemetry events.

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]
    Description: Retention period in days for the telemetry log events.

  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: ClaudeDesktop-Telemetry-Dashboard
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Dashboard to visualize CoWork metrics and analytics.

  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
    Description: CloudWatch metric namespace for extracted CoWork telemetry metrics.

  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: AWS region where metric data and dashboard widgets will be evaluated.

Resources:
  CoWorkLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  MetricFilterSchemaAInputTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterName: CoWork-SchemaA-InputTokens
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.event_type = "agent_turn" || $.type = "agent_turn") && ($.usage.input_tokens IS TRUE || $.usage.prompt_tokens IS TRUE) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricValue: $.usage.input_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  MetricFilterSchemaBInputTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterName: CoWork-SchemaB-InputTokens
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.schema = "claude_code" || $.client = "claude-code-desktop") && ($.metrics.input_tokens IS TRUE || $.tokens.input IS TRUE) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricValue: $.metrics.input_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  MetricFilterSchemaAOutputTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterName: CoWork-SchemaA-OutputTokens
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.event_type = "agent_turn" || $.type = "agent_turn") && ($.usage.output_tokens IS TRUE || $.usage.completion_tokens IS TRUE) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricValue: $.usage.output_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  MetricFilterSchemaBOutputTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterName: CoWork-SchemaB-OutputTokens
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.schema = "claude_code" || $.client = "claude-code-desktop") && ($.metrics.output_tokens IS TRUE || $.tokens.output IS TRUE) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricValue: $.metrics.output_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  MetricFilterSchemaACacheReadTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterName: CoWork-SchemaA-CacheReadTokens
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.event_type = "agent_turn" || $.type = "agent_turn") && $.usage.cache_read_input_tokens IS TRUE }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricValue: $.usage.cache_read_input_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  MetricFilterSchemaBCacheReadTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterName: CoWork-SchemaB-CacheReadTokens
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.schema = "claude_code" || $.client = "claude-code-desktop") && ($.metrics.cache_read_tokens IS TRUE || $.tokens.cache_read IS TRUE) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricValue: $.metrics.cache_read_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  MetricFilterSchemaACacheCreationTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterName: CoWork-SchemaA-CacheCreationTokens
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.event_type = "agent_turn" || $.type = "agent_turn") && $.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens IS TRUE }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricValue: $.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  MetricFilterSchemaBCacheCreationTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterName: CoWork-SchemaB-CacheCreationTokens
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.schema = "claude_code" || $.client = "claude-code-desktop") && ($.metrics.cache_creation_tokens IS TRUE || $.tokens.cache_creation IS TRUE) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricValue: $.metrics.cache_creation_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  MetricFilterSchemaAEstimatedCost:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterName: CoWork-SchemaA-EstimatedCost
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.event_type = "agent_turn" || $.type = "agent_turn") && $.cost.estimated_usd IS TRUE }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: EstimatedCost
          MetricValue: $.cost.estimated_usd
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: None

  MetricFilterSchemaBEstimatedCost:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterName: CoWork-SchemaB-EstimatedCost
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.schema = "claude_code" || $.client = "claude-code-desktop") && ($.metrics.cost_usd IS TRUE || $.cost.total IS TRUE) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: EstimatedCost
          MetricValue: $.metrics.cost_usd
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: None

  MetricFilterSchemaASessionTurns:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterName: CoWork-SchemaA-SessionTurns
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.event_type = "agent_turn" || $.type = "agent_turn") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: SessionTurns
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  MetricFilterSchemaBSessionTurns:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterName: CoWork-SchemaB-SessionTurns
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.schema = "claude_code" || $.client = "claude-code-desktop") && ($.turn_number IS TRUE || $.turn_count IS TRUE || $.event_type = "turn") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: SessionTurns
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  CoWorkTelemetryDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 6,
              "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "InputTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Input Tokens" } ],
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "OutputTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Output Tokens" } ]
                ],

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS CloudFormation template for the CDK bootstrap environment (modern bootstrap stack).
  Creates an encrypted S3 asset bucket, ECR repository, KMS key/alias, IAM roles for
  deployment, file publishing, image publishing, lookup, and CloudFormation execution,
  and an SSM parameter tracking the bootstrap version.

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: 'hnb659fds'
    Description: >-
      An identifier to distinguish multiple bootstrap stacks in the same environment.
      Must be between 1 and 10 alphanumeric characters.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9A-Z]{1,10}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be between 1 and 10 alphanumeric characters.

  FileAssetsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Name of the S3 bucket for file assets. Leave empty to automatically generate a unique bucket name.

  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated list of AWS Account IDs that may assume the deployment, file publishing,
      and image publishing roles.

  TrustedAccountsForLookup:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated list of AWS Account IDs that may assume the lookup role.

  CloudFormationExecutionPolicies:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated list of IAM Managed Policy ARNs to attach to the CloudFormation execution role.
      If empty, AdministratorAccess will be attached.

  ExistingKmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      ARN or Key ID of an existing KMS key to use for S3 file asset encryption. Leave empty to create a new KMS key.

Conditions:
  HasCustomFileAssetsBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketName, '']]
  UseExistingKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExistingKmsKeyId, '']]
  CreateNewKmsKey: !Not [!Condition UseExistingKmsKey]
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref TrustedAccounts], '']]
  HasTrustedAccountsForLookup: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref TrustedAccountsForLookup], '']]
  HasCloudFormationExecutionPolicies: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies], '']]

Resources:
  FileAssetsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateNewKmsKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Key used to encrypt CDK file assets for qualifier ${Qualifier}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: cdk-bootstrap-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  FileAssetsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/cdk-bootstrap-${Qualifier}-key'
      TargetKeyId: !If
        - CreateNewKmsKey
        - !Ref FileAssetsKey
        - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId

  StagingBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasCustomFileAssetsBucketName
        - !Ref FileAssetsBucketName
        - !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If
                - UseExistingKmsKey
                - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId
                - !GetAtt FileAssetsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  StagingBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref StagingBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt StagingBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${StagingBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  ContainerAssetsRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [
              {
                "rulePriority": 1,
                "description": "Prune untagged container images",
                "selection": {
                  "tagStatus": "untagged",
                  "countType": "sinceImagePushed",
                  "countUnit": "days",
                  "countNumber": 1
                },
                "action": {
                  "type": "expire"
                }
              }
            ]
          }

  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Ref TrustedAccounts
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cdk-file-publishing-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3Access
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject*'
                  - 's3:GetBucket*'
                  - 's3:GetEncryptionConfiguration'
                  - 's3:List*'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject*'
                  - 's3:PutObject*'
                  - 's3:Abort*'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt StagingBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${StagingBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: KMSAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                Resource: !If
                  - UseExistingKmsKey
                  - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsKey.Arn

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Ref TrustedAccounts
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cdk-image-publishing-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadOnlyECRAuth
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ecr:GetAuthorizationToken'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadWriteRepository
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability'
                  - 'ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer'
                  - 'ecr:BatchGetImage'
                  - 'ecr:PutImage'
                  - 'ecr:InitiateLayerUpload'
                  - 'ecr:UploadLayerPart'
                  - 'ecr:CompleteLayerUpload'
                  - 'ecr:DescribeRepositories'
                  - 'ecr:DescribeImages'
                Resource: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn

  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccountsForLookup
                - !Ref TrustedAccountsForLookup
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cdk-lookup-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DontReadSecrets
                Effect: Deny
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LookupReadOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudformation:DescribeStacks'
                  - 'cloudformation:GetTemplate'
                  - 'cloudformation:ListStackResources'
                  - 'ec2:Describe*'
                  - 'ssm:GetParameter'
                  - 'ssm:GetParameters'
                  - 'ssm:GetParametersByPath'
                  - 'ssm:DescribeParameters'
                  - 'route53:List*'
                  - 'route53:Get*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                  - 'kms:ListAliases'
                  - 'kms:ListKeys'
                Resource: '*'

  DeploymentActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Ref TrustedAccounts
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cdk-deploy-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudFormationActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudformation:CreateChangeSet'
                  - 'cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet'
                  - 'cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet'
                  - 'cloudformation:DescribeStacks'
                  - 'cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents'
                  - 'cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet'
                  - 'cloudformation:GetTemplate'
                  - 'cloudformation:DeleteStack'
                  - 'cloudformation:UpdateStack'
                  - 'cloudformation:CreateStack'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/*/*'
              - Sid: PassRoleToCloudFormation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
              - Sid: S3ReadWriteAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject*'
                  - 's3:GetBucket*'
                  - 's3:List*'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt StagingBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${StagingBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: KMSDecrypt
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !If
                  - UseExistingKmsKey
                  - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsKey.Arn

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - HasCloudFormationExecutionPolicies
        - !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies
        - - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cdk-asset-key-decrypt
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: KMSDecrypt
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !If
                  - UseExistingKmsKey
                  - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsKey.Arn

  BootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version'
      Description: CDK Bootstrap version
      Type: String
      Value: '21'

Outputs:
  BucketName:
    Description: The name of the S3 bucket owned by the CDK toolkit stack
    Value: !Ref StagingBucket

  FileAssetKeyArn:

  ImageRepositoryUri:

  FilePublishingRoleArn:

  ImagePublishingRoleArn:

    Description: The version of the bootstrap schema
    Value: !GetAtt BootstrapVersionParameter.Value

  BootstrapVersionParameterName:
    Description: The name of the SSM parameter storing the bootstrap schema version
    Value: !Ref BootstrapVersionParameter

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for Elastic Beanstalk supporting Blue-Green deployments with complete VPC infrastructure.

Parameters:
  CreateNewApplication:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a new Elastic Beanstalk Application. Set to false to reference an existing one.

  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'my-sample-eb-app'
    Description: Name of the Elastic Beanstalk Application to create or existing application name if CreateNewApplication is false.

  BlueEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'sample-eb-blue-env'
    Description: Name for the primary Blue Elastic Beanstalk Environment.

  DeployGreenEnvironment:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to deploy a temporary Green environment for Blue-Green deployment and testing.

  GreenEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'sample-eb-green-env'
    Description: Name for the temporary Green Elastic Beanstalk Environment.

  SolutionStack:
    Type: String
    Default: '64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v6.3.0 running Node.js 20'
    Description: Elastic Beanstalk solution stack to use.

  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: 't3.micro'
    Description: EC2 Instance Type for Elastic Beanstalk environments.

  CustomSourceBundleBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom S3 bucket containing the application bundle. If left blank, the standard sample application bucket for the region will be used.

  CustomSourceBundleKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom S3 key (path) for the application bundle. If left blank, the standard sample app zip will be used.

Conditions:
  IsCreateNewApplication: !Equals [!Ref CreateNewApplication, 'true']
  IsDeployGreenEnvironment: !Equals [!Ref DeployGreenEnvironment, 'true']
  UseCustomSourceBundle: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomSourceBundleBucket, '']]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Elastic Beanstalk instances and load balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          FromPort: -1
          ToPort: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-sg'

  EBInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWebTier
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWorkerTier
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkMulticontainerDocker
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-instance-role'

  EBInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: '/'
      Roles:
        - !Ref EBInstanceRole

  EBServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSElasticBeanstalkEnhancedHealth
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkManagedUpdatesCustomerRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-service-role'

  EBApplication:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application
    Condition: IsCreateNewApplication
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Elastic Beanstalk Application for Blue-Green Deployments

  EBApplicationVersion:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If [IsCreateNewApplication, !Ref EBApplication, !Ref ApplicationName]
      Description: Initial Application Version
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !If
          - UseCustomSourceBundle
          - !Ref CustomSourceBundleBucket
          - !Sub 'elasticbeanstalk-samples-${AWS::Region}'
        S3Key: !If
          - UseCustomSourceBundle
          - !Ref CustomSourceBundleKey
          - 'nodejs-sample.zip'

  BlueEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    DependsOn:
      - PublicRoute
      - PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation
      - PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If [IsCreateNewApplication, !Ref EBApplication, !Ref ApplicationName]
      EnvironmentName: !Ref BlueEnvironmentName
      Description: Blue (Active/Production) Environment
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStack
      VersionLabel: !Ref EBApplicationVersion
      Tier:
        Name: WebServer
        Type: Standard
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !GetAtt EBServiceRole.Arn
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref EBInstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: InstanceType
          Value: !Ref InstanceType
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: SecurityGroups
          Value: !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Sub '${PublicSubnet1},${PublicSubnet2}'
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: ELBSubnets
          Value: !Sub '${PublicSubnet1},${PublicSubnet2}'
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: AssociatePublicIpAddress
          Value: 'true'
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: EnvironmentType
          Value: LoadBalanced
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:healthreporting:system
          OptionName: SystemType
          Value: enhanced

  GreenEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Condition: IsDeployGreenEnvironment
    DependsOn:
      - PublicRoute
      - PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation
      - PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If [IsCreateNewApplication, !Ref EBApplication, !Ref ApplicationName]
      EnvironmentName: !Ref GreenEnvironmentName
      Description: Green (Staging/Candidate) Environment for Blue-Green Deployment
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStack
      VersionLabel: !Ref EBApplicationVersion
      Tier:
        Name: WebServer
        Type: Standard
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !GetAtt EBServiceRole.Arn
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref EBInstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: InstanceType
          Value: !Ref InstanceType
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: SecurityGroups
          Value: !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Sub '${PublicSubnet1},${PublicSubnet2}'
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: ELBSubnets
          Value: !Sub '${PublicSubnet1},${PublicSubnet2}'
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: AssociatePublicIpAddress
          Value: 'true'
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: EnvironmentType
          Value: LoadBalanced
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:healthreporting:system
          OptionName: SystemType
          Value: enhanced

Outputs:
  ApplicationNameOutput:
    Description: The Elastic Beanstalk Application Name
    Value: !If [IsCreateNewApplication, !Ref EBApplication, !Ref ApplicationName]

  BlueEnvironmentEndpoint:
    Description: URL endpoint of the Blue Elastic Beanstalk Environment
    Value: !GetAtt BlueEnvironment.EndpointURL

  BlueEnvironmentId:
    Description: Environment ID of the Blue Environment
    Value: !Ref BlueEnvironment

  GreenEnvironmentEndpoint:
    Condition: IsDeployGreenEnvironment
    Description: URL endpoint of the Green Elastic Beanstalk Environment
    Value: !GetAtt GreenEnvironment.EndpointURL

  GreenEnvironmentId:
    Condition: IsDeployGreenEnvironment
    Description: Environment ID of the Green Environment
    Value: !Ref GreenEnvironment
