final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Infrastructure stack for QuickSight Admin Console monitoring and metadata extraction
  pipeline using AWS Glue jobs, CloudWatch Metric Streams, Kinesis Data Firehose, and S3,
  with Customer Managed Key (CMK) encryption.

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket where Glue scripts are stored.
    Default: ''
  ScriptPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 prefix/path where Glue scripts are located (must end with a slash or be empty).
    Default: 'scripts/'

Conditions:
  CreateScriptBucket: !Equals [!Ref ScriptBucketName, '']

Resources:
  # Customer Managed Key (CMK) for S3 and pipeline encryption
  AdminSuiteKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer Managed Key for QuickSight Admin Suite S3 buckets and data pipeline
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: admin-suite-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowUnifiedRoleAndServicesUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowFirehoseServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'firehose.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'

  AdminSuiteKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/admin-suite-cmk-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminSuiteKmsKey

  # Internal script bucket created if ScriptBucketName parameter is not provided
  AdminSuiteScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: CreateScriptBucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-scripts-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  AdminSuiteScriptBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: CreateScriptBucket
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteScriptBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteScriptBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteScriptBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # Main admin suite storage bucket for output data and metric streams
  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  AdminSuiteBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # CloudWatch Log Group for Firehose error logging
  FirehoseLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/kinesisfirehose/admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  FirehoseLogStreamIngestion:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogStream
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup
      LogStreamName: 'ingestion-metrics'

  FirehoseLogStreamDashboard:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogStream
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup
      LogStreamName: 'dashboard-metrics'

  FirehoseLogStreamSpice:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogStream
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup
      LogStreamName: 'spice-metrics'

  FirehoseLogStreamQuickIndex:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogStream
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup
      LogStreamName: 'quickindex-metrics'

  FirehoseLogStreamAction:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogStream
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup
      LogStreamName: 'action-metrics'

  # Unified IAM Role for Glue, Firehose, CloudWatch Metric Streams, and CloudFormation
  AdminSuiteUnifiedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'admin-suite-unified-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AdminSuiteDataBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:AbortMultipartUpload'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:ListBucketMultipartUploads'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/*'
              - Sid: AdminSuiteScriptBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                Resource:
                  - !If
                    - CreateScriptBucket
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::admin-suite-scripts-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}'
                  - !If
                    - CreateScriptBucket
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::admin-suite-scripts-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*'
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/*'

        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteKmsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AdminSuiteKmsOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: '*'

        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteLoggingAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/kinesisfirehose/*'
                  - !GetAtt FirehoseLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FirehoseLogGroup.Arn}:*'

        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteQuickSightReadOnly
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightMetadataRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'quicksight:Describe*'
                  - 'quicksight:List*'
                  - 'quicksight:Search*'
                  - 'quicksight:Get*'
                Resource: '*'

        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteMetricStreamToFirehose
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchPutRecordsFirehose
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'firehose:PutRecord'
                  - 'firehose:PutRecordBatch'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/admin-suite-*'

        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteGlueOperations
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: GlueJobCatalogOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'glue:GetJob'
                  - 'glue:GetJobs'
                  - 'glue:GetJobRun'
                  - 'glue:GetJobRuns'
                  - 'glue:BatchStopJobRun'
                  - 'glue:GetDatabase'
                  - 'glue:GetDatabases'
                  - 'glue:GetTable'
                  - 'glue:GetTables'
                  - 'glue:GetPartitions'
                  - 'glue:CreateTable'
                  - 'glue:UpdateTable'
                  - 'glue:BatchCreatePartition'
                Resource: '*'

  # Firehose Delivery Streams
  FirehoseDeliveryStreamIngestion:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: 'admin-suite-firehose-ingestion'
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: 'metrics/ingestion/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/day=!{timestamp:dd}/hour=!{timestamp:HH}/'
        ErrorOutputPrefix: 'metrics-errors/ingestion/!{firehose:error-output-type}/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        CloudWatchLoggingOptions:
          Enabled: true
          LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup
          LogStreamName: !Ref FirehoseLogStreamIngestion

  FirehoseDeliveryStreamDashboard:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: 'admin-suite-firehose-dashboard'
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: 'metrics/dashboard/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/day=!{timestamp:dd}/hour=!{timestamp:HH}/'
        ErrorOutputPrefix: 'metrics-errors/dashboard/!{firehose:error-output-type}/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        CloudWatchLoggingOptions:
          Enabled: true
          LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup
          LogStreamName: !Ref FirehoseLogStreamDashboard

  FirehoseDeliveryStreamSpice:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: 'admin-suite-firehose-spice'
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: 'metrics/spice/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/day=!{timestamp:dd}/hour=!{timestamp:HH}/'
        ErrorOutputPrefix: 'metrics-errors/spice/!{firehose:error-output-type}/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        CloudWatchLoggingOptions:
          Enabled: true
          LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup
          LogStreamName: !Ref FirehoseLogStreamSpice

  FirehoseDeliveryStreamQuickIndex:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: 'admin-suite-firehose-quickindex'
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: 'metrics/quickindex/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/day=!{timestamp:dd}/hour=!{timestamp:HH}/'
        ErrorOutputPrefix: 'metrics-errors/quickindex/!{firehose:error-output-type}/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        CloudWatchLoggingOptions:
          Enabled: true
          LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup
          LogStreamName: !Ref FirehoseLogStreamQuickIndex

  FirehoseDeliveryStreamAction:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: 'admin-suite-firehose-action'
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: 'metrics/action/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/day=!{timestamp:dd}/hour=!{timestamp:HH}/'
        ErrorOutputPrefix: 'metrics-errors/action/!{firehose:error-output-type}/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        CloudWatchLoggingOptions:
          Enabled: true
          LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseLogGroup
          LogStreamName: !Ref FirehoseLogStreamAction

  # CloudWatch Metric Streams
  MetricStreamIngestion:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: 'admin-suite-stream-ingestion'
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseDeliveryStreamIngestion.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: 'AWS/QuickSight'
          MetricNames:
            - IngestionRowCount
            - IngestionLatency
            - IngestionInvocationCount
            - IngestionErrorCount

  MetricStreamDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: 'admin-suite-stream-dashboard'
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseDeliveryStreamDashboard.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: 'AWS/QuickSight'
          MetricNames:
            - VisualLoadTime
            - DashboardViewLoadTime
            - DashboardViewCount
            - VisualLoadErrorCount

  MetricStreamSpice:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: 'admin-suite-stream-spice'
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseDeliveryStreamSpice.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: 'AWS/QuickSight'
          MetricNames:
            - SPICECapacityLimitInMB
            - SPICECapacityConsumedInMB

  MetricStreamQuickIndex:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: 'admin-suite-stream-quickindex'
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseDeliveryStreamQuickIndex.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: 'AWS/QuickSight'
          MetricNames:
            - QuickIndexDocumentCount
            - QuickIndexExtractedTextSize

  MetricStreamAction:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: 'admin-suite-stream-action'
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseDeliveryStreamAction.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: 'AWS/QuickSight'
          MetricNames:
            - ActionInvocationError
            - ActionInvocationCount

  # Five Python Shell Glue Jobs (Glue 3.0, python3.9, maxConcurrentRuns: 1, timeout: 120)
  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: 'etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access'
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !If
          - CreateScriptBucket
          - !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptBucket}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
          - !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--destination_bucket': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--enable-observability-metrics': 'true'

  GlueJobAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: 'etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata'
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !If
          - CreateScriptBucket
          - !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptBucket}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py'
          - !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--destination_bucket': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--enable-observability-metrics': 'true'

  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: 'etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets'
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !If
          - CreateScriptBucket
          - !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptBucket}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py'
          - !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--destination_bucket': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--enable-observability-metrics': 'true'

  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: 'etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata'
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !If
          - CreateScriptBucket
          - !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptBucket}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py'
          - !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--destination_bucket': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--enable-observability-metrics': 'true'

  GlueJobQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: 'etl_job_admin_suite_q_access'
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !If
          - CreateScriptBucket
          - !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptBucket}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py'
          - !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--destination_bucket': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--enable-observability-metrics': 'true'

  # Two Spark ETL Glue Jobs (Glue 5.0, G.1X, 2 workers, maxRetries: 0, timeout: 120)
  GlueJobDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: 'etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties'
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: 'G.1X'
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !If
          - CreateScriptBucket
          - !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptBucket}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py'
          - !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': 'python'
        '--region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--destination_bucket': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'

  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: 'etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties'
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: 'G.1X'
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !If
          - CreateScriptBucket
          - !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptBucket}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py'
          - !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': 'python'
        '--region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless CRUD API for Kitten service with API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB.

Resources:
  KittenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: Kitten
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  KittenLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: KittenServiceLambdaRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KittenCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*:*'
        - PolicyName: KittenDynamoDBPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt KittenTable.Arn

  KittenFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: KittenServiceFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt KittenLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 256
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref KittenTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import uuid
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ.get('TABLE_NAME', 'Kitten')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          HEADERS = {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'
          }

          def respond(status_code, body):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status_code,
                  'headers': HEADERS,
                  'body': json.dumps(body)
              }

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              http_method = event.get('httpMethod', '')
              resource = event.get('resource', '')
              path_parameters = event.get('pathParameters') or {}
              kitten_id = path_parameters.get('id')

              try:
                  if http_method == 'POST' and resource == '/kitten':
                      body = event.get('body')
                      if not body:
                          return respond(400, {'message': 'Missing request body'})
                      data = json.loads(body)
                      name = data.get('name')
                      color = data.get('color')
                      if not name or not color:
                          return respond(400, {'message': "Fields 'name' and 'color' are required"})
                      
                      new_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                      item = {
                          'KittenId': new_id,
                          'name': str(name),
                          'color': str(color)
                      }
                      table.put_item(Item=item)
                      return respond(201, item)

                  elif http_method == 'GET' and resource == '/kitten':
                      response = table.scan()
                      items = response.get('Items', [])
                      while 'LastEvaluatedKey' in response:
                          response = table.scan(ExclusiveStartKey=response['LastEvaluatedKey'])
                          items.extend(response.get('Items', []))
                      return respond(200, items)

                  elif http_method == 'GET' and resource == '/kitten/{id}':
                      if not kitten_id:
                          return respond(400, {'message': 'Kitten id is required'})
                      response = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      item = response.get('Item')
                      if not item:
                          return respond(404, {'message': f'Kitten with id {kitten_id} not found'})
                      return respond(200, item)

                  elif http_method == 'PUT' and resource == '/kitten/{id}':
                      if not kitten_id:
                          return respond(400, {'message': 'Kitten id is required'})
                      body = event.get('body')
                      if not body:
                          return respond(400, {'message': 'Missing request body'})
                      data = json.loads(body)
                      name = data.get('name')
                      color = data.get('color')
                      if not name or not color:
                          return respond(400, {'message': "Fields 'name' and 'color' are required"})
                      item = {
                          'KittenId': kitten_id,
                          'name': str(name),
                          'color': str(color)
                      }
                      table.put_item(Item=item)
                      return respond(200, item)

                  elif http_method == 'DELETE' and resource == '/kitten/{id}':
                      if not kitten_id:
                          return respond(400, {'message': 'Kitten id is required'})
                      table.delete_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      return respond(200, {'message': f'Kitten {kitten_id} deleted successfully'})

                  else:
                      return respond(400, {'message': f'Unsupported route: {http_method} {resource}'})

              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return respond(400, {'message': 'Invalid JSON in request body'})
              except ClientError as e:
                  return respond(500, {'message': 'Database error', 'error': e.response['Error']['Message']})
              except Exception as e:
                  return respond(500, {'message': 'Internal server error', 'error': str(e)})

  KittenRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: KittenServiceApi
      Description: API for Kitten Service operations
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  KittenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt KittenRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: kitten

  KittenItemResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenRestApi
      ParentId: !Ref KittenResource
      PathPart: '{id}'

  KittenResourceOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'''*'''"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  KittenItemResourceOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenItemResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'''*'''"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  KittenPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${KittenFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  KittenGetAllMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${KittenFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  KittenGetItemMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenItemResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${KittenFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  KittenPutItemMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Step Functions Standard State Machine with version, alias, and multiple event-driven
  triggers including API Gateway REST API, EventBridge Rules, and EventBridge Scheduler.

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # Step Functions State Machine Resources
  # ============================================================================
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: |-
        {
          "Comment": "Standard workflow with a single Pass state returning 1",
          "StartAt": "ReturnOne",
          "States": {
            "ReturnOne": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": 1,
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

  StateMachineVersion:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineVersion
    Properties:
      StateMachineArn: !Ref StateMachine

  StateMachineAlias:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineAlias
    Properties:
      Name: PROD
      RoutingConfiguration:
        - StateMachineVersionArn: !Ref StateMachineVersion
          Weight: 100

  # ============================================================================
  # API Gateway Trigger Resources
  # ============================================================================
  ApiGatewayExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: StepFunctionsTriggerApi
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execute

  GetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayExecutionRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_TEMPLATES
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |-
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachineAlias}",
              "input": "{}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - GetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: prod

  # ============================================================================
  # EventBridge Rule Triggers Resources
  # ============================================================================
  EventBridgeRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  TerminatedStateRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Triggers state machine alias on execution terminated state changes
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.states
        detail-type:
          - Step Functions Execution Status Change
        detail:
          status:
            - FAILED
            - TIMED_OUT
            - ABORTED
      Targets:
        - Id: StepFunctionsTerminatedTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRuleRole.Arn

  ScheduledRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Scheduled rule running every minute (initially disabled)
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      State: DISABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: StepFunctionsScheduleTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRuleRole.Arn

  TagChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Triggers state machine alias on AWS Tag service events
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.tag
      Targets:
        - Id: StepFunctionsTagTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRuleRole.Arn

  # ============================================================================
  # EventBridge Scheduler Trigger Resources
  # ============================================================================
  SchedulerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: scheduler.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  OneMinuteSchedule:
    Type: AWS::Scheduler::Schedule
    Properties:
      Description: Schedule running every minute targeting the state machine alias
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      FlexibleTimeWindow:
        Mode: 'OFF'
      State: ENABLED
      Target:
        Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
        RoleArn: !GetAtt SchedulerRole.Arn
        Input: '{}'

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions State Machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine

  StateMachineAliasArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions State Machine Alias
    Value: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  ApiGatewayEndpointUrl:
    Description: Invocation URL for the GET method starting execution
    Value: !Sub https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/execute

              - eks:CreateNodegroup

              - eks:ListIdentityProviderConfigs

              - eks:ListUpdates

    Properties:

      Description: Read-only visibility into EKS clusters, node groups, add-ons, and workloads for human console users.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EKSReadOnlyPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:AccessKubernetesApi
              - eks:DescribeAddon
              - eks:DescribeAddonConfiguration
              - eks:DescribeAddonVersions
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
              - eks:DescribeIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeUpdate
              - eks:ListAddons
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:ListFargateProfiles
              - eks:ListIdentityProviderConfigs
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:ListUpdates
            Resource: '*'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. IAM Role: EKS Control Plane Service Role
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-eks-control-plane-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by the Amazon EKS managed service.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. IAM Role & Instance Profile: Self-Managed / Hybrid Control Plane Role
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-control-plane-role'
      Description: IAM role for EC2 instances hosting the Kubernetes control plane.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InTreeCloudProviderPolicy
        - !Ref NodeOperationsPolicy
        - !Ref ControllersPolicy
        - !Ref EKSManagementPolicy

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-control-plane-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 8. IAM Role & Instance Profile: Cluster Worker Nodes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WorkerNodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-nodes-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by EC2 cluster worker nodes.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref NodeOperationsPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly

  WorkerNodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-nodes-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref WorkerNodesRole

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 9. IAM Role & Instance Profile: CAPA Controllers (EC2 & Pod Identity Assumable)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-controllers-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by CAPA controller pods or EC2 instances to manage cluster infrastructure.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControllersPolicy
        - !Ref EKSManagementPolicy

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-controllers-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  InTreeCloudProviderPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the In-Tree Cloud Provider customer managed policy.
    Value: !Ref InTreeCloudProviderPolicy

  NodeOperationsPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the Node Operations customer managed policy.
    Value: !Ref NodeOperationsPolicy

  ControllersPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA Controllers customer managed policy.
    Value: !Ref ControllersPolicy

  EKSManagementPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS Management customer managed policy.

  EKSReadOnlyPolicyArn:

  ControlPlaneRoleArn:

    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneRole.Arn

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the control plane instance profile.
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneInstanceProfile.Arn

  WorkerNodesRoleArn:

    Value: !GetAtt ControllersRole.Arn

  ControllersInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA controllers instance profile.
    Value: !GetAtt ControllersInstanceProfile.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready VPC foundation with public/private subnets across two AZs, dual NAT Gateways, VPC Flow Logs, S3 Gateway Endpoint, and ECR Interface Endpoints.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.20.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.

  FlowLogsRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention period in days for VPC Flow Logs.

  FlowLogsTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    AllowedValues:
      - ALL
      - ACCEPT

    Properties:

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VPCFlowLog:

      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogsTrafficType
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-log'

      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints allowing internal VPC HTTPS traffic
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS inbound from within VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS outbound to within VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-endpoint-sg'

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

      SubnetIds:

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  VPC with KerberosEMRonEKS prefix supporting Microsoft AD, including public/private
  subnets, dual NAT Gateways, KMS-encrypted VPC Flow Logs, and Interface VPC Endpoints.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.64/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.128/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.192/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet2

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGateway1EIP

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGateway2EIP

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGateway1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGateway2

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicRouteTable

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting KerberosEMRonEKS VPC Flow Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: flowlogs-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogsKey
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flowlogs/KerberosEMRonEKS
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLog

  EndpointsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints restricting traffic to HTTPS
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/24
          Description: Allow HTTPS inbound from VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/24
          Description: Allow HTTPS outbound to VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-EndpointsSG

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-SSMEndpoint

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-SSMMessagesEndpoint

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-EC2MessagesEndpoint

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-SecretsManagerEndpoint

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EndpointsSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security Group ID for VPC Endpoints
    Value: !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup

  FlowLogsLogGroupArn:
    Description: CloudWatch Log Group ARN for VPC Flow Logs
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  FlowLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS Key ARN used for Flow Logs encryption
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Fully self-contained greenfield CloudFormation template for a VPC-only SageMaker Domain with a test user profile, dedicated IAM execution role, KMS customer-managed key, VPC, subnets, security group, and KMS-encrypted default S3 bucket.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: sagemaker-vpc-domain
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Domain.

  TestUserName:
    Type: String
    Default: test-user
    Description: Name of the initial test user profile in the SageMaker Domain.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the SageMaker Domain VPC.

  Subnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Subnet 1.

  Subnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Subnet 2.

Resources:
  # KMS Key for S3 Bucket Encryption
  SageMakerKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key for SageMaker artifacts S3 bucket encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerServiceUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  SageMakerKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${DomainName}-s3-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SageMakerKmsKey

  # S3 Storage Bucket encrypted with Customer Managed KMS Key
  SageMakerArtifactsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt SageMakerKmsKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  # Networking: VPC & Subnets
  SageMakerVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-vpc'

  SageMakerSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-subnet-1'

  SageMakerSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-subnet-2'

  SageMakerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker Studio Domain users
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-studio-sg'

  SageMakerSecurityGroupIngressSelf:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref SageMakerSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: '-1'
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref SageMakerSecurityGroup

  # IAM Execution Role
  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${DomainName}-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerStudioUserPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerJobManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJobV2
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJobV2
                  - sagemaker:StopAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:ListAutoMLJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:training-job/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:processing-job/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transform-job/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automl-job/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:hyper-parameter-tuning-job/*'

              - Sid: SageMakerExperimentsAndLineage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:UpdateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DeleteExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:AddTags
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTags
                  - sagemaker:ListTags
                  - sagemaker:AssociateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DisassociateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:CreateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:DescribeArtifact
                  - sagemaker:UpdateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:DeleteArtifact
                  - sagemaker:ListArtifacts
                  - sagemaker:CreateContext
                  - sagemaker:DescribeContext
                  - sagemaker:UpdateContext
                  - sagemaker:DeleteContext
                  - sagemaker:ListContexts
                  - sagemaker:CreateAction
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAction
                  - sagemaker:UpdateAction
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAction
                  - sagemaker:ListActions
                  - sagemaker:AddAssociation
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAssociation
                  - sagemaker:ListAssociations
                  - sagemaker:QueryLineage
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment-trial/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment-trial-component/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:artifact/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:context/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:action/*'

              - Sid: SageMakerModelManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-package/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-package-group/*'

              - Sid: SageMakerStudioAppsAndSpaces
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                  - sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:domain/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/*/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:app/*/*/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:space/*/*'

              - Sid: SageMakerPassRoleToService
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${DomainName}-execution-role'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com

              - Sid: S3BucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !GetAtt SageMakerArtifactsBucket.Arn

              - Sid: S3ObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub '${SageMakerArtifactsBucket.Arn}/*'

              - Sid: KMSAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt SageMakerKmsKey.Arn

              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                Resource: '*'

              - Sid: ECRReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: '*'

  # SageMaker Domain
  SageMakerDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
