AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  AWS CloudFormation template defining Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights saved queries
  and a dedicated CloudWatch Log Group for analyzing usage, performance, cost, and
  operational metrics generated by Claude Code applications.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/claude-code/metrics
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Log Group containing Claude Code telemetry and metric logs.
    AllowedPattern: '^/[a-zA-Z0-9_\.\-]+(/[a-zA-Z0-9_\.\-]+)*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid log group path starting with '/' and containing valid characters.

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Number of days to retain Claude Code metric logs in CloudWatch Logs.
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Log Group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ClaudeCodeLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Real-Time Monitoring Queries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryRealTimeTokenConsumptionRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RealTime/01-TokenConsumptionRatePerUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | stats sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0) + coalesce(outputTokens, 0)) as totalTokens,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0)) as promptTokens,
                sum(coalesce(outputTokens, 0)) as completionTokens
          by bin(1m) as timeWindow, userId
        | sort timeWindow desc, totalTokens desc
        | limit 100

  QueryRealTimeRequestRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RealTime/02-RequestRatePerUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, @requestId
        | stats count(@requestId) as requestCount,
                count_distinct(sessionId) as activeSessions
          by bin(1m) as timeWindow, userId
        | sort timeWindow desc, requestCount desc
        | limit 100

  QueryRealTimeCurrentTpmRpmAverages:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RealTime/03-OverallCurrentTpmRpmAverages
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, totalTokens, @requestId
        | stats sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0) + coalesce(outputTokens, 0)) as tokensPerMinute,
                count(@requestId) as requestsPerMinute,
                count_distinct(userId) as activeUsersPerMinute
          by bin(1m) as minuteWindow
        | sort minuteWindow desc
        | limit 60

  QueryRealTimeRateLimitRisk:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RealTime/04-RateLimitRiskDetection
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, modelId, statusCode, errorCode, errorMessage
        | filter statusCode == 429 or ispresent(errorCode) or errorCode like /RateLimit|Throttl/
        | stats count(*) as throttledRequests,
                latest(errorMessage) as sampleErrorMessage
          by bin(1m) as timeWindow, userId, modelId, errorCode
        | sort timeWindow desc, throttledRequests desc
        | limit 100

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User and Session Analytics Queries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryAnalyticsSessionLevelUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Analytics/01-SessionLevelUsageBreakdown
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields sessionId, userId, modelId, inputTokens, outputTokens, durationMs
        | stats count(*) as interactionCount,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0)) as totalInputTokens,
                sum(coalesce(outputTokens, 0)) as totalOutputTokens,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0) + coalesce(outputTokens, 0)) as totalTokens,
                min(@timestamp) as sessionStart,
                max(@timestamp) as sessionEnd,
                (max(@timestamp) - min(@timestamp)) / 1000 as sessionDurationSec,
                avg(coalesce(durationMs, 0)) as avgLatencyMs
          by sessionId, userId
        | sort totalTokens desc
        | limit 100

  QueryAnalyticsHourlyActivityTimeline:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Analytics/02-HourlyActivityTimeline
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, inputTokens, outputTokens, userId, sessionId
        | stats count(*) as totalInvocations,
                count_distinct(userId) as uniqueUsers,
                count_distinct(sessionId) as uniqueSessions,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0)) as inputTokens,
                sum(coalesce(outputTokens, 0)) as outputTokens,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0) + coalesce(outputTokens, 0)) as totalTokens
          by bin(1h) as hourWindow
        | sort hourWindow desc
        | limit 168

  QueryAnalyticsErrorAndThrottlingDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Analytics/03-ErrorAndThrottlingDetection
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, sessionId, modelId, statusCode, errorCode, errorMessage
        | filter statusCode >= 400 or ispresent(errorCode)
        | stats count(*) as errorCount,
                latest(errorMessage) as lastError
          by modelId, userId, statusCode, errorCode
        | sort errorCount desc
        | limit 100

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cost and Attribution Reporting Queries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryCostAttributionByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Cost/01-UsageAndCostByUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields userId, inputTokens, outputTokens, estimatedCostUsd
        | stats count(*) as requestCount,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0)) as totalPromptTokens,
                sum(coalesce(outputTokens, 0)) as totalCompletionTokens,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0) + coalesce(outputTokens, 0)) as totalTokens,
                sum(coalesce(estimatedCostUsd, 0)) as totalEstimatedCostUsd
          by userId
        | sort totalEstimatedCostUsd desc, totalTokens desc
        | limit 100

  QueryCostAttributionByModel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Cost/02-UsageAndCostByModel
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields modelId, inputTokens, outputTokens, estimatedCostUsd
        | stats count(*) as requestCount,
                count_distinct(userId) as uniqueUsers,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0)) as totalPromptTokens,
                sum(coalesce(outputTokens, 0)) as totalCompletionTokens,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0) + coalesce(outputTokens, 0)) as totalTokens,
                sum(coalesce(estimatedCostUsd, 0)) as totalEstimatedCostUsd,
                avg(coalesce(durationMs, 0)) as avgResponseTimeMs
          by modelId
        | sort totalEstimatedCostUsd desc, totalTokens desc

  QueryCostAttributionByOrganization:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Cost/03-CostAttributionByOrganization
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields organizationId, teamId, projectId, inputTokens, outputTokens, estimatedCostUsd
        | stats count(*) as requestCount,
                count_distinct(userId) as activeDevelopers,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0) + coalesce(outputTokens, 0)) as totalTokens,
                sum(coalesce(estimatedCostUsd, 0)) as totalCostUsd
          by coalesce(organizationId, "default-org") as org,
             coalesce(teamId, "unassigned-team") as team,
             coalesce(projectId, "unassigned-project") as project
        | sort totalCostUsd desc
        | limit 100

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Performance, Latency, and Cache Efficiency Queries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryPerformanceModelEfficiency:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Performance/01-ModelEfficiencyAndLatency
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields modelId, durationMs, outputTokens, timeToFirstTokenMs
        | filter ispresent(durationMs)
        | stats count(*) as sampleSize,
                pct(durationMs, 50) as p50DurationMs,
                pct(durationMs, 90) as p90DurationMs,
                pct(durationMs, 99) as p99DurationMs,
                avg(durationMs) as avgDurationMs,
                pct(timeToFirstTokenMs, 50) as p50TimeToFirstTokenMs,
                pct(timeToFirstTokenMs, 90) as p90TimeToFirstTokenMs,
                avg(outputTokens / (durationMs / 1000)) as avgTokensPerSecond
          by modelId
        | sort sampleSize desc

  QueryPerformanceOverallCacheRates:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Performance/02-OverallCacheHitAndMissRates
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields cacheReadInputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens, inputTokens
        | stats count(*) as totalInvocations,
                sum(coalesce(cacheReadInputTokens, 0)) as totalCacheReadTokens,
                sum(coalesce(cacheCreationInputTokens, 0)) as totalCacheWriteTokens,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0)) as totalInputTokens,
                (sum(coalesce(cacheReadInputTokens, 0)) / sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0))) * 100 as cacheHitTokenRatioPct,
                count(cacheReadInputTokens > 0) as invocationsWithCacheRead,
                (count(cacheReadInputTokens > 0) / count(*)) * 100 as cacheInvocationHitRatePct

  QueryPerformanceCacheTrendsOverTime:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Performance/03-CacheTrendsOverTime
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, cacheReadInputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens, inputTokens
        | stats sum(coalesce(cacheReadInputTokens, 0)) as cacheReadTokens,
                sum(coalesce(cacheCreationInputTokens, 0)) as cacheCreationTokens,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0)) as totalInputTokens,
                (sum(coalesce(cacheReadInputTokens, 0)) / sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0))) * 100 as cacheHitRatePct
          by bin(1h) as hourWindow
        | sort hourWindow desc
        | limit 168

  QueryPerformanceCacheRatesBySession:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Performance/04-CacheRatesBySessionAndUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields sessionId, userId, cacheReadInputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens, inputTokens
        | stats count(*) as requestCount,
                sum(coalesce(cacheReadInputTokens, 0)) as sessionCacheReadTokens,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0)) as sessionTotalInputTokens,
                (sum(coalesce(cacheReadInputTokens, 0)) / sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0))) * 100 as sessionCacheHitRatioPct
          by sessionId, userId
        | sort sessionCacheReadTokens desc
        | limit 100

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Capacity Planning Queries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryCapacityPeakUsageWindows:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Capacity/01-PeakUsageWindows
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | stats count(*) as requestsInWindow,
                count_distinct(userId) as concurrentUsersInWindow,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0) + coalesce(outputTokens, 0)) as tokensInWindow
          by bin(5m) as fiveMinuteWindow
        | sort requestsInWindow desc, tokensInWindow desc
        | limit 50

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Deep-Dive and Investigative Queries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryDeepDiveSessionLookup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Investigation/01-SessionDeepDiveLookup
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, sessionId, userId, modelId, inputTokens, outputTokens,
               cacheReadInputTokens, durationMs, statusCode, errorCode, @message
        | filter ispresent(sessionId)
        | sort @timestamp asc
        | limit 500

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Discovery and Schema Explorer Queries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryDiscoveryFieldExplorer:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Discovery/01-MetricFieldExplorer
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message, userId, sessionId, modelId,
               inputTokens, outputTokens, durationMs, statusCode,
               cacheReadInputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens,
               organizationId, teamId, projectId, estimatedCostUsd
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Reporting and Executive Summaries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryReportingDailyUsageSummary:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Reporting/01-DailyUsageSummary
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, sessionId, inputTokens, outputTokens, estimatedCostUsd, statusCode
        | stats count(*) as totalRequests,
                count_distinct(userId) as activeUsers,
                count_distinct(sessionId) as totalSessions,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0)) as totalInputTokens,
                sum(coalesce(outputTokens, 0)) as totalOutputTokens,
                sum(coalesce(inputTokens, 0) + coalesce(outputTokens, 0)) as totalTokens,
                sum(coalesce(estimatedCostUsd, 0)) as totalEstimatedCostUsd,
                count(statusCode >= 400) as errorRequests
          by bin(1d) as dayWindow
        | sort dayWindow desc
        | limit 90

Outputs:

    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Log Group configured for Claude Code metrics.
    Value: !Ref ClaudeCodeLogGroup

  LogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch Log Group configured for Claude Code metrics.
    Value: !GetAtt ClaudeCodeLogGroup.Arn

  RealTimeTokenRateQueryId:
    Description: Query Definition ID for Real-Time Token Consumption Rate Per User.
    Value: !Ref QueryRealTimeTokenConsumptionRatePerUser

  RealTimeCurrentTpmRpmQueryId:
    Description: Query Definition ID for Overall Current TPM and RPM Averages.
    Value: !Ref QueryRealTimeCurrentTpmRpmAverages

  CostAttributionByUserQueryId:
    Description: Query Definition ID for Cost and Usage Attribution by User.
    Value: !Ref QueryCostAttributionByUser

  CostAttributionByModelQueryId:
    Description: Query Definition ID for Cost and Usage Distribution by Claude Model.
    Value: !Ref QueryCostAttributionByModel

  DailyUsageSummaryQueryId:
    Description: Query Definition ID for Daily Usage and Cost Summary Report.
    Value: !Ref QueryReportingDailyUsageSummary

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AppSync GraphQL API (SuperCoolAPI) with IAM auth, CloudWatch logging, DynamoDB table, and multiple data sources.

Resources:
  AppSyncLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SuperCoolAPI-AppSyncLoggingRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSAppSyncPushToCloudWatchLogs

  SuperCoolAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SuperCoolAPI
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLoggingRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL
        ExcludeVerboseContent: false

  Table1:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: Table1
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SuperCoolAPI-AppSyncDynamoDBRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBReadWriteAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt Table1.Arn
                  - !Sub '${Table1.Arn}/index/*'

  Table1DataSourceStandard:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1DataSourceStandard
      Description: DynamoDB data source referencing table name by Ref and region by AWS::Region pseudo parameter
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
        TableName: !Ref Table1

  Table1DataSourceDirect:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1DataSourceDirect
      Description: DynamoDB data source referencing table name via direct string resolution and Sub region
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        AwsRegion: !Sub '${AWS::Region}'
        TableName: !Sub '${Table1}'

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          description: String
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }

        type Mutation {
          addTodo(id: ID!, description: String): Todo
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: The ID of the AppSync GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId

  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: The ARN of the AppSync GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.Arn

  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: The GraphQL endpoint URL of the AppSync API
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.GraphQLUrl

  DynamoDBTableArn:
    Description: The ARN of the DynamoDB Table1
    Value: !GetAtt Table1.Arn

  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: The Name of the DynamoDB Table1
    Value: !Ref Table1

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  IAM roles, instance profiles, and customer-managed policies for Cluster API
  Provider AWS (CAPA) supporting self-managed and Amazon EKS clusters with
  managed node groups and Fargate.

Parameters:
  CAPAPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: capa
    Description: Prefix to be used for IAM role and policy resource names to prevent naming collisions.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@_-]{1,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be alphanumeric or one of +=,.@_- and up to 32 characters.

Resources:
  # Customer Managed Policy: Legacy In-Tree AWS Cloud Provider
  CloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${CAPAPrefix}-cloud-provider-policy'
      Description: Permissions for Kubernetes legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DetachLoadBalancerFromSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesForBackendServer
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  # Customer Managed Policy: Node Initialization & Bootstrap
  NodePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${CAPAPrefix}-node-policy'
      Description: Permissions for cluster nodes initialization, image pulling, and SSM/Secrets retrieval
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:DescribeAssociation
              - ssm:GetDeployablePatchSnapshotForInstance
              - ssm:GetDocument
              - ssm:DescribeDocument
              - ssm:GetManifest
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:ListAssociations
              - ssm:ListInstanceAssociations
              - ssm:PutInventory
              - ssm:PutComplianceItems
              - ssm:PutConfigurePackageResult
              - ssm:UpdateAssociationStatus
              - ssm:UpdateInstanceAssociationStatus
              - ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation
              - ssmmessages:CreateControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:CreateDataChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenDataChannel
              - ec2messages:AcknowledgeMessage
              - ec2messages:DeleteMessage
              - ec2messages:FailMessage
              - ec2messages:GetEndpoint
              - ec2messages:GetMessages
              - ec2messages:SendReply
            Resource: '*'

  # Customer Managed Policy: Cluster API Controllers Infrastructure Management
  ControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${CAPAPrefix}-controllers-policy'
      Description: Permissions for Cluster API controllers to manage AWS infrastructure
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
              - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DisassociateAddress
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeInstanceHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:DetachLoadBalancerFromSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesForBackendServer
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - autoscaling.amazonaws.com
                  - elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com

  # Customer Managed Policy: EKS Orchestration for CAPA
  EKSControllerPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${CAPAPrefix}-eks-controller-policy'
      Description: Permissions for Cluster API controllers to orchestrate EKS resources
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
              - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup
              - eks:CreateFargateProfile
              - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
              - eks:ListFargateProfiles
              - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
              - eks:CreateAddon
              - eks:DescribeAddon
              - eks:DescribeAddonVersions
              - eks:ListAddons
              - eks:UpdateAddon
              - eks:DeleteAddon
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
              - eks:ListTagsForResource
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${CAPAPrefix}-*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:PassedToService:
                  - eks.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  # Role 1: CAPA Controllers Role & Instance Profile
  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${CAPAPrefix}-controllers-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControllersPolicy
        - !Ref EKSControllerPolicy

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${CAPAPrefix}-controllers-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  # Role 2: Self-managed Control Plane Role & Instance Profile
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${CAPAPrefix}-control-plane-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CloudProviderPolicy
        - !Ref NodePolicy
        - !Ref ControllersPolicy
        - !Ref EKSControllerPolicy

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${CAPAPrefix}-control-plane-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  # Role 3: Self-managed Plain Nodes Role & Instance Profile
  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${CAPAPrefix}-nodes-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref NodePolicy
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${CAPAPrefix}-nodes-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  # Role 4: EKS Control Plane Service Role
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${CAPAPrefix}-eks-control-plane-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'

  # Role 5: EKS Fargate Execution Role
  EKSFargatePodExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${CAPAPrefix}-eks-fargate-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy'

  # Role 6: EKS Managed Node Group Role
  EKSNodeGroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${CAPAPrefix}-eks-nodegroup-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'

Outputs:
  CloudProviderPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the Legacy In-Tree Cloud Provider Policy
    Value: !Ref CloudProviderPolicy

  NodePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the Node Initialization Policy
    Value: !Ref NodePolicy

  ControllersPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the Controller Infrastructure Policy
    Value: !Ref ControllersPolicy

  EKSControllerPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS Orchestration Policy
    Value: !Ref EKSControllerPolicy

  ControllersRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA Controllers IAM Role
    Value: !GetAtt ControllersRole.Arn

  ControllersInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA Controllers IAM Instance Profile
    Value: !GetAtt ControllersInstanceProfile.Arn

  ControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Control Plane IAM Role
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneRole.Arn

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the Control Plane IAM Instance Profile
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneInstanceProfile.Arn

  NodesRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Nodes IAM Role
    Value: !GetAtt NodesRole.Arn

  NodesInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the Nodes IAM Instance Profile
    Value: !GetAtt NodesInstanceProfile.Arn

  EKSControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS Control Plane Service IAM Role
    Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn

  EKSFargatePodExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS Fargate Pod Execution IAM Role
    Value: !GetAtt EKSFargatePodExecutionRole.Arn

  EKSNodeGroupRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS Managed Node Group IAM Role
    Value: !GetAtt EKSNodeGroupRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared VPC for EMR on EKS and Celeborn Shuffle Service with dual AZ NAT Gateways, VPC Endpoints, and encrypted VPC Flow Logs.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24

        - Key: Name

        - Key: Name

    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr

      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2

  PublicRouteTable:

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

  PublicDefaultRoute:

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:

    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEip1:

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP

    Properties:

      Tags:

          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2

    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-2

    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1

    Type: AWS::EC2::Route

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints allowing HTTPS from VPC CIDR
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

        - IpProtocol: tcp

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-vpce-sg

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint

      SubnetIds:

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:

      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  MonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  StsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  EmrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.elasticmapreduce
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  KmsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC Flow Logs CloudWatch Log Group
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: flowlogs-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flow-logs/*

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsPublishPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for a dual-stack (IPv4 and Amazon-provided IPv6) VPC across three Availability Zones with optional public subnets and mandatory private subnets.

Parameters:
  VpcIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: my-vpc
    Description: Identifier name tag for the VPC and associated resources.
  VpcCidrBlock:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: The primary IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC.
  EnablePublicSubnets:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to 'true' to deploy three public subnets, an Internet Gateway, and public routes.

Conditions:
  CreatePublicSubnetsCondition: !Equals [!Ref EnablePublicSubnets, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidrBlock
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcIdentifier

  VpcIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnetsCondition
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcIdentifier}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:

      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcIdentifier}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnet1:

    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock

      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcIdentifier}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

      CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidrBlock, 6, 8]]

      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcIdentifier}-private-subnet-2'

  PrivateSubnet3:

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidrBlock, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcIdentifier}-private-subnet-3'

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Provisions the complete set of IAM roles, instance profiles, managed policies,
  user group, and user required to bootstrap and operate the Cluster API Provider
  for AWS (CAPA), covering controller manager, control plane nodes, worker nodes,
  EKS managed control plane, and bootstrap identity.

Resources:
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Cluster API AWS Controller Managed Policy
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CapaControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-capa-controllers-policy'
      Description: IAM policy granting cluster-api-provider-aws controllers permissions to manage AWS infrastructure.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2Management
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:*Address*
              - ec2:*InternetGateway*
              - ec2:*NatGateway*
              - ec2:*CustomerGateway*
              - ec2:*DhcpOptions*
              - ec2:*LaunchTemplate*
              - ec2:*NetworkInterface*
              - ec2:*RouteTable*
              - ec2:*Route
              - ec2:*SecurityGroup*
              - ec2:*Subnet*
              - ec2:*Tags
              - ec2:*Vpc*
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ELBManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*LoadBalancer*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*TargetGroup*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*Listener*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*Rule*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*Tags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetIpAddressType
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ASGManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:Describe*
              - autoscaling:*AutoScalingGroup*
              - autoscaling:*LaunchConfiguration*
              - autoscaling:*LifecycleHook*
              - autoscaling:*NotificationConfiguration*
              - autoscaling:*Policy*
              - autoscaling:*ScheduledAction*
              - autoscaling:*Instances*
              - autoscaling:*LoadBalancer*
              - autoscaling:*Tags
              - autoscaling:ResumeProcesses
              - autoscaling:SuspendProcesses
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:SetInstanceHealth
              - autoscaling:SetInstanceProtection
              - autoscaling:CompleteLifecycleAction
              - autoscaling:RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: EKSManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:*Cluster*
              - eks:*Nodegroup*
              - eks:*FargateProfile*
              - eks:*Addon*
              - eks:DescribeUpdate
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
              - eks:ListTagsForResource
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: IAMPassRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*-control-plane*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*-worker*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*-controller*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*-eks*'
          - Sid: IAMServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAutoScaling*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKS*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKSNodegroup*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
                  - autoscaling.amazonaws.com
                  - eks.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: SecretsManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
              - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
              - secretsmanager:TagResource
              - secretsmanager:UntagResource
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:capa-*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:cluster-api-*'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Cloud Provider AWS Integration Managed Policy
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudProviderAwsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cloud-provider-aws-policy'
      Description: IAM policy granting AWS cloud provider integration permissions to manage EC2, ELB, ASG, ECR, and SSM.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2CloudProvider
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ELBCloudProvider
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*LoadBalancer*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*TargetGroup*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*Listener*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*Rule*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*Tags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetIpAddressType
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ASGCloudProvider
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ECRReadCloudProvider
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:DescribeImages
              - ecr:DescribeRepositories
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy
              - ecr:ListImages
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMCloudProvider
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:DescribeAssociation
              - ssm:GetDeployablePatchSnapshotForInstance
              - ssm:GetDocument
              - ssm:DescribeDocument
              - ssm:GetManifest
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:ListAssociations
              - ssm:ListInstanceAssociations
              - ssm:PutInventory
              - ssm:PutComplianceItems
              - ssm:PutConfigurePackageResult
              - ssm:UpdateAssociationStatus
              - ssm:UpdateInstanceAssociationStatus
              - ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SecretsManagerReadCloudProvider
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:capa-*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:cluster-api-*'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. CAPA Controllers IAM Role and Instance Profile
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CapaControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-capa-controllers-role'
      Description: IAM role for Cluster API Provider for AWS controller manager.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CapaControllersPolicy
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'

  CapaControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-capa-controllers-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref CapaControllersRole

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Kubernetes Control Plane IAM Role and Instance Profile
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-control-plane-role'
      Description: IAM role for Kubernetes control plane nodes.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CapaControllersPolicy
        - !Ref CloudProviderAwsPolicy
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-control-plane-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Worker Nodes IAM Role and Instance Profile
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WorkerNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-worker-node-role'
      Description: IAM role for Kubernetes worker nodes (data plane).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CloudProviderAwsPolicy
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'

  WorkerNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-worker-node-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref WorkerNodeRole

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. EKS Control Plane IAM Role
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EksClusterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eks-cluster-role'
      Description: IAM role for EKS managed control plane.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSVPCResourceController'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. Cluster Bootstrapper IAM Group and User
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CapaBootstrapperGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-bootstrapper-group'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CapaControllersPolicy

  CapaBootstrapperUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-bootstrapper-user'
      Groups:
        - !Ref CapaBootstrapperGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC infrastructure for OpenSearch cross-region resilience with configurable NAT Gateway strategy, multi-AZ subnets, and VPC Flow Logs.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name used for tagging and resource naming conventions.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: VPC CIDR block. Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range between /16 and /28.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.101.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 (AZ 1).
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.102.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 (AZ 2).
  PublicSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.103.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 3 (AZ 3).
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 (AZ 1).
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 (AZ 2).
  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 3 (AZ 3).
  NatGatewayStrategy:
    Type: String
    Default: Single
    AllowedValues:
      - Single
      - OnePerAZ
    Description: NAT Gateway provisioning strategy. Single is cost-effective; OnePerAZ provides high availability across AZs.

Conditions:
  IsMultiNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayStrategy, OnePerAZ]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-igw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets (MapPublicIpOnLaunch disabled to conform to AWS-0164)
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Public Route Table & Routing
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # NAT Gateway Resources
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsMultiNat
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsMultiNat
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway3EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsMultiNat
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-3
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsMultiNat
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway3EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-3
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Private Route Tables
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-3
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Private Routes
  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If [IsMultiNat, !Ref NatGateway2, !Ref NatGateway1]

  PrivateDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If [IsMultiNat, !Ref NatGateway3, !Ref NatGateway1]

  # Private Subnet Route Table Associations
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  # VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogsGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc-flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}-${VPC}
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-VpcId

  VpcCidrBlock:
    Description: VPC CIDR Block
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-VpcCidrBlock

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet1Id

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet2Id

  PublicSubnet3Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 3 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet3Id

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet1Id

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet2Id

  PrivateSubnet3Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 3 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet3Id

  NatGateway1Id:
    Description: Primary NAT Gateway ID (Subnet 1)
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-NatGateway1Id

  NatGateway2Id:
    Description: Secondary NAT Gateway ID (Subnet 2, empty if single NAT strategy)
    Value: !If [IsMultiNat, !Ref NatGateway2, 'N/A']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-NatGateway2Id

  NatGateway3Id:
    Description: Tertiary NAT Gateway ID (Subnet 3, empty if single NAT strategy)
    Value: !If [IsMultiNat, !Ref NatGateway3, 'N/A']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-NatGateway3Id

  FlowLogGroupId:
    Description: CloudWatch Log Group for VPC Flow Logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-FlowLogGroupId
