final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Isolated private VPC without direct internet access for an AI-powered customer support application with Bedrock, ECR, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, RDS Data API, Secrets Manager, SSM, KMS, S3, and X-Ray VPC endpoints, KMS-encrypted VPC Flow Logs, and dedicated component security groups.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the isolated private VPC.

  Subnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in Availability Zone 1.

  Subnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in Availability Zone 2.

  Subnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in Availability Zone 3.

  FlowLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]
    Description: Retention period in days for VPC Flow Logs in CloudWatch.

  DynamoDbPrefixListId:
    Type: String
    Default: pl-02cd2c6b
    AllowedPattern: ^pl-[a-z0-9]+$
    Description: AWS-managed prefix list ID for DynamoDB in the deployment region (e.g., pl-02cd2c6b for us-east-1).

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for VPC Flow Logs and isolated AI application infrastructure.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: KeyPolicyVpcFlowLogs
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flow-logs/*

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/vpc-flow-logs-ai-workload
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AI-Customer-Support-Isolated-VPC

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AI-Isolated-Subnet-AZ1

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AI-Isolated-Subnet-AZ2

  Subnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AI-Isolated-Subnet-AZ3

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AI-Isolated-RouteTable

  Subnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  Subnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  Subnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsPublishPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AI-Customer-Support-VPC-FlowLog

  EndpointsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for interface VPC endpoints allowing inbound HTTPS from application components.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Inbound HTTPS from within the isolated VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VPCEndpoints-SG

  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Agent Runtime instances or containers with HTTPS egress to VPC Endpoints.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
          Description: Allow outbound HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AgentRuntime-SG

  MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Model Context Protocol runtime with HTTPS egress to VPC Endpoints.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
          Description: Allow outbound HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MCPRuntime-SG

  LambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Lambda functions with HTTPS egress to VPC Endpoints.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
          Description: Allow outbound HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Lambda-SG

  AgentToMCPIngressRule:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup
      Description: Allow Agent Runtime to communicate with MCP Runtime over HTTPS

  AgentToMCPEgressRule:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup
      Description: Allow Agent Runtime to call MCP Runtime over HTTPS

  LambdaToMCPIngressRule:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LambdaSecurityGroup
      Description: Allow Lambda to communicate with MCP Runtime over HTTPS

  LambdaToMCPEgressRule:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref LambdaSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup
      Description: Allow Lambda to call MCP Runtime over HTTPS

  DynamoDBEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  S3InterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
        - !Ref Subnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: false

  BedrockEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.bedrock
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
        - !Ref Subnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  BedrockRuntimeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.bedrock-runtime
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
        - !Ref Subnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  BedrockAgentEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.bedrock-agent
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
        - !Ref Subnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  BedrockAgentRuntimeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.bedrock-agent-runtime
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
        - !Ref Subnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
        - !Ref Subnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
        - !Ref Subnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
        - !Ref Subnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  MonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
        - !Ref Subnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  RdsDataEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.rds-data
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
        - !Ref Subnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
        - !Ref Subnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
        - !Ref Subnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  KmsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
        - !Ref Subnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  XRayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.xray
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
        - !Ref Subnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  DynamoDbPrefixListEgressLambda:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref LambdaSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref DynamoDbPrefixListId
      Description: Direct HTTPS access to DynamoDB gateway endpoint for Lambda functions

  DynamoDbPrefixListEgressAgent:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref DynamoDbPrefixListId
      Description: Direct HTTPS access to DynamoDB gateway endpoint for Agent Runtime

  DynamoDbPrefixListEgressMcp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref DynamoDbPrefixListId
      Description: Direct HTTPS access to DynamoDB gateway endpoint for MCP Runtime

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready VPC architecture for Amazon EKS across 3 Availability Zones with public and private subnets, highly available NAT Gateways, Kubernetes tags, and security groups.

Parameters:
  ResourcePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-vpc
    Description: Prefix name applied to resources and used for Kubernetes cluster tags.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16).

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 (AZ 1).
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 (AZ 2).
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'

  PublicSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 3 (AZ 3).
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 (AZ 1).
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 (AZ 2).
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'

  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.12.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 3 (AZ 3).
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-vpc'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${ResourcePrefix}'
          Value: shared

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: 'kubernetes.io/role/elb'
          Value: '1'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${ResourcePrefix}'
          Value: shared

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: 'kubernetes.io/role/elb'
          Value: '1'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${ResourcePrefix}'
          Value: shared

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-public-subnet-3'
        - Key: 'kubernetes.io/role/elb'
          Value: '1'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${ResourcePrefix}'
          Value: shared

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: 'kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb'
          Value: '1'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${ResourcePrefix}'
          Value: shared

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: 'kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb'
          Value: '1'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${ResourcePrefix}'
          Value: shared

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-private-subnet-3'
        - Key: 'kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb'
          Value: '1'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${ResourcePrefix}'
          Value: shared

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway3EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-nat-eip-3'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-nat-gw-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-nat-gw-2'

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway3EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-nat-gw-3'

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-private-rt-3'

  PrivateDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  EKSControlPlaneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EKS control plane and worker node communication
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow outbound traffic within the VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-eks-control-plane-sg'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${ResourcePrefix}'
          Value: shared

  EKSControlPlaneSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref EKSControlPlaneSecurityGroup
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref EKSControlPlaneSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: -1
      Description: Allow all traffic between control plane and managed nodes sharing this SG

  IngressGatewaySecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group exposing HTTP, HTTPS, and service mesh gateway ports to internet
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow inbound HTTP from anywhere
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow inbound HTTPS from anywhere
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8080
          ToPort: 8080
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow inbound custom app/gateway port 8080
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8443
          ToPort: 8443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow inbound custom app/gateway TLS port 8443
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 15021
          ToPort: 15021
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow inbound Istio/Envoy status health checks
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow outbound traffic within the VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-ingress-gw-sg'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

  VpcCidrBlock:
    Description: The CIDR block of the VPC
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of Public Subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of Public Subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnet3Id:
    Description: ID of Public Subnet 3
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of all public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of Private Subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of Private Subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet3Id:
    Description: ID of Private Subnet 3
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet3

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of all private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]

  AllSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of all public and private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3, !Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]

  EKSControlPlaneSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the EKS control plane and node communication security group
    Value: !Ref EKSControlPlaneSecurityGroup

  IngressGatewaySecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the ingress and service mesh gateway security group
    Value: !Ref IngressGatewaySecurityGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to create an IAM execution role for a SageMaker HyperPod cluster integrated with an Amazon EKS cluster.

Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix to apply to resource names (e.g. MyHyperPod).
    Default: HyperPod
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 50

  EKSClusterName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the EKS cluster integrated with SageMaker HyperPod.
    Default: hyperpod-eks-cluster

  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional VPC ID. If omitted, a default VPC will be created.
    Default: ''

  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Optional comma-delimited list of Security Group IDs. If omitted, a default security group will be created.
    Default: ''

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Optional comma-delimited list of Private Subnet IDs. If omitted, a default subnet will be created.
    Default: ''

  LifecycleScriptsBucket:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional S3 bucket name containing HyperPod lifecycle scripts. If omitted, a default bucket will be created.
    Default: ''

  CreateRIGResources:
    Type: String
    Description: Flag to conditionally create RIG (Resource Isolation Group / Inference) policies.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

  RIGInputBucket:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional S3 bucket name for RIG input data.
    Default: ''

  RIGOutputBucket:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional S3 bucket name for RIG output data.
    Default: ''

  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    Description: Flag to enable gated access permissions (access points and SQS queues).
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

Conditions:
  HasVpcId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
  CreateDefaultVpc: !Not [Condition: HasVpcId]
  HasLifecycleScriptsBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LifecycleScriptsBucket, '']]
  CreateDefaultBucket: !Not [Condition: HasLifecycleScriptsBucket]
  HasRIGInputBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RIGInputBucket, '']]
  ShouldCreateRIG: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateRIGResources, 'true']
    - Condition: HasRIGInputBucket
  IsGatedAccessEnabled: !And
    - Condition: ShouldCreateRIG
    - !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, 'true']
  HasRIGOutputBucket: !And
    - Condition: ShouldCreateRIG
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RIGOutputBucket, '']]

Resources:
  DefaultVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateDefaultVpc
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-default-vpc'
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisites
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  DefaultSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDefaultVpc
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref DefaultVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-default-subnet'
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisites
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  DefaultSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateDefaultVpc
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Default Security Group for HyperPod nodes
      VpcId: !Ref DefaultVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-default-sg'
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisites
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  LifecycleScriptsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateDefaultBucket
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Key for encrypting HyperPod lifecycle scripts S3 bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3AndSageMakerAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - s3.amazonaws.com
                - sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisites
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  LifecycleScriptsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateDefaultBucket
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ResourceNamePrefix}-lifecycle-scripts-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LifecycleScriptsKey

  DefaultLifecycleScriptsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: CreateDefaultBucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt LifecycleScriptsKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisites
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  HyperPodExecRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AmazonEKSVPCCNIPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EKSCNINetworkInterfaceActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
              - Sid: EKSCNIDescribeActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: HyperPodClusterOperationsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ENIManagementActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
                  - !Sub
                    - 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${EffectiveVpcId}'
                    - EffectiveVpcId: !If [HasVpcId, !Ref VpcId, !Ref DefaultVpc]
              - Sid: NetworkReadActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ECRPullActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchAlarmsRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EKSPodIdentityAssumeRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/${EKSClusterName}'
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsS3Access
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::${EffectiveScriptsBucket}'
                  - EffectiveScriptsBucket: !If [HasLifecycleScriptsBucket, !Ref LifecycleScriptsBucket, !Ref DefaultLifecycleScriptsBucket]
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsS3ObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::${EffectiveScriptsBucket}/*'
                  - EffectiveScriptsBucket: !If [HasLifecycleScriptsBucket, !Ref LifecycleScriptsBucket, !Ref DefaultLifecycleScriptsBucket]
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsKMSAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisites
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  HyperPodNetworkScopedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-NetworkScopedPolicy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ScopedSubnetAndSGNetworkInterfaceActions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/*'

  RIGManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: ShouldCreateRIG
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-RIGPolicy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RIGInputBucketRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${RIGInputBucket}'
          - Sid: RIGInputBucketObjectRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${RIGInputBucket}/*'
          - Sid: RIGLambdaInvocation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*SageMaker*'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*sagemaker*'

  RIGOutputPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: HasRIGOutputBucket
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-RIGOutputPolicy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RIGOutputBucketList
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${RIGOutputBucket}'
          - Sid: RIGOutputBucketObjectAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${RIGOutputBucket}/*'

  RIGGatedAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: IsGatedAccessEnabled
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-RIGGatedAccessPolicy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: GatedAccessS3AccessPoints
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*SageMaker*/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*sagemaker*/*'
              - 'arn:aws:s3:::*sagemaker-gated*/*'
              - 'arn:aws:s3:::*SageMaker-gated*/*'
          - Sid: GatedAccessSQSQueues
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:SendMessage
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*SageMaker*'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*sagemaker*'

Outputs:
  HyperPodRoleName:
    Description: Name of the SageMaker HyperPod IAM Execution Role
    Value: !Ref HyperPodExecRole

  HyperPodRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker HyperPod IAM Execution Role
    Value: !GetAtt HyperPodExecRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Establishes baseline IAM groups, roles, instance profiles, and managed policies
  representing common operational personas: System Administrator, IAM Administrator,
  Instance Operations, Read-Only Administrator, and Read-Only Billing.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: Baseline
    Description: Prefix to apply to IAM resource names.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@\-_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and symbols +=,.@-_

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # 1. System Administrator Managed Policy
  # =========================================================================
  SystemAdminManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-SystemAdministratorPolicy'
      Description: System Administrator policy granting broad access, denying IAM write operations, requiring MFA, denying billing access, and protecting logging KMS keys.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBroadServiceAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: RequireMfa
            Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyIamWriteActions
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - iam:Create*
              - iam:Delete*
              - iam:Update*
              - iam:Put*
              - iam:Attach*
              - iam:Detach*
              - iam:Add*
              - iam:Remove*
              - iam:Set*
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyBillingAndCostManagement
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - ce:*
              - cur:*
              - pricing:*
              - consolidatedbilling:*
              - account:*
              - payments:*
              - invoicing:*
              - tax:*
              - bcm-data-exports:*
              - costoptimizationhub:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyTamperingWithLoggingKmsKeys
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:Delete*
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                kms:ResourceTag/Usage: '*log*'

  # =========================================================================
  # 2. IAM Administrator Managed Policy
  # =========================================================================
  IamAdminManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-IamAdministratorPolicy'
      Description: IAM Administrator policy granting IAM and Identity Center access, requiring MFA, denying billing access, and protecting logging KMS keys.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowIamAndOrganizations
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:*
              - organizations:Describe*
              - organizations:List*
              - sso:*
              - identitystore:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: RequireMfa
            Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyBillingAndCostManagement
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - ce:*
              - cur:*
              - pricing:*
              - consolidatedbilling:*
              - account:*
              - payments:*
              - invoicing:*
              - tax:*
              - bcm-data-exports:*
              - costoptimizationhub:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyTamperingWithLoggingKmsKeys
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:Delete*
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                kms:ResourceTag/Usage: '*log*'

  # =========================================================================
  # 3. Instance Operations Managed Policy
  # =========================================================================
  InstanceOperationsManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Production-ready 3-tier VPC architecture spanning three Availability Zones
  with web, application, and database subnets, an Internet Gateway, and redundant
  NAT Gateways.

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    Description: CIDR block for the entire VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR range, e.g. 10.0.0.0/16.

  WebSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for Web Subnet in Availability Zone 1.

  WebSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for Web Subnet in Availability Zone 2.

  WebSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.2.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for Web Subnet in Availability Zone 3.

  AppSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.10.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for Application Subnet in Availability Zone 1.

  AppSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.11.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for Application Subnet in Availability Zone 2.

  AppSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.12.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for Application Subnet in Availability Zone 3.

  DatabaseSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.20.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for Database Subnet in Availability Zone 1.

  DatabaseSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.21.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for Database Subnet in Availability Zone 2.

  DatabaseSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.22.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for Database Subnet in Availability Zone 3.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Web Subnets (Public Route Table, MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false)
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-az1'

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-az2'

  WebSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-az3'

  # Application Subnets (Private)
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-az1'

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-az2'

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-az3'

  # Database Subnets (Private)
  DatabaseSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref DatabaseSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-az1'

  DatabaseSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref DatabaseSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-az2'

  DatabaseSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref DatabaseSubnet3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-az3'

  # Web Route Table & Routes
  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-rt'

  WebDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az1'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az2'

  NatGateway3EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az3'

  # NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-az1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-az2'

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway3EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-az3'

  # Application Route Tables and Routes
  AppRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-az1'

  AppDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1

  AppRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-az2'

  AppDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2

  AppRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-az3'

  AppDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  AppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3

  # Database Route Tables and Routes
  DatabaseRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-rt-az1'

  DatabaseDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DatabaseRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  DatabaseSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DatabaseSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref DatabaseRouteTable1

  DatabaseRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-rt-az2'

  DatabaseDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DatabaseRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  DatabaseSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DatabaseSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref DatabaseRouteTable2

  DatabaseRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-rt-az3'

  DatabaseDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DatabaseRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  DatabaseSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DatabaseSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref DatabaseRouteTable3

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

  AvailabilityZone1:
    Description: Availability Zone 1 used for the subnets
    Value: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']

  AvailabilityZone2:
    Description: Availability Zone 2 used for the subnets
    Value: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']

  AvailabilityZone3:
    Description: Availability Zone 3 used for the subnets
    Value: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']

  WebSubnets:
    Description: List of Web Subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref WebSubnet1, !Ref WebSubnet2, !Ref WebSubnet3]]

  AppSubnets:
    Description: List of Application Subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref AppSubnet1, !Ref AppSubnet2, !Ref AppSubnet3]]

  DatabaseSubnets:
    Description: List of Database Subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref DatabaseSubnet1, !Ref DatabaseSubnet2, !Ref DatabaseSubnet3]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared IAM roles and instance profiles for Amazon EKS Quick Start deployments with SSM parameter mappings.

Parameters:
  RolePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-quickstart
    Description: Prefix to use for naming IAM roles and instance profiles.
  SsmPathPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: /quickstart/amazon-eks
    Description: SSM parameter path prefix under which role ARNs will be registered.

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # EKS Control Plane Role
  # ============================================================================
  EksControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-control-plane-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSServicePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EksAdditionalControlPlanePermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                Resource: '*'

  # ============================================================================
  # Fargate Execution Role
  # ============================================================================
  FargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-fargate-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy

  # ============================================================================
  # Managed Node Role & Instance Profile
  # ============================================================================
  ManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-managed-node-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-managed-node-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeRole

  # ============================================================================
  # Unmanaged Node Role & Instance Profile
  # ============================================================================
  UnmanagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-unmanaged-node-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-unmanaged-node-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeRole

  # ============================================================================
  # VPC Role Creator Lambda Execution Role
  # Allowed to create role CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC and attach specific policies
  # ============================================================================
  VpcRoleCreatorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-vpc-role-creator-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageVpcRoleCreation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
                Condition:
                  ArnEquals:
                    iam:PolicyArn:
                      - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaENIManagementAccess
                      - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # ============================================================================
  # Lambda Utility Execution Roles
  # ============================================================================
  CopyArtifactsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-copy-artifacts-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CopyS3ArtifactsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'

  ResourceReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-resource-reader-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess

  BucketCleanupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-bucket-cleanup-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeleteBucketContentsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                Resource: '*'

  LoadBalancerCleanupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-lb-cleanup-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LoadBalancerCleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                Resource: '*'

  SecurityGroupCleanupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-sg-cleanup-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecurityGroupCleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                Resource: '*'

  LambdaCleanupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-lambda-cleanup-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaCleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                Resource: '*'

  CallerArnResolverRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-caller-arn-resolver-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResolveCallerArnPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - iam:GetUser
                  - iam:GetRole
                Resource: '*'

  CustomResourceTypeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-custom-resource-type-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RegisterCustomResourceTypePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeTypeRegistration
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeDefaultVersion
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                Resource: '*'

  NodeSecurityGroupManagerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-node-sg-manager-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageNodeSecurityGroupsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                Resource: '*'

  FargateProfileManagerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-fargate-profile-manager-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageFargateProfilesPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:CreateFargateProfile
                  - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
                  - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
                  - eks:ListFargateProfiles
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'

  SsmParameterResolverRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-ssm-param-resolver-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResolveSsmParametersPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: '*'

  # ============================================================================
  # SSM Parameters: Registration under SsmPathPrefix
  # ============================================================================
  SsmParamControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SsmPathPrefix}/roles/control-plane-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt EksControlPlaneRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the EKS Control Plane IAM Role

  SsmParamFargateExecutionRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SsmPathPrefix}/roles/fargate-execution-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt FargateExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the EKS Fargate Execution IAM Role

  SsmParamManagedNodeRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SsmPathPrefix}/roles/managed-node-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ManagedNodeRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the Managed Node IAM Role

  SsmParamManagedNodeInstanceProfileArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SsmPathPrefix}/roles/managed-node-profile-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ManagedNodeInstanceProfile.Arn
      Description: ARN of the Managed Node Instance Profile

  SsmParamUnmanagedNodeRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SsmPathPrefix}/roles/unmanaged-node-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UnmanagedNodeRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the Unmanaged Node IAM Role

  SsmParamUnmanagedNodeInstanceProfileArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SsmPathPrefix}/roles/unmanaged-node-profile-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile.Arn
      Description: ARN of the Unmanaged Node Instance Profile

  SsmParamVpcRoleCreatorRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter

      Value: !GetAtt VpcRoleCreatorRole.Arn

  SsmParamCopyArtifactsRoleArn:

      Value: !GetAtt CopyArtifactsRole.Arn

  SsmParamResourceReaderRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter

  SsmParamBucketCleanupRoleArn:

  SsmParamLoadBalancerCleanupRoleArn:

  SsmParamLambdaCleanupRoleArn:

    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SsmPathPrefix}/roles/lambda-cleanup-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt LambdaCleanupRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the Lambda Cleanup Lambda Role

  SsmParamCallerArnResolverRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:

      Value: !GetAtt CallerArnResolverRole.Arn

  SsmParamCustomResourceTypeRoleArn:

  SsmParamNodeSecurityGroupManagerRoleArn:

  SsmParamFargateProfileManagerRoleArn:

      Value: !GetAtt FargateProfileManagerRole.Arn

  SsmParamSsmParameterResolverRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SsmPathPrefix}/roles/ssm-param-resolver-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt SsmParameterResolverRole.Arn
