AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Lab VPC with web and application subnets, shared route table, web security group, S3 Gateway endpoint, and Kinesis interface endpoints.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.

  WebSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Web Subnet 1.

  WebSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Web Subnet 2.

  AppSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Application Subnet 1.

  AppSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Application Subnet 2.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabVPC

  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet1

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet2

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet1

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet2

  SharedRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SharedRouteTable

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for web tier allowing HTTPS from VPC
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow inbound HTTPS from VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSecurityGroup

  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref SharedRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadOnlyAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: '*'

  KinesisStreamsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  KinesisFirehoseEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-firehose
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

  WebSubnet1Id:
    Description: The ID of Web Subnet 1
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet1

  WebSubnet2Id:
    Description: The ID of Web Subnet 2
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet2

  AppSubnet1Id:
    Description: The ID of Application Subnet 1
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet1

  AppSubnet2Id:
    Description: The ID of Application Subnet 2
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet2

  WebSecurityGroupId:
    Description: The ID of the Web Security Group
    Value: !Ref WebSecurityGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared IAM roles and instance profiles for Amazon EKS clusters and CloudFormation custom resource handlers.

Parameters:
  ResourcePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-shared
    Description: Prefix applied to all IAM role and instance profile names.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters or (+=,.@_-).

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # EKS Cluster and Node IAM Roles
  # =========================================================================
  EKSClusterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-eks-cluster-role'
      Description: EKS control plane IAM role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'

  EKSFargatePodExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-eks-fargate-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by EKS Fargate profiles
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy'

  EKSManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-eks-managed-node-role'
      Description: IAM role for EKS managed node groups
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/*'

  EKSManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-eks-managed-node-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref EKSManagedNodeRole

  EKSUnmanagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters.

        - AttributeName: bs

        - AttributeName: bs
          KeyType: HASH

        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:Scan
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
              - !Sub '${DynamoDBTable.Arn}/index/*'

    Description: Name of the created DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${App}-${Env}-${Name}-bs-dynamodb-TableName'

    Export:

    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: AWS Account ID of the AWS Organization master/management account.

  JumpstartAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: AWS Account ID for Jumpstart.

  ManagementAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: AWS Account ID for Management.

  LogAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: AWS Account ID for Centralized Logging.

  RecoveryAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: AWS Account ID for Disaster Recovery.

  BuildAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: AWS Account ID for Build / CI/CD.

  CoreAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: AWS Account ID for Core / Hub services.

  ProductionAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: AWS Account ID for Production.

  StagingAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: AWS Account ID for Staging.

  UATAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: AWS Account ID for User Acceptance Testing.

  QAAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: AWS Account ID for Quality Assurance.

  TestingAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: AWS Account ID for Testing.

  DevelopmentAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: AWS Account ID for Development.

Conditions:
  IsTransitGatewayAccountEmpty: !Equals [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, '']
  IsTransitGatewayAccountSelf: !Equals [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
  IsTransitGatewayAccount: !Or
    - !Condition IsTransitGatewayAccountEmpty
    - !Condition IsTransitGatewayAccountSelf
  IsNotTransitGatewayAccount: !Not [!Condition IsTransitGatewayAccount]

  HasOrganization: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Organization, '']]
  HasOrganizationAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationAccount, '']]
  HasJumpstartAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref JumpstartAccount, '']]
  HasManagementAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ManagementAccount, '']]
  HasLogAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LogAccount, '']]
  HasRecoveryAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RecoveryAccount, '']]
  HasBuildAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BuildAccount, '']]
  HasCoreAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CoreAccount, '']]
  HasProductionAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ProductionAccount, '']]
  HasStagingAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StagingAccount, '']]
  HasUATAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref UATAccount, '']]
  HasQAAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref QAAccount, '']]
  HasTestingAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TestingAccount, '']]
  HasDevelopmentAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DevelopmentAccount, '']]

  HasCoreAccounts: !Or
    - !Condition HasOrganizationAccount
    - !Condition HasJumpstartAccount
    - !Condition HasManagementAccount
    - !Condition HasLogAccount
    - !Condition HasRecoveryAccount
    - !Condition HasBuildAccount
    - !Condition HasCoreAccount

  HasWorkloadAccounts: !Or
    - !Condition HasProductionAccount
    - !Condition HasStagingAccount
    - !Condition HasUATAccount
    - !Condition HasQAAccount
    - !Condition HasTestingAccount
    - !Condition HasDevelopmentAccount

  HasIndividualAccounts: !Or
    - !Condition HasCoreAccounts
    - !Condition HasWorkloadAccounts

  HasAnyPrincipals: !Or
    - !Condition HasOrganization
    - !Condition HasIndividualAccounts

  AllowExternalRequested: !Equals [!Ref AllowExternalPrincipals, 'true']
  EnableAllowExternalPrincipals: !Or
    - !Condition AllowExternalRequested
    - !Condition HasIndividualAccounts

Resources:
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Condition: IsTransitGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayASN
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: !Ref AutoAcceptSharedAttachments
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway'
      DnsSupport: !Ref DnsSupport
      VpnEcmpSupport: !Ref VpnEcmpSupport
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway'
        - Key: CompanyName
          Value: !Ref CompanyName
        - Key: SystemName
          Value: !Ref SystemName
        - Key: AccountName
          Value: !Ref AccountName
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayResourceShare:
    Type: AWS::RAM::ResourceShare
    Condition: IsTransitGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref TransitGatewayResourceShareName
      AllowExternalPrincipals: !If [EnableAllowExternalPrincipals, true, false]
      ResourceArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transit-gateway/${TransitGateway}'
      Principals:
        !If
        - HasAnyPrincipals
        - !Split
          - ','
          - !Select
            - 0
            - !Split
              - ',__END__'
              - !Sub
                - '${P_Org}${P_OrgAcc}${P_Jump}${P_Mgmt}${P_Log}${P_Rec}${P_Bld}${P_Core}${P_Prod}${P_Stag}${P_Uat}${P_Qa}${P_Test}${P_Dev}__END__'
                - P_Org: !If [HasOrganization, !Sub '${Organization},', '']
                  P_OrgAcc: !If [HasOrganizationAccount, !Sub '${OrganizationAccount},', '']
                  P_Jump: !If [HasJumpstartAccount, !Sub '${JumpstartAccount},', '']
                  P_Mgmt: !If [HasManagementAccount, !Sub '${ManagementAccount},', '']
                  P_Log: !If [HasLogAccount, !Sub '${LogAccount},', '']
                  P_Rec: !If [HasRecoveryAccount, !Sub '${RecoveryAccount},', '']
                  P_Bld: !If [HasBuildAccount, !Sub '${BuildAccount},', '']
                  P_Core: !If [HasCoreAccount, !Sub '${CoreAccount},', '']
                  P_Prod: !If [HasProductionAccount, !Sub '${ProductionAccount},', '']
                  P_Stag: !If [HasStagingAccount, !Sub '${StagingAccount},', '']
                  P_Uat: !If [HasUATAccount, !Sub '${UATAccount},', '']
                  P_Qa: !If [HasQAAccount, !Sub '${QAAccount},', '']
                  P_Test: !If [HasTestingAccount, !Sub '${TestingAccount},', '']
                  P_Dev: !If [HasDevelopmentAccount, !Sub '${DevelopmentAccount},', '']
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref TransitGatewayResourceShareName
        - Key: CompanyName
          Value: !Ref CompanyName
        - Key: SystemName
          Value: !Ref SystemName
        - Key: AccountName
          Value: !Ref AccountName
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayReference:
    Type: Custom::TransitGatewayReference
    Condition: IsNotTransitGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      ServiceToken:
        Fn::ImportValue: !Sub '${ReferenceFunctionsStackName}-TransitGatewayReferenceFunctionArn'
      TransitGatewayAccount: !Ref TransitGatewayAccount
      EnvironmentName: !Ref EnvironmentName
      SystemName: !Ref SystemName

Outputs:
  TransitGateway:
    Description: The Transit Gateway ID for this environment.
    Value: !If
      - IsTransitGatewayAccount
      - !Ref TransitGateway
      - !GetAtt TransitGatewayReference.TransitGatewayId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TransitGateway'

  TransitGatewayArn:
    Description: The Transit Gateway ARN.
    Condition: IsTransitGatewayAccount
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transit-gateway/${TransitGateway}'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TransitGatewayArn'

  TransitGatewayResourceShareArn:
    Description: The Resource Access Manager (RAM) Resource Share ARN for the Transit Gateway.
    Condition: IsTransitGatewayAccount
    Value: !GetAtt TransitGatewayResourceShare.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TransitGatewayResourceShareArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS Bedrock Guardrail and Guardrail Version for AWS Pricing Assistant with SSM Parameter storage.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-pricing-assistant
    Description: Project identifier used for resource naming and tagging.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens only.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Environment stage for deployment.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

Resources:
  PricingAssistantGuardrail:
    Type: AWS::Bedrock::Guardrail
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-guardrail'
      Description: Guardrail restricting model interactions strictly to AWS pricing and infrastructure design topics.
      BlockedInputMessaging: 'I am an AWS Pricing and Infrastructure Assistant. I can only assist with AWS pricing, cost estimates, and AWS architecture design queries.'
      BlockedOutputsMessaging: 'The generated response was blocked because it did not adhere to AWS pricing and architecture guidance boundaries.'
      TopicPolicyConfig:
        TopicsConfig:
          - Name: DenyOffTopicConversations
            Definition: General inquiries or discussions unrelated to AWS pricing, cost estimates, or cloud infrastructure design, such as weather, cooking, sports, or general knowledge.
            Type: DENY
            Examples:
              - 'What is the weather like in Seattle today?'
              - 'Can you give me a recipe for chocolate cake?'
              - 'Who won the football game last night?'
              - 'Write a poem about spring flowers.'
              - 'What are the best tourist destinations in Europe?'
      ContentPolicyConfig:
        FiltersConfig:
          - Type: SEXUAL
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: VIOLENCE
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: HATE
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: PROMPT_ATTACK
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: INSULTS
            InputStrength: MEDIUM
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: MISCONDUCT
            InputStrength: MEDIUM
            OutputStrength: NONE
      WordPolicyConfig:
        ManagedWordListsConfig:
          - Type: PROFANITY
      SensitiveInformationPolicyConfig:
        PiiEntitiesConfig:
          - Type: EMAIL
            Action: BLOCK
          - Type: PHONE
            Action: BLOCK
          - Type: US_SOCIAL_SECURITY_NUMBER
            Action: BLOCK
          - Type: CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD_NUMBER
            Action: BLOCK
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PricingAssistantGuardrailVersion:
    Type: AWS::Bedrock::GuardrailVersion
    Properties:
      GuardrailIdentifier: !GetAtt PricingAssistantGuardrail.GuardrailId
      Description: !Sub 'Production-ready guardrail version for ${ProjectName} in ${Environment}'

  ActiveGuardrailVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-

          import json
          import hmac
          import hashlib
          import base64
          import urllib.request
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          DATE_STRING = "11111111"
          SERVICE = "ses"
          MESSAGE = "SendRawEmail"
          VERSION = 0x04

          def sign(key, msg):
              return hmac.new(key, msg.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).digest()

          def calculate_smtp_password(secret_access_key):
              signature = sign(("AWS4" + secret_access_key).encode('utf-8'), DATE_STRING)
              signature = sign(signature, boto3.Session().region_name or "us-east-1")
              signature = sign(signature, SERVICE)
              signature = sign(signature, MESSAGE)
              signature_and_version = bytes([VERSION]) + signature
              return base64.b64encode(signature_and_version).decode('ascii')

          def send_cfn_response(event, context, response_status, response_data, physical_resource_id=None):
              response_url = event['ResponseURL']
              response_body = json.dumps({
                  'Status': response_status,
                  'Reason': f'See CloudWatch Log Stream: {context.log_stream_name}',
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': response_data
              }).encode('utf-8')

              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  response_url,
                  data=response_body,
                  headers={'content-type': '', 'content-length': str(len(response_body))},
                  method='PUT'
              )
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                      logger.info("CFN response status: %s", resp.status)
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error("Failed sending CFN response: %s", str(e))

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              properties = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})

              user_name = properties.get('IAMUserName')
              access_key_id = properties.get('AccessKeyId')
              secret_access_key = properties.get('SecretAccessKey')
              kms_key_arn = properties.get('KmsKeyArn')

              username_param_name = f"/ses/smtp/{user_name}/username"
              password_param_name = f"/ses/smtp/{user_name}/password"
              physical_id = f"SES-SMTP-{user_name}"

              ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

              try:
                  if request_type in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      smtp_password = calculate_smtp_password(secret_access_key)

                      put_user_kwargs = {
                          'Name': username_param_name,
                          'Description': f'SES SMTP Username for IAM user {user_name}',
                          'Value': access_key_id,
                          'Type': 'SecureString',
                          'Overwrite': True
                      }
                      if kms_key_arn:
                          put_user_kwargs['KeyId'] = kms_key_arn
                      ssm.put_parameter(**put_user_kwargs)

                      put_pass_kwargs = {
                          'Name': password_param_name,
                          'Description': f'SES SMTP Password derived from Secret Access Key for {user_name}',
                          'Value': smtp_password,
                          'Type': 'SecureString',
                          'Overwrite': True
                      }
                      if kms_key_arn:
                          put_pass_kwargs['KeyId'] = kms_key_arn
                      ssm.put_parameter(**put_pass_kwargs)

                      send_cfn_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {
                          'UsernameParameter': username_param_name,
                          'PasswordParameter': password_param_name
                      }, physical_id)

                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      for param_name in [username_param_name, password_param_name]:
                          try:
                              ssm.delete_parameter(Name=param_name)
                              logger.info("Deleted parameter %s", param_name)
                          except ssm.exceptions.ParameterNotFound:
                              logger.info("Parameter %s already deleted or not found", param_name)
                          except Exception as e:
                              logger.warning("Error deleting parameter %s: %s", param_name, str(e))

                      send_cfn_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_id)

              except Exception as exc:
                  logger.exception("Handler failed: %s", str(exc))
                  send_cfn_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {'Error': str(exc)}, physical_id)

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Production-ready WebSocket API Gateway with Lambda backend, DynamoDB connection tracker,
  dedicated KMS encryption for Lambda environment variables and CloudWatch Logs, and full API Gateway
  account-level CloudWatch logging.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # KMS Key: Lambda Environment Variables Encryption
  # =========================================================================
  LambdaEnvKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting Lambda environment variables for grant status processing
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: lambda-env-kms-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowLambdaRoleDecrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:PrincipalArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${AWS::StackName}-websocket-lambda-role*'

  LambdaEnvKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-lambda-env-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LambdaEnvKmsKey

  # =========================================================================
  # KMS Key: CloudWatch Logs Encryption
  # =========================================================================
  CloudWatchLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting CloudWatch Logs log groups
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: cw-logs-kms-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  CloudWatchLogsKmsKeyAlias:

  # =========================================================================

      KeySchema:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents

        - PolicyName: KmsDecryptPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKmsKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayManageConnectionsPolicy

            Version: '2012-10-17'

  # =========================================================================
  # Lambda: WebSocket Route Handler
  # =========================================================================
  WebSocketHandlerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKmsKey.Arn
      Timeout: 15

      Environment:

          ENVIRONMENT: !Ref EnvironmentName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import time
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ.get("TABLE_NAME")
          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          table = dynamodb.Table(TABLE_NAME)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              route_key = event.get("requestContext", {}).get("routeKey")
              connection_id = event.get("requestContext", {}).get("connectionId")
              domain_name = event.get("requestContext", {}).get("domainName")
              stage = event.get("requestContext", {}).get("stage")

              if route_key == "$connect":
                  # Record active connection with a 24-hour TTL
                  table.put_item(
                      Item={
                          "connectionId": connection_id,
                          "connectedAt": int(time.time()),
                          "ttl": int(time.time()) + 86400
                      }
                  )
                  return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Connected."}

              elif route_key == "$disconnect":
                  table.delete_item(Key={"connectionId": connection_id})
                  return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Disconnected."}

              elif route_key == "jobstatus":
                  endpoint_url = f"https://{domain_name}/{stage}"
                  apigw_management = boto3.client("apigatewaymanagementapi", endpoint_url=endpoint_url)

                  body = {}
                  if "body" in event and event["body"]:
                      try:
                          body = json.loads(event["body"])
                      except Exception:
                          body = {}

                  job_id = body.get("jobId", "unknown")
                  job_status = body.get("status", "processing")
                  status_message = json.dumps({
                      "action": "jobstatus_update",
                      "jobId": job_id,
                      "status": job_status,
                      "timestamp": int(time.time())
                  }).encode("utf-8")

                  # Fan out status update to all registered connections
                  scan_response = table.scan(ProjectionExpression="connectionId")
                  items = scan_response.get("Items", [])

                  for item in items:
                      cid = item["connectionId"]
                      try:
                          apigw_management.post_to_connection(
                              ConnectionId=cid,
                              Data=status_message
                          )
                      except ClientError as e:
                          if e.response.get("Error", {}).get("Code") == "GoneException":
                              table.delete_item(Key={"connectionId": cid})

                  return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Status broadcasted."}

              elif route_key == "$default":
                  return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Default route hit."}

              return {"statusCode": 400, "body": "Unknown route."}

  # =========================================================================
  # API Gateway: WebSocket API
  # =========================================================================
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-grant-status-api'
      Description: WebSocket API for pushing live status updates about grant-processing jobs
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'

  # Integration
  LambdaIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  # Routes
  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$connect'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${LambdaIntegration}'

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$disconnect'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${LambdaIntegration}'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$default'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${LambdaIntegration}'

  JobStatusRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: 'jobstatus'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${LambdaIntegration}'

  # Permissions for API Gateway to invoke Lambda
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*'

  # Deployment

    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - JobStatusRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

  # =========================================================================
  # CloudWatch Logs & API Gateway Account Configuration
  # =========================================================================
  ApiGatewayAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/${AWS::StackName}-websocket-access-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CloudWatchLogsKmsKey.Arn

  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs'

              for item in sig_header.split(','):
                  item = item.strip()
                  if '=' in item:
                      k, v = item.split('=', 1)
                      if k == 't':
                          pairs['t'] = v
                      elif k == 'v1':
                          pairs.setdefault('v1', []).append(v)
              if 't' not in pairs or 'v1' not in pairs:
                  return False
              timestamp = pairs['t']
              try:
                  if abs(time.time() - int(timestamp)) > 300:
                      return False
              except ValueError:
                  return False
              signed_payload = f"{timestamp}.{payload_str}".encode('utf-8')
              expected_sig = hmac.new(secret.encode('utf-8'), signed_payload, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
              return any(hmac.compare_digest(expected_sig, sig) for sig in pairs['v1'])

          def fetch_squarespace_order(order_id, api_key):
              url = f"https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce/orders/{order_id}"
              req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
                  "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
                  "User-Agent": "LambdaSquarespaceStripeNotifier/1.0"
              })
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
                      if resp.status == 200:
                          return json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Failed to fetch order {order_id} from Squarespace: {str(e)}")
              return None

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              headers = {k.lower(): v for k, v in (event.get('headers') or {}).items()}
              stripe_signature = headers.get('stripe-signature', '')
              raw_body = event.get('body', '')

              if event.get('isBase64Encoded', False):
                  import base64
                  raw_body = base64.b64decode(raw_body).decode('utf-8')

              secrets = get_secrets()
              stripe_secret = secrets.get('stripe_webhook_secret', '')
              sqsp_key = secrets.get('squarespace_api_key', '')

              if not verify_stripe_signature(raw_body, stripe_signature, stripe_secret):
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Invalid signature'})}

              try:
                  stripe_event = json.loads(raw_body)
              except Exception:
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Malformed JSON body'})}

              event_type = stripe_event.get('type')
              event_obj = stripe_event.get('data', {}).get('object', {})

              order_id = (event_obj.get('metadata') or {}).get('squarespace_order_id')
              order_details = None
              if order_id and sqsp_key:
                  order_details = fetch_squarespace_order(order_id, sqsp_key)

              amount_received = event_obj.get('amount_received') or event_obj.get('amount', 0)
              currency = (event_obj.get('currency') or 'USD').upper()
              amount_str = f"{amount_received / 100:.2f} {currency}"

              items_summary = []
              if order_details and 'lineItems' in order_details:
                  for item in order_details.get('lineItems', []):
                      items_summary.append(f"• {item.get('quantity', 1)}x {item.get('productName', 'Item')} (SKU: {item.get('sku', 'N/A')})")

              slack_message = {
                  "text": f":tada: New Payment Received: {amount_str}",
                  "blocks": [
                      {
                          "type": "header",
                          "text": {"type": "plain_text", "text": "New Sale Notification", "emoji": True}
                      },
                      {
                          "type": "section",
                          "fields": [
                              {"type": "mrkdwn", "text": f"*Event Type:*\n`{event_type}`"},
                              {"type": "mrkdwn", "text": f"*Amount:*\n*{amount_str}*"},
                              {"type": "mrkdwn", "text": f"*Stripe Payment:*\n`{event_obj.get('id', 'N/A')}`"},
                              {"type": "mrkdwn", "text": f"*Squarespace Order:*\n`{order_id or 'Not linked'}`"}
                          ]
                      }
                  ]
              }

              if items_summary:
                  slack_message["blocks"].append({
                      "type": "section",
                      "text": {"type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*Order Items:*\n" + "\n".join(items_summary)}
                  })

              sns_client.publish(
                  TopicArn=SNS_TOPIC_ARN,
                  Subject="Stripe/Squarespace Sale Notification",
                  Message=json.dumps(slack_message)
              )

              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps({'status': 'success', 'event': event_type})}

      Tags:

        - IpProtocol: -1

        - !Ref LabSubnet2

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                  - dynamodb:Query

                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${OrdersTable.Arn}/index/*'

  DaxCluster:
    Type: AWS::DAX::Cluster
    Condition: CreateDaxCluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax'
      Description: DAX cluster for caching orders DynamoDB table
      NodeType: dax.t3.small
      ReplicationFactor: !Ref DaxReplicationFactor
      IAMRoleARN: !GetAtt DaxServiceRole.Arn
      SubnetGroupName: !Ref DaxSubnetGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained test environment for Amazon ElastiCache for Redis Replication Group
  with Cluster Mode enabled across two Availability Zones, customer-managed KMS key,
  SNS topic for CloudWatch alarms, and IAM role for SSM Automation signaling.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the test VPC.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  Subnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Subnet 1 (AZ 1).
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  Subnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Subnet 2 (AZ 2).
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  CacheNodeType:
    Type: String
    Default: cache.t4g.medium
    Description: ElastiCache Redis cluster node instance type.
    AllowedValues:
      - cache.t4g.micro
      - cache.t4g.small
      - cache.t4g.medium
      - cache.m6g.large
      - cache.m6g.xlarge
      - cache.r6g.large
      - cache.r6g.xlarge
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a supported ElastiCache Redis node type.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-vpc

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2

  ElastiCacheSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ElastiCache Redis cluster
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet1Cidr
          Description: Inbound Redis from Subnet 1
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet2Cidr
          Description: Inbound Redis from Subnet 2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-redis-sg

  ElastiCacheSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ElastiCacheSecurityGroup
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ElastiCacheSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 6379
      ToPort: 6379
      Description: Allow Redis cluster nodes to communicate with each other

  ElastiCacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Subnet group for multi-AZ Redis cluster
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-redis-subnet-group

  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS customer-managed key for ElastiCache and SNS topic encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: KeyPolicy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAndSNSToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowElastiCacheServiceKeyUsage
            Effect: Allow

              Service: elasticache.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-kms-key

  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  SNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-alarms
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-alarms

  SNSTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref SNSTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: SNSTopicPolicy
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref SNSTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  RedisReplicationGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::ReplicationGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ReplicationGroupDescription: Multi-AZ Redis cluster with cluster mode enabled
      Engine: redis
      CacheNodeType: !Ref CacheNodeType
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Ref ElastiCacheSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ElastiCacheSecurityGroup
      NumNodeGroups: 2
      ReplicasPerNodeGroup: 1
      AutomaticFailoverEnabled: true
      MultiAZEnabled: true
      AtRestEncryptionEnabled: true
      TransitEncryptionEnabled: true
      KmsKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Scan"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)

        #end

    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver

    Value: !Ref SongsTable

  SongsTableArn:
    Description: DynamoDB Table ARN for Songs
    Value: !GetAtt SongsTable.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito User Pool with REST API secured by Cognito User Pool Authorizer and backing Lambda function.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  ApiHandlerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api-handler'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              request_context = event.get('requestContext', {})
              authorizer = request_context.get('authorizer', {})
              claims = authorizer.get('claims') if authorizer else None

              if claims:
                  response_data = {
                      'status': 'authenticated',
                      'message': 'Successfully accessed protected endpoint',
                      'claims': claims
                  }
              else:
                  response_data = {
                      'status': 'unauthenticated',
                      'message': 'Successfully accessed open endpoint',
                      'claims': None
                  }

              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps(response_data)
              }

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      Description: Regional API with Cognito authentication
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoAuthorizer
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  MeResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: me
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  OpenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: open
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  MeGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      HttpMethod: GET
      ResourceId: !Ref MeResource
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref ApiAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ApiHandlerFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  OpenGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      HttpMethod: GET
      ResourceId: !Ref OpenResource
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ApiHandlerFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  LambdaApiGatewayPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ApiHandlerFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/*'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MeGetMethod
      - OpenGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool App Client ID
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  MeEndpointUrl:
    Description: Protected GET /me endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/me'

  OpenEndpointUrl:
    Description: Unauthenticated GET /open endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/open'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for integrating with the marbot.io monitoring and alerting service.

Parameters:
  EndpointId:
    Type: String
    Description: Your marbot endpoint ID (UUID provided in the marbot onboarding wizard).
    Default: 'placeholder-endpoint-id'
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid marbot endpoint identifier containing only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
  MarbotAwsAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: The AWS Account ID belonging to marbot that is allowed to assume the cross-account role. Leave empty or set to 'self' to use the current AWS account (useful in greenfield/testing environments).
    Default: 'self'
    AllowedPattern: '^(self|[0-9]{12})$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 'self' or a valid 12-digit AWS account ID.
  EnableAutomaticMonitoring:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable marbot to automatically configure CloudWatch alarms and monitoring rules across AWS resources.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  EnableAccountAliasEnrichment:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable marbot to discover AWS IAM account alias to enrich alert messages.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  EnableMetricGraphs:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable marbot to query CloudWatch metrics to embed metric graphs directly into alert notifications.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  EnableCodePipelineApproval:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable marbot to approve or reject AWS CodePipeline manual approval stages directly from chat.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

Conditions:
  UseSelfAccount: !Equals [!Ref MarbotAwsAccountId, 'self']
  IsAutomaticMonitoringEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableAutomaticMonitoring, 'true']
  IsAccountAliasEnrichmentEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableAccountAliasEnrichment, 'true']
  IsMetricGraphsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableMetricGraphs, 'true']
  IsCodePipelineApprovalEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableCodePipelineApproval, 'true']

Resources:
  # EventBridge Connection to marbot.io
  MarbotEventBridgeConnection:
    Type: AWS::Events::Connection
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-connection-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: HTTP API Connection for sending events to marbot.io
      AuthorizationType: API_KEY
      AuthParameters:
        ApiKeyAuthParameters:
          ApiKeyName: x-api-key
          ApiKeyValue: !Ref EndpointId

  # EventBridge API Destination pointing to marbot's webhook
  MarbotApiDestination:
    Type: AWS::Events::ApiDestination
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-destination-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: API Destination for marbot.io webhook
      ConnectionArn: !GetAtt MarbotEventBridgeConnection.Arn
      HttpMethod: POST
      InvocationEndpoint: !Sub 'https://api.marbot.io/v1/endpoint/${EndpointId}'
      InvocationRateLimitPerSecond: 10

  # IAM Role for EventBridge to invoke the API Destination
  MarbotEventBridgeInvocationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'marbot-events-role-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeApiDestinationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:InvokeApiDestination
                Resource: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn

  # Scheduled keep-alive heartbeat rule running every 30 days
  MarbotHeartbeatRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-heartbeat-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: Sends periodic heartbeat signals to marbot.io every 30 days to maintain active registration.
      ScheduleExpression: 'rate(30 days)'
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: MarbotHeartbeatTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt MarbotEventBridgeInvocationRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub |
            {
              "type": "heartbeat",
              "accountId": "${AWS::AccountId}",
              "region": "${AWS::Region}",
              "stackId": "${AWS::StackId}",
              "endpointId": "${EndpointId}"
            }

  # Permissions Boundary Policy for roles managed/created by marbot
  MarbotPermissionsBoundary:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: IsAutomaticMonitoringEnabled
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'marbot-permissions-boundary-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: Permissions boundary applied to resources managed by marbot automatic monitoring.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
              - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
              - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
              - cloudwatch:ListTagsForResource
              - cloudwatch:TagResource
              - cloudwatch:UntagResource
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeRuleManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - events:DescribeRule
              - events:PutRule
              - events:DeleteRule
              - events:PutTargets
              - events:RemoveTargets
              - events:ListTargetsByRule
              - events:ListTagsForResource
              - events:TagResource
              - events:UntagResource
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/marbot-*'
          - Sid: AllowResourceDiscovery
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - rds:Describe*
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - lambda:List*
              - dynamodb:List*
              - dynamodb:Describe*
              - ecs:List*
              - ecs:Describe*
              - sqs:List*
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyIamChanges
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - iam:Create*
              - iam:Delete*
              - iam:Attach*
              - iam:Detach*
              - iam:Put*
            Resource: '*'

  # Cross-account IAM Role for marbot
  MarbotCrossAccountRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'marbot-access-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: Cross-account role assumed by marbot.io service to monitor resources and deliver alerts.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - UseSelfAccount
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${MarbotAwsAccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                sts:ExternalId: !Sub '${AWS::StackId}'
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - IsAutomaticMonitoringEnabled
        - !Ref MarbotPermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Policies:
        - !If
          - IsAutomaticMonitoringEnabled
          - PolicyName: AutomaticMonitoring
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: CloudWatchAlarmsManagement
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                    - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                    - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                    - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
                    - cloudwatch:ListTagsForResource
                    - cloudwatch:TagResource
                    - cloudwatch:UntagResource
                  Resource: '*'
                - Sid: EventBridgeRulesManagement
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - events:DescribeRule
                    - events:PutRule
                    - events:DeleteRule
                    - events:PutTargets
                    - events:RemoveTargets
                    - events:ListTargetsByRule
                    - events:ListTagsForResource
                    - events:TagResource
                    - events:UntagResource
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/marbot-*'
                - Sid: ResourceDiscovery
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - ec2:Describe*
                    - rds:Describe*
                    - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                    - lambda:List*
                    - dynamodb:List*
                    - dynamodb:Describe*
                    - ecs:List*
                    - ecs:Describe*
                    - sqs:List*
                    - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                    - apigateway:GET
                    - cloudfront:List*
                    - autoscaling:Describe*
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - IsAccountAliasEnrichmentEnabled
          - PolicyName: AccountAliasEnrichment
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: ReadAccountAliases
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - iam:ListAccountAliases
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - IsMetricGraphsEnabled
          - PolicyName: MetricGraphs
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: CloudWatchMetricsRead
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                    - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                    - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

          - IsCodePipelineApprovalEnabled
          - PolicyName: CodePipelineApproval

                    - codepipeline:PutApprovalResult
                    - codepipeline:GetPipelineState
                    - codepipeline:GetPipeline
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # Lambda Execution Role for marbot Registration Custom Resource
  MarbotRegistrationLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'marbot-registration-lambda-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

  # Lambda Function to register/deregister account with marbot
  MarbotRegistrationLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'marbot-registrar-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: CloudFormation Custom Resource handler to register/deregister the AWS account with marbot.io
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt MarbotRegistrationLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error

          def send_cfn_response(event, context, status, response_data, physical_id=None, reason=None):
              response_url = event['ResponseURL']
              response_body = {
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': reason or f'See CloudWatch Log Stream: {context.log_stream_name}',
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_id or event.get('PhysicalResourceId', context.log_stream_name),
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': response_data
              }
              json_data = json.dumps(response_body).encode('utf-8')
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  response_url,
                  data=json_data,
                  headers={'Content-Type': '', 'Content-Length': str(len(json_data))},
                  method='PUT'
              )
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                      print(f'CFN response sent successfully: {resp.status}')
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f'Failed to send CFN response: {e}')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              print(f"Received event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              endpoint_id = props.get('EndpointId', '')
              
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or f"marbot-{endpoint_id}"
              
              # If placeholder endpoint is used (such as during test deployments), bypass external API call
              if not endpoint_id or endpoint_id == 'placeholder-endpoint-id':
                  print("Placeholder endpoint detected. Skipping external API call.")
                  send_cfn_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'Status': 'SkippedPlaceholder'}, physical_id=physical_id)
                  return

              marbot_url = f"https://api.marbot.io/v1/endpoint/{endpoint_id}"
              action = 'register' if request_type in ['Create', 'Update'] else 'deregister'
              payload = {
                  'action': action,
                  'requestType': request_type,
                  'accountId': props.get('AccountId'),
                  'region': props.get('Region'),
                  'stackId': props.get('StackId'),
                  'roleArn': props.get('RoleArn'),
                  'externalId': props.get('ExternalId')
              }
              
              try:
                  req = urllib.request.Request(
                      marbot_url,
                      data=json.dumps(payload).encode('utf-8'),
                      headers={
                          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                          'x-api-key': endpoint_id
                      },
                      method='POST'
                  )
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as response:
                      res_body = response.read().decode('utf-8')
                      print(f"Marbot API response: {response.status} - {res_body}")
                  send_cfn_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'Status': 'Registered'}, physical_id=physical_id)
              except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                  error_body = e.read().decode('utf-8')
                  print(f"HTTPError contacting marbot: {e.code} {e.reason} - {error_body}")
                  if request_type == 'Delete':
                      send_cfn_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'Status': 'DeregisterIgnored'}, physical_id=physical_id)
                  else:
                      send_cfn_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {}, physical_id=physical_id, reason=f"Marbot returned HTTP {e.code}: {error_body}")
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Exception contacting marbot: {str(e)}")
                  if request_type == 'Delete':
                      send_cfn_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'Status': 'DeregisterIgnored'}, physical_id=physical_id)
                  else:
                      send_cfn_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {}, physical_id=physical_id, reason=str(e))

  # Custom Resource to invoke registration on stack creation and cleanup on deletion
  MarbotRegistration:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt MarbotRegistrationLambda.Arn
      EndpointId: !Ref EndpointId
      AccountId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Region: !Ref AWS::Region
      StackId: !Ref AWS::StackId
      RoleArn: !GetAtt MarbotCrossAccountRole.Arn
      ExternalId: !Ref AWS::StackId

Outputs:

    Description: ARN of the EventBridge Connection for marbot.io.
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotEventBridgeConnection.Arn

    Description: ARN of the EventBridge API Destination for marbot.io.

  CrossAccountRoleArn:

    Description: External ID required for marbot.io to assume the cross-account role.

    Description: ARN of the EventBridge 30-day heartbeat rule.
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotHeartbeatRule.Arn
  PermissionsBoundaryArn:
    Condition: IsAutomaticMonitoringEnabled
    Description: ARN of the IAM Permissions Boundary applied to marbot-managed resources.
    Value: !Ref MarbotPermissionsBoundary

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS Glue Data Catalog database with optional crawler and Spark ETL job.

Parameters:
  Prefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Resource naming prefix.
    Default: data-catalog
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 30
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Target deployment environment.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev

  SourceBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the existing source S3 bucket for crawler discovery and ETL input (e.g., arn:aws:s3:::my-source-bucket).
    Default: arn:aws:s3:::example-datalake-source-bucket
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws:s3:::[a-z0-9.-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket ARN (arn:aws:s3:::bucketname).

  SourceBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Path prefix inside the source S3 bucket to scan or read from (without leading slash).
    Default: ''

  EnableCrawler:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether to deploy the Glue crawler for schema and partition discovery.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'

  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Description: Cron schedule expression for the crawler (in UTC).
    Default: 'cron(0 0 * * ? *)'

  EnableJob:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether to deploy the Glue Spark ETL job.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'

  JobScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 path to the PySpark or Scala ETL script (e.g., s3://bucket/scripts/etl.py). Required if EnableJob is true.
    Default: ''

  TargetBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the target S3 bucket for ETL output data (e.g., arn:aws:s3:::my-target-bucket). Required if EnableJob is true.
    Default: ''

  TargetBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Path prefix inside the target S3 bucket where transformed data is written.
    Default: output/

  WorkerType:
    Type: String
    Description: Worker type for the Glue Spark job.
    AllowedValues:
      - G.1X
      - G.2X
      - G.4X
      - G.8X
    Default: G.1X

  NumberOfWorkers:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of workers allocated to the Glue Spark job.
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 299

  JobTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum execution time in minutes for the Glue Spark job.
    Default: 2880
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 2880

  MaxConcurrentRuns:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum number of concurrent runs allowed for the Glue Spark job.
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Retention period in days for Glue job CloudWatch logs.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
    Default: 30

Conditions:
  CreateCrawler: !Equals [!Ref EnableCrawler, 'true']
  CreateJob: !Equals [!Ref EnableJob, 'true']
  CreateAnyServiceResource: !Or [!Condition CreateCrawler, !Condition CreateJob]
  HasTargetBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetBucketArn, '']]
  HasSourcePrefix: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SourceBucketPrefix, '']]
  HasTargetPrefix: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetBucketPrefix, '']]

Resources:
  GlueCatalogDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${Prefix}_${Environment}_catalog_db'
        Description: !Sub 'Data Catalog database for ${Prefix} in ${Environment} environment.'

  GlueJobLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: CreateJob
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws-glue/jobs/${Prefix}-${Environment}-spark-etl'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateAnyServiceResource
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-glue-service-role'
      Description: Shared IAM service role for AWS Glue crawler and Spark ETL job.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueSourceBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListSourceBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !Ref SourceBucketArn
              - Sid: ReadSourceBucketObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${SourceBucketArn}/*'
        - !If
          - HasTargetBucket
          - PolicyName: GlueTargetBucketAccess
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: ListTargetBucket
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:ListBucket
                    - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  Resource: !Ref TargetBucketArn
                - Sid: ReadWriteTargetBucketObjects
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:PutObject
                    - s3:DeleteObject
                  Resource: !Sub '${TargetBucketArn}/*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - CreateJob
          - PolicyName: GlueCloudWatchLoggingAccess
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: AllowContinuousLogging
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - logs:CreateLogStream
                    - logs:PutLogEvents
                  Resource: !GetAtt GlueJobLogGroup.Arn
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  GlueCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Condition: CreateCrawler
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-crawler'
      Description: !Sub 'Crawler for ${Prefix} in ${Environment} to discover partitions and schemas.'
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueCatalogDatabase
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref CrawlerSchedule
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: CRAWL_NEW_FOLDERS_ONLY
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: LOG
        DeleteBehavior: LOG
      Configuration: '{"Version":1.0,"CrawlerOutput":{"Partitions":{"AddOrUpdateBehavior":"InheritFromTable"}}}'
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !If
              - HasSourcePrefix
              - !Sub
                - 's3://${BucketName}/${PrefixPath}'
                - BucketName: !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
                  PrefixPath: !Ref SourceBucketPrefix
              - !Sub
                - 's3://${BucketName}'
                - BucketName: !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref SourceBucketArn]]

  GlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Condition: CreateJob
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-spark-etl'
      Description: !Sub 'Spark ETL job for ${Prefix} in ${Environment}.'
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '4.0'
      WorkerType: !Ref WorkerType
      NumberOfWorkers: !Ref NumberOfWorkers
      Timeout: !Ref JobTimeout
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: !Ref MaxConcurrentRuns
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Ref JobScriptLocation
        PythonVersion: '3'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-bookmark-option': 'job-bookmark-enable'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--continuous-log-logGroup': !Ref GlueJobLogGroup
        '--enable-spark-ui': 'true'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--source_database': !Ref GlueCatalogDatabase
        '--source_bucket': !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
        '--source_prefix': !Ref SourceBucketPrefix
        '--target_bucket': !If
          - HasTargetBucket
          - !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref TargetBucketArn]]
          - ''
        '--target_prefix': !Ref TargetBucketPrefix
