  DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt MacroExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: CloudFormation macro handler to generate Datadog IAM policy fragments
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))
              request_id = event.get("requestId", "")
              params = event.get("params", {}) or {}
              fragment = event.get("fragment", {})

              try:
                  policy_type = params.get("PolicyType")
                  bucket_arn = params.get("BucketArn", "*")

                  if bucket_arn != "*" and not bucket_arn.endswith("/*"):
                      bucket_resource = f"{bucket_arn}/*"
                  else:
                      bucket_resource = bucket_arn

                  if policy_type == "LogArchive":
                      generated_policy = {
                          "Type": "AWS::IAM::Policy",
                          "Properties": {
                              "PolicyName": "DatadogLogArchiveAndRehydratePolicy",
                              "PolicyDocument": {
                                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                                  "Statement": [
                                      {
                                          "Sid": "DatadogLogArchiveList",
                                          "Effect": "Allow",
                                          "Action": [
                                              "s3:ListBucket"
                                          ],
                                          "Resource": [bucket_arn]
                                      },
                                      {
                                          "Sid": "DatadogLogArchiveGetAndPut",
                                          "Effect": "Allow",
                                          "Action": [
                                              "s3:GetObject",
                                              "s3:PutObject"
                                          ],
                                          "Resource": [bucket_resource]
                                      }
                                  ]
                              }
                          }
                      }
                      if isinstance(fragment, dict):
                          fragment.update(generated_policy)
                      else:
                          fragment = generated_policy

                  elif policy_type == "CloudTrail":
                      generated_policy = {
                          "Type": "AWS::IAM::Policy",
                          "Properties": {
                              "PolicyName": "DatadogCloudTrailsPolicy",
                              "PolicyDocument": {
                                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                                  "Statement": [
                                      {
                                          "Sid": "DatadogCloudTrailBucketAccess",
                                          "Effect": "Allow",
                                          "Action": [
                                              "s3:ListBucket",
                                              "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                                          ],
                                          "Resource": [bucket_arn]
                                      },
                                      {
                                          "Sid": "DatadogCloudTrailObjectAccess",
                                          "Effect": "Allow",
                                          "Action": [
                                              "s3:GetObject"
                                          ],
                                          "Resource": [bucket_resource]
                                      }
                                  ]
                              }
                          }
                      }
                      if isinstance(fragment, dict):
                          fragment.update(generated_policy)
                      else:
                          fragment = generated_policy

                  return {
                      "requestId": request_id,
                      "status": "SUCCESS",
                      "fragment": fragment
                  }

                      "status": "FAILURE",

Description: CloudFormation template to create an Amazon S3 bucket with versioning, customer managed KMS key encryption, public access block, security policies, and tags for testing.

Resources:
  TestBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for S3 test bucket server-side encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: TestBucketKeyPolicy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: test-key
        - Key: AppName
          Value: test
        - Key: Env
          Value: dev

  TestBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-test-bucket-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TestBucketKey

  TestBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt TestBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: test
        - Key: AppName
          Value: test
        - Key: Env
          Value: dev

  TestBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TestBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt TestBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${TestBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

Outputs:
  BucketName:
    Description: Name of the created S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref TestBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TestBucketName'
  BucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the created S3 bucket
    Value: !GetAtt TestBucket.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TestBucketArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates a customer-managed KMS key and key alias to secure AWS service data encryption and optional deletion alerts.

Parameters:
  ParentAlertStack:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional name of the parent alert stack providing an SNS topic export for deletion and disablement alerts. Leave empty to disable alerts.
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL_SERVICES
    AllowedValues:
      - ALL_SERVICES
      - S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS
      - connect
      - dms
      - ssm
      - ec2
      - elasticfilesystem
      - es
      - kinesis
      - kinesisvideo
      - lambda
      - lex
      - redshift
      - rds
      - secretsmanager
      - ses
      - s3
      - importexport
      - sqs
      - workmail
      - workspaces
    Description: Service allowed to use this key. Set to ALL_SERVICES, S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS, or a specific service.

Conditions:
  HasAlertStack: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ParentAlertStack, '']]
  IsAllServices: !Equals [!Ref Service, ALL_SERVICES]
  IsS3PublicAccess: !Equals [!Ref Service, S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS]
  IsSpecificService: !And
    - !Not [!Condition IsAllServices]
    - !Not [!Condition IsS3PublicAccess]

Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key created by stack ${AWS::StackName} for service: ${Service}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: KeyPolicy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCryptographicOperations
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !If
                  - IsSpecificService
                  - !Sub '${Service}.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                  - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - Sid: AllowS3PublicAccessDecryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !If
                  - IsS3PublicAccess
                  - !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                  - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
                'kms:CallerAccount': !If
                  - IsS3PublicAccess
                  - !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
                  - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  KeyDeletionAlertRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: HasAlertStack
    Properties:
      Description: Alert rule for KMS key deletion and disablement events

        source:
          - aws.kms
        detail-type:
          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - kms.amazonaws.com
          eventName:
            - ScheduleKeyDeletion
            - DisableKey
          resources:
            - !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !ImportValue
            'Fn::Sub': '${ParentAlertStack}-TopicArn'
          Id: ParentAlertSNSTopic

Outputs:
  KeyId:
    Description: KMS Key ID
    Value: !Ref KMSKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyId'
  KeyArn:
    Description: KMS Key ARN
    Value: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyArn'
  KeyAlias:
    Description: KMS Key Alias
    Value: !Ref KMSKeyAlias
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyAlias'

    Default: production

    Description: Target deployment environment.

        Statement:

                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'

        - Key: Environment

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito authentication layer for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway using OAuth2 client credentials.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: Name of the project, used for resource naming and tags.
  RequireSymbols:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to require symbols in user passwords.

Conditions:
  ShouldRequireSymbols: !Equals [!Ref RequireSymbols, 'true']

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentcore-gateway-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: !If [ShouldRequireSymbols, true, false]
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub
        - 'agentcore-${AWS::Region}-${StackSuffix}'
        - StackSuffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: agentcore-gateway
      Name: agentcore-gateway-resources
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AgentCore Gateway
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AgentCore Gateway
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Admin access to AgentCore Gateway

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: agentcore-gateway-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - agentcore-gateway/read
        - agentcore-gateway/write
        - agentcore-gateway/admin

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-cognito-secret-sync-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
        - PolicyName: CognitoDescribeClientPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
        - PolicyName: SecretsManagerAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret*'

  SecretSyncLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-cognito-secret-sync'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import urllib.request
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
          secretsmanager = boto3.client('secretsmanager')

          def send_response(event, context, response_status, response_data, physical_resource_id=None):
              response_url = event['ResponseURL']
              response_body = json.dumps({
                  'Status': response_status,
                  'Reason': f'See CloudWatch Log Stream: {context.log_stream_name}',
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': response_data
              }).encode('utf-8')

              headers = {
                  'content-type': '',
                  'content-length': str(len(response_body))
              }

              req = urllib.request.Request(response_url, data=response_body, headers=headers, method='PUT')
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
                      logger.info(f"Status code: {response.status}")
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Failed sending response: {e}")

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Received event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              properties = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              user_pool_id = properties.get('UserPoolId')
              client_id = properties.get('ClientId')
              secret_name = properties.get('SecretName')

              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or f"{secret_name}-resource"

              if request_type == 'Delete':
                  try:
                      secretsmanager.delete_secret(
                          SecretId=secret_name,
                          ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery=True
                      )
                      logger.info(f"Force-deleted secret {secret_name}")
                  except ClientError as e:
                      if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ResourceNotFoundException':
                          logger.info(f"Secret {secret_name} already deleted or not found.")
                      else:
                          logger.error(f"Error deleting secret: {e}")
                          send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {}, physical_id)
                          return
                  send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_id)
                  return

              try:
                  client_resp = cognito.describe_user_pool_client(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      ClientId=client_id
                  )
                  client_secret = client_resp['UserPoolClient'].get('ClientSecret')
                  if not client_secret:
                      raise ValueError("ClientSecret not found on UserPoolClient")

                  secret_payload = json.dumps({
                      'client_id': client_id,
                      'client_secret': client_secret,
                      'user_pool_id': user_pool_id
                  })

                  try:
                      secretsmanager.describe_secret(SecretId=secret_name)
                      secretsmanager.put_secret_value(
                          SecretId=secret_name,
                          SecretString=secret_payload
                      )
                      logger.info(f"Updated secret {secret_name}")
                  except ClientError as e:
                      if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ResourceNotFoundException':
                          secretsmanager.create_secret(
                              Name=secret_name,
                              Description="Cognito client credentials for AgentCore Gateway",
                              SecretString=secret_payload
                          )
                          logger.info(f"Created secret {secret_name}")
                      else:
                          raise e

                  send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'SecretName': secret_name}, physical_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Failed to process secret sync: {e}")
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {'Error': str(e)}, physical_id)

  CognitoSecretSynchronizer:
    Type: Custom::CognitoSecretSynchronizer
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SecretSyncLambda.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
      SecretName: !Sub '${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret'

  SSMOidcDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/oidc-discovery-url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL for the Cognito User Pool

  SSMClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/client-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
      Description: Cognito confidential App Client ID

  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID

  SSMUserPoolArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      Description: Cognito User Pool ARN

  SSMHostedDomainUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/hosted-domain-url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Description: Cognito hosted UI domain URL

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn'

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool Client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId'

  OidcDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OpenID Connect discovery endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-OidcDiscoveryUrl'

  HostedDomainUrl:
    Description: Cognito Hosted UI domain URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HostedDomainUrl'

  TokenEndpointUrl:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TokenEndpointUrl'

  CustomScopes:
    Description: List of granted custom scopes for client credentials
    Value: agentcore-gateway/read agentcore-gateway/write agentcore-gateway/admin
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CustomScopes'

  SecretsManagerSecretName:
    Description: Name of the Secrets Manager secret containing client credentials
    Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SecretsManagerSecretName'

  SSMParameterOidcDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: SSM parameter path for OIDC discovery URL
    Value: !Ref SSMOidcDiscoveryUrl

  SSMParameterClientId:
    Description: SSM parameter path for Client ID
    Value: !Ref SSMClientId

  SSMParameterUserPoolId:
    Description: SSM parameter path for User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref SSMUserPoolId

  SSMParameterUserPoolArn:
    Description: SSM parameter path for User Pool ARN
    Value: !Ref SSMUserPoolArn

  SSMParameterHostedDomainUrl:
    Description: SSM parameter path for Hosted Domain URL
    Value: !Ref SSMHostedDomainUrl

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito Identity Bootstrap for Multi-Tenant SaaS Operations Application with ABAC Tag-based DynamoDB Isolation.

Parameters:
  TenantAppCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Default: https://app.example.com/callback
    Description: Tenant application callback host URL (e.g., https://app.example.com/callback)
  AdminAppCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Default: https://admin.example.com/callback
    Description: Admin operations application callback host URL (e.g., https://admin.example.com/callback)
  SiloedTenantRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: authenticated-siloed-user-role
    Description: IAM role name for authenticated siloed tenant users

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # 1. Pooled Tenant User Pool & App Client
  # ============================================================================
  PooledTenantUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailSubject: Welcome to the SaaS Operations Application
          EmailMessage: !Sub >
            Welcome to the SaaS Operations Application!
            Your temporary username is {username} and your temporary password is {####}.
            Please log in at ${TenantAppCallbackHost} to set your new password.

  PooledTenantUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsClient
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref TenantAppCallbackHost
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref TenantAppCallbackHost
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
      IdTokenValidity: 12
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours

  PooledTenantUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool
      Domain: !Sub pooledtenant-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}

  # ============================================================================
  # 2. Operations Users Pool, App Client, Domain & Group
  # ============================================================================
  OperationsUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: OperationUsers-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: apiKey
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailSubject: Welcome to the SaaS Operations Admin Portal
          EmailMessage: !Sub >
            Welcome to the SaaS Operations Admin Portal!
            Your temporary username is {username} and your temporary password is {####}.
            Please log in at ${AdminAppCallbackHost} to set your new password.

  OperationsUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationsUserPool
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsOperationUsersPoolClient
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref AdminAppCallbackHost
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref AdminAppCallbackHost
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
        - custom:apiKey
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
        - custom:apiKey
      IdTokenValidity: 12
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours

  OperationsUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationsUserPool
      Domain: !Sub operationsusers-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}

  SystemAdminsUserPoolGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: SystemAdmins
      Description: System Administrators with full administrative privileges
      Precedence: 0
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationsUserPool

  # ============================================================================
  # 3. OIDC Identity Providers ("Cognito" self-registration)
  # ============================================================================
  PooledTenantOidcProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool
      ProviderName: Cognito
      ProviderType: OIDC
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref PooledTenantUserPoolClient
        attributes_request_method: GET
        oidc_issuer: !Sub https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PooledTenantUserPool}
        authorize_scopes: email openid profile
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        custom:tenantId: custom:tenantId
        custom:userRole: custom:userRole

  OperationsUserOidcProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationsUserPool
      ProviderName: Cognito
      ProviderType: OIDC
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref OperationsUserPoolClient
        attributes_request_method: GET
        oidc_issuer: !Sub https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${OperationsUserPool}
        authorize_scopes: email openid profile
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        custom:tenantId: custom:tenantId
        custom:userRole: custom:userRole
        custom:apiKey: custom:apiKey

  # ============================================================================
  # 4. Identity Pools
  # ============================================================================
  PooledTenantIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !Sub cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PooledTenantUserPool}

  OperationsIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: OperationsUser-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref OperationsUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !Sub cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${OperationsUserPool}

  # ============================================================================
  # 5. Principal Tag Mappings
  # ============================================================================
  PooledTenantPrincipalTags:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolPrincipalTag
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
      IdentityProviderName: !Sub cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PooledTenantUserPool}
      UseDefaults: false
      PrincipalTags:
        tenantId: custom:tenantId
        userRole: custom:userRole

  OperationsPrincipalTags:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolPrincipalTag
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref OperationsIdentityPool
      IdentityProviderName: !Sub cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${OperationsUserPool}
      UseDefaults: false
      PrincipalTags:
        tenantId: custom:tenantId
        userRole: custom:userRole

  # ============================================================================
  # 6. IAM Roles & Policies for Authenticated Pooled and Siloed Users
  # ============================================================================
  AuthenticatedPooledUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: authenticated-pooled-user-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud:
                  - !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
                  - !Ref OperationsIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PooledTenantDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # Tenant-scoped access to shared pooled Product and Order tables
              - Sid: TenantItemLevelAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order/*
                Condition:
                  'ForAllValues:StringEquals':
                    dynamodb:LeadingKeys:
                      - '${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}'
              # TenantAdmin access to administration and configuration tables
              - Sid: TenantAdminTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/tenant-user-mapping
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/tenant-user-mapping/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/tenant-details
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/tenant-details/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/tenant-stack-mapping
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/tenant-stack-mapping/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/settings
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/settings/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'aws:PrincipalTag/userRole': TenantAdmin
              # SystemAdmin access to all DynamoDB tables and indexes
              - Sid: SystemAdminFullDynamoDBAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'aws:PrincipalTag/userRole': SystemAdmin

  AuthenticatedSiloedUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref SiloedTenantRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud:
                  - !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
                  - !Ref OperationsIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SiloedTenantDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # Siloed access to tenant-specific Product and Order tables suffixed with tenant ID
              - Sid: SiloedTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}/*
              # TenantAdmin access to configuration tables
              - Sid: SiloedTenantAdminTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/tenant-user-mapping
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/tenant-user-mapping/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/tenant-details
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/tenant-details/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/tenant-stack-mapping
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/tenant-stack-mapping/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/settings
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/settings/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'aws:PrincipalTag/userRole': TenantAdmin
              # SystemAdmin access to all tables and indexes
              - Sid: SiloedSystemAdminFullDynamoDBAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'aws:PrincipalTag/userRole': SystemAdmin

  # ============================================================================
  # 7. Identity Pool Role Attachments
  # ============================================================================
  PooledTenantIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedPooledUserRole.Arn

  OperationsIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref OperationsIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedPooledUserRole.Arn

Outputs:
  PooledTenantUserPoolId:
    Description: Pooled Tenant Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool

  PooledTenantClientId:
    Description: Pooled Tenant App Client ID
    Value: !Ref PooledTenantUserPoolClient

  PooledTenantIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Pooled Tenant Cognito Identity Pool ID
    Value: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool

  OperationsUserPoolId:
    Description: Operations User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref OperationsUserPool

  OperationsClientId:
    Description: Operations User Pool Client ID
    Value: !Ref OperationsUserPoolClient

  OperationsIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Operations Cognito Identity Pool ID
    Value: !Ref OperationsIdentityPool

  OperationsUserPoolProviderURL:
    Description: Operations User Pool Provider URL
    Value: !Sub https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${OperationsUserPool}

  SiloedTenantRoleName:
    Description: Siloed Tenant IAM Role Name
    Value: !Ref AuthenticatedSiloedUserRole

  SiloedTenantRoleArn:
    Description: Siloed Tenant IAM Role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt AuthenticatedSiloedUserRole.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready reusable DynamoDB table stack with optional GSIs, TTL, streams, auto-scaling, AWS Backup, and CloudWatch alarms.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) The name of the DynamoDB table. If not specified, CloudFormation generates a unique name.

  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    Description: (Required) The name of the partition key attribute. Defaults to 'id'.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, underscores, dots, or hyphens.

  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Description: The data type for the partition key attribute (S = String, N = Number, B = Binary).

  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) The name of the sort key attribute. Leave blank if no sort key is needed.

  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Description: The data type for the sort key attribute.

  ExtraAttribute1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Name of an additional attribute (e.g. for GSI key schemas).

  ExtraAttribute1Type:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Description: Data type of ExtraAttribute1.

  ExtraAttribute2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Name of a second additional attribute (e.g. for GSI key schemas).

  ExtraAttribute2Type:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Description: Data type of ExtraAttribute2.

  ExtraAttribute3Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Name of a third additional attribute (e.g. for GSI key schemas).

  ExtraAttribute3Type:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Description: Data type of ExtraAttribute3.

  GSI1IndexName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Name of Global Secondary Index 1.

  GSI1PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Partition key attribute name for GSI 1.

  GSI1SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Sort key attribute name for GSI 1.

  GSI2IndexName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Name of Global Secondary Index 2.

  GSI2PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Partition key attribute name for GSI 2.

  GSI2SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Sort key attribute name for GSI 2.

  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues: [PROVISIONED, PAY_PER_REQUEST]
    Description: Billing mode for the table.

  TimeToLiveAttribute:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Name of the TTL attribute. Leave empty to disable TTL.

  StreamViewType:
    Type: String
    Default: DISABLED
    AllowedValues: [DISABLED, NEW_IMAGE, OLD_IMAGE, NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES, KEYS_ONLY]
    Description: DynamoDB Streams configuration. Select DISABLED to turn off streams.

  EnableKmsEncryption:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable server-side encryption using the AWS managed KMS key (alias/aws/dynamodb).

  PointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) for the table.

  BackupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 36500
    Description: Retention period in days for AWS Backup. Set to 0 to disable automated backups.

  AlertNotificationTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) SNS Topic ARN for CloudWatch alarms and backup vault notifications. Leave empty to disable.

Conditions:
  HasTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, '']]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  HasExtraAttr1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute1Name, '']]
  HasExtraAttr2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute2Name, '']]
  HasExtraAttr3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute3Name, '']]
  HasGsi1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1IndexName, '']]
  HasGsi1SortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1SortKeyName, '']]
  HasGsi2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2IndexName, '']]
  HasGsi2SortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2SortKeyName, '']]
  HasAnyGsi: !Or [!Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1IndexName, '']], !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2IndexName, '']]]
  HasTTL: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TimeToLiveAttribute, '']]
  HasStreams: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StreamViewType, 'DISABLED']]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, 'PROVISIONED']
  IsKmsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableKmsEncryption, 'true']
  IsPitrEnabled: !Equals [!Ref PointInTimeRecovery, 'true']
  IsBackupEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BackupRetentionDays, 0]]
  HasAlerts: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn, '']]
  HasBackupAndAlerts: !And [!Not [!Equals [!Ref BackupRetentionDays, 0]], !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn, '']]]

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !If [HasTableName, !Ref TableName, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: 1
          WriteCapacityUnits: 1
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasExtraAttr1
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute1Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute1Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasExtraAttr2
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute2Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute2Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasExtraAttr3
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute3Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute3Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes: !If
        - HasAnyGsi
        - - !If
            - HasGsi1
            - IndexName: !Ref GSI1IndexName
              Projection:
                ProjectionType: ALL
              ProvisionedThroughput: !If
                - IsProvisioned
                - ReadCapacityUnits: 1
                  WriteCapacityUnits: 1
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              KeySchema:
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName
                  KeyType: HASH
                - !If
                  - HasGsi1SortKey
                  - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKeyName
                    KeyType: RANGE
                  - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - HasGsi2
            - IndexName: !Ref GSI2IndexName
              Projection:
                ProjectionType: ALL
              ProvisionedThroughput: !If
                - IsProvisioned
                - ReadCapacityUnits: 1
                  WriteCapacityUnits: 1
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              KeySchema:
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName
                  KeyType: HASH
                - !If
                  - HasGsi2SortKey
                  - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKeyName
                    KeyType: RANGE
                  - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [IsPitrEnabled, true, false]
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: !If [IsKmsEnabled, true, false]
        SSEType: !If [IsKmsEnabled, KMS, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
        KMSMasterKeyId: !If [IsKmsEnabled, alias/aws/dynamodb, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      TimeToLiveSpecification: !If
        - HasTTL
        - AttributeName: !Ref TimeToLiveAttribute
          Enabled: true
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      StreamSpecification: !If
        - HasStreams
        - StreamViewType: !Ref StreamViewType
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoScalingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                Resource: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

  ReadCapacityScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 1
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub table/${DynamoDBTable}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  ReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ReadScalingPolicy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ReadCapacityScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 80.0
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization

  WriteCapacityScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 1
      MinCapacity: 1

        PredefinedMetricSpecification:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template creating DynamoDB tables and Application Auto Scaling for an account-vending automation tool.

Parameters:
  Stage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage environment identifier (e.g., dev, test, prod).
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, dashes, or underscores.

Resources:
  ScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub talr-dynamodb-scaling-role-${Stage}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoScalingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/talr-*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
                Resource: '*'

  TalrCbInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub talr-cbInfo-${Stage}
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TalrAccountInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub talr-accountInfo-${Stage}
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: gsiRequestId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: requestId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: KEYS_ONLY
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
        - IndexName: gsiAccountId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: accountId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TalrTaskStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub talr-taskStatus-${Stage}
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES

  TalrNipapCfnTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub talr-nipapCfn-${Stage}
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TalrOpsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub talr-ops-${Stage}
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: layer
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: layer
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TalrDxInterfaceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub talr-dxInterface-${Stage}
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: vlan
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: vlan
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TalrClaStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub talr-claStatus-${Stage}
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TalrConfigRulesComplianceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub talr-configRulesCompliance-${Stage}
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  # Auto Scaling - AccountInfo Table Read
  AccountInfoReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub table/${TalrAccountInfoTable}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  AccountInfoReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub AccountInfoReadScalingPolicy-${Stage}
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization

  # Auto Scaling - AccountInfo Table Write

    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub table/${TalrAccountInfoTable}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  AccountInfoWriteScalingPolicy:

      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling

      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0

  # Auto Scaling - AccountInfo GSI gsiRequestId Read
  AccountInfoGsiRequestIdReadScalableTarget:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready highly available network foundation and ECS cluster for containerised Streamlit application.

Parameters:
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range between /16 and /28.

  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range between /16 and /28.

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range between /16 and /28.

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range between /16 and /28.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Streamlit-VPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Streamlit-IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Streamlit-Public-Subnet-AZ1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Streamlit-Public-Subnet-AZ2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Streamlit-Private-Subnet-AZ1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Streamlit-Private-Subnet-AZ2

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Streamlit-Public-RouteTable

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Streamlit-NAT-EIP-AZ1

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Streamlit-NAT-Gateway-AZ1

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Streamlit-NAT-EIP-AZ2

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Streamlit-NAT-Gateway-AZ2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Streamlit-Private-RouteTable-AZ1

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Streamlit-Private-RouteTable-AZ2

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: 7

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role for publishing VPC Flow Logs to CloudWatch Logs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Streamlit-VPC-FlowLogs

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-cluster
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Streamlit-ECS-Cluster

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC

  VpcCidr:
    Description: The CIDR block of the VPC.
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Subnet ID of Public Subnet 1 in AZ1.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Subnet ID of Public Subnet 2 in AZ2.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Subnet ID of Private Subnet 1 in AZ1.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Subnet ID of Private Subnet 2 in AZ2.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Description: Elastic IP address of NAT Gateway 1 in AZ1.
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1EIP

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Description: Elastic IP address of NAT Gateway 2 in AZ2.
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2EIP

  FlowLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Log Group for VPC Flow Logs.
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup

  ECSClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS Cluster with Container Insights enabled.
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster

  ECSClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS Cluster.
    Value: !GetAtt ECSCluster.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Service Catalog preventive controls validation test environment with VPC, KMS, DMS, ElastiCache, SageMaker, and product launch roles.

Resources:
  TestVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ServiceCatalogTestVPC

  TestSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      CidrBlock: 172.16.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ServiceCatalogTestSubnet1

  TestSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      CidrBlock: 172.16.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ServiceCatalogTestSubnet2

  TestSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Service Catalog test resources
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          FromPort: -1
          ToPort: -1
          CidrIp: 172.16.0.0/16
          Description: Allow internal VPC traffic
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          FromPort: -1
          ToPort: -1
          CidrIp: 172.16.0.0/16
          Description: Restrict egress to internal VPC traffic
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ServiceCatalogTestSG

  ElastiCacheSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ElastiCache clusters in test VPC
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: 172.16.0.0/16
          Description: Redis default port from VPC
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 11211
          ToPort: 11211
          CidrIp: 172.16.0.0/16
          Description: Memcached default port from VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          FromPort: -1
          ToPort: -1
          CidrIp: 172.16.0.0/16
          Description: Restrict egress to internal VPC traffic
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ServiceCatalogElastiCacheSG

  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dms-vpc-role
      Description: Required role for AWS DMS VPC and Replication Subnet Group operations
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
