    Type: String
    Default: restaurant-assistant
    Description: Project identifier used in resource names and tags.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment identifier.

Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer managed key for ${ProjectName}-${Environment} data stores
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: key-default-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDeliveryServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  LoggingBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  LoggingBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LoggingBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonHttpsAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${LoggingBucket}
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${LoggingBucket}/*
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${LoggingBucket}/*
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  ImageBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DependsOn: LoggingBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-images-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref LoggingBucket
        LogFilePrefix: images/
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ImageBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ImageBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonHttpsAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ImageBucket}
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ImageBucket}/*
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  SessionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-sessions
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: sessionId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: dataType
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: sessionId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: dataType
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MarketPricesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-market-prices
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ingredient
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: marketName
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: lastUpdated
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ingredient
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: marketName
          KeyType: RANGE
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: ingredient-lastUpdated-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: ingredient
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: lastUpdated
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RemindersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-reminders
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: reminderId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: reminderId
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rate-limits
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: rateLimitKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: rateLimitKey
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  KMSKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the Customer Managed KMS Key
    Value: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-KMSKeyArn

  KMSKeyId:
    Description: ID of the Customer Managed KMS Key
    Value: !Ref KMSKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-KMSKeyId

  KMSKeyAliasName:
    Description: Friendly Alias of the Customer Managed KMS Key
    Value: !Ref KMSKeyAlias
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-KMSKeyAlias

  LoggingBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket receiving access logs
    Value: !Ref LoggingBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-LoggingBucketName

  LoggingBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 bucket receiving access logs
    Value: !GetAtt LoggingBucket.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-LoggingBucketArn

  ImageBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket storing images
    Value: !Ref ImageBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-ImageBucketName

  ImageBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 bucket storing images
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBucket.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-ImageBucketArn

  SessionsTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB sessions table
    Value: !Ref SessionsTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-SessionsTableName

  SessionsTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB sessions table
    Value: !GetAtt SessionsTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-SessionsTableArn

  MarketPricesTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB market prices table
    Value: !Ref MarketPricesTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-MarketPricesTableName

  MarketPricesTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB market prices table
    Value: !GetAtt MarketPricesTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-MarketPricesTableArn

  RemindersTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB reminders table
    Value: !Ref RemindersTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-RemindersTableName

  RemindersTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB reminders table
    Value: !GetAtt RemindersTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-RemindersTableArn

  RateLimitsTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB rate limits table
    Value: !Ref RateLimitsTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-RateLimitsTableName

  RateLimitsTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB rate limits table
    Value: !GetAtt RateLimitsTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-RateLimitsTableArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Shared identity and state infrastructure for stateful Bedrock AgentCore demo,
  including Amazon Cognito User Pool with M2M and Web clients, DynamoDB state table,
  IAM execution roles, and SSM Parameter Store discovery values.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: agentcore-demo
    Description: Base name for all resources and SSM parameter hierarchy prefix.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphens.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment stage/environment name.

  TestUserEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: demo-agent-user@example.com
    Description: Email address for the seeded test user.
    AllowedPattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid email address format.

  TestUserPassword:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Default: DemoPass123!Secure
    Description: Initial password for the seeded demo user.
    MinLength: 8
    MaxLength: 128

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # 1. Identity Layer: Amazon Cognito User Pool, Domain, Resource Server
  # =========================================================================
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}'

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Sub 'https://${ProjectName}.api'
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-resource-server'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: 'finance.read'
          ScopeDescription: 'Read access to financial tracking state'
        - ScopeName: 'finance.write'
          ScopeDescription: 'Write access to financial tracking state'

  # Machine-to-Machine (M2M) Client for Bedrock/Agent runtimes using Client Credentials
  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-m2m-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub 'https://${ProjectName}.api/finance.read'
        - !Sub 'https://${ProjectName}.api/finance.write'

  # Web Client for interactive sign-in
  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-web-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - 'http://localhost:3000/callback'
      LogoutURLs:
        - 'http://localhost:3000/logout'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # Seeded Test User
  TestUser:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolUser
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Username: !Ref TestUserEmail
      DesiredDeliveryMediums:
        - EMAIL
      ForceAliasCreation: false
      MessageAction: SUPPRESS
      UserAttributes:
        - Name: email
          Value: !Ref TestUserEmail
        - Name: email_verified
          Value: 'true'

  # =========================================================================
  # 2. State Layer: Amazon DynamoDB
  # =========================================================================
  FinanceTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-finance-state'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: SessionId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: TurnId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: SessionId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: TurnId
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  # =========================================================================
  # 3. Execution Roles: MCP Server & Bedrock Agent Runtimes
  # =========================================================================
  MCPServerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-mcp-server-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FinanceTrackingTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FinanceTrackingTable.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: LoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/${ProjectName}/*'

  BedrockAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-bedrock-agent-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BedrockFoundationModelPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*'
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBStateAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FinanceTrackingTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FinanceTrackingTable.Arn}/*'

  # =========================================================================
  # 4. Service Discovery: SSM Parameter Store
  # =========================================================================
  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/cognito/user-pool-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool Identifier

  SSMUserPoolArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/cognito/user-pool-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      Description: Cognito User Pool ARN

  SSMM2MClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/cognito/m2m-client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref M2MClient
      Description: Cognito Machine-to-Machine User Pool Client ID

  SSMWebClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/cognito/web-client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebClient
      Description: Cognito Web Application Client ID

  SSMOpenIdDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/cognito/openid-discovery-url'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: Cognito OpenID Connect Discovery URL

  SSMTokenEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/cognito/oauth-token-endpoint'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${ProjectName}-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Description: Cognito Hosted UI OAuth2 Token Endpoint

  SSMDynamoDBTableName:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/dynamodb/table-name'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref FinanceTrackingTable
      Description: DynamoDB Finance State Tracking Table Name

  SSMMCPRuntimeRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/iam/mcp-server-role-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MCPServerExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: Execution Role ARN for MCP Server Runtime

  SSMBedrockAgentRuntimeRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/iam/bedrock-agent-role-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt BedrockAgentExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: Execution Role ARN for Bedrock Agent Runtime

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Identifier of the created Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the created Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  CognitoHostedDomainUrl:
    Description: Fully qualified domain prefix for Cognito Hosted UI
    Value: !Sub 'https://${ProjectName}-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

  OpenIDDiscoveryEndpoint:
    Description: OpenID Connect Configuration discovery endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  OAuthTokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth2 token issuance endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${ProjectName}-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

  M2MClientId:
    Description: Client ID for Machine-to-Machine authentication
    Value: !Ref M2MClient

  WebClientId:
    Description: Client ID for interactive user login
    Value: !Ref WebClient

  FinanceTrackingTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table storing finance state
    Value: !Ref FinanceTrackingTable

  FinanceTrackingTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table storing finance state
    Value: !GetAtt FinanceTrackingTable.Arn

  MCPServerRoleArn:
    Description: IAM Role ARN for MCP Server execution
    Value: !GetAtt MCPServerExecutionRole.Arn

  BedrockAgentRoleArn:
    Description: IAM Role ARN for Bedrock Agent execution
    Value: !GetAtt BedrockAgentExecutionRole.Arn

  SSMParameterNamespace:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Highly available two-tier VPC network with public and private subnets across two Availability Zones, dual NAT Gateways, and exported outputs.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 located in Availability Zone 1.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 located in Availability Zone 2.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.101.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 located in Availability Zone 1.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.102.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 located in Availability Zone 2.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-2'

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: Identifier of the created VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Identifier of Public Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Identifier of Public Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Identifier of Private Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Identifier of Private Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'
